izzyondroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.name: Let Me Downgrade
izzyondroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.summary: Add support for downgrading apps on Android 12 through 17.
izzyondroid:com.berdik.letmedowngrade.description:
Android's app installation system does not allow users to downgrade to an older version of an app when they already have a newer version installed. Let Me Downgrade is an Xposed module for Android 12 through 17 that enables users to bypass this restriction. The app provides a Status screen with a switch to allow or block downgrades at any time. You can also add an optional App Downgrades Quick Settings tile that mirrors the same on/off state for quicker access.
 ⚠️ WARNING: Let Me Downgrade is intended for rooted devices running Android 12 through 17 and requires Xposed. The required Xposed variant to use is LSPosed. Other Xposed variants will not work. Additionally, this module cannot be guaranteed to work on all devices. In the worst case, it can cause a bootloop. Use at your own risk.
 To use Let Me Downgrade:
 Install an LSPosed build with API 101 or 102 support. This requires your device to be rooted with Magisk or KernelSU.
 Install Let Me Downgrade.
 Activate the Let Me Downgrade module in the LSposed user interface.
 Reboot your device and sign in.
 Open Let Me Downgrade from your launcher. When the module is active in LSPosed, the Status card shows whether app downgrades are allowed or blocked; use the switch to turn the hook on or off.
 On LSPosed API 102, updating the Let Me Downgrade APK can reload the module hooks without a reboot (first-time activation still requires a reboot). On API 101, reboot after updating the module APK.
 Optionally, add the App Downgrades Quick Settings tile from the tile editor. The tile mirrors the in-app switch.

izzyondroid:com.github.warren_bank.exopl.name: ExoAirPlayer
izzyondroid:com.github.warren_bank.exopl.summary: play video/audio cast via stateless HTML API
izzyondroid:com.github.warren_bank.exopl.description:
ExoAirPlayer is an app you run on your Android set-top box. It plays video/audio URLs "cast" to it with a stateless HTTP API (based on AirPlay).
 There is no UI when the app starts. It’s a foreground service with a notification, which runs a web server on port 8192. The IP address of the server is given in the notification message.
 When a video URL is "cast" to the server, a video player opens full-screen. If the video player loses focus (ex: by pressing the "home" button), another notification is added to control playback or refocus on the video player window.
 When an audio URL is "cast" to the server, the music plays in the background – even when the screen is off.
 This page is the simplest way to send signals to a running instance. Though other "high-level" tools exist to capture media URLs from the wild (some are listed here ). One of them is DroidPlay , which lets you cast content from another Android device to ExoAirPlayer. 
 Audio or video files/playlists can also be started directly from the Android file system, which makes this app a very suitable replacement for a general-purpose video player. This can be done locally on the same device, e.g. using a file manager like Total Commander: if you tap a media file there, it implicitly calls an intent ExoAirPlayer (and other installed media players) act upon – so a list of such apps open and you can chose from it. You can also use Total Commander to create playlists; see here for details.
 The remote way to do this requires knowing the structure of the Android file system. In that case, rather than "casting" a URL.. you can "cast" a file or directory path (ex: /storage/sdb1/Downloads/my-video.mp4 ). This can be done with the website mentioned above.

izzyondroid:foss.chillastro.root.checker.name: Root Checker - Modern & Open Source!
izzyondroid:foss.chillastro.root.checker.summary: A Modern Open-Source Root Checker App for Android 7+!
izzyondroid:foss.chillastro.root.checker.description:
FOSS Root Checker is an open-source utility for verifying Root Access on Android devices with absolute transparency.
 Ever wondered what Root Checker apps do behind the scenes once you grant them permission? This app is designed for users who value simplicity and want to see exactly how their device is being audited.
 How it works:
 Search Root: Checks 40+ system paths to find traces of root access.
 Verify Root: Executes the command su -c id . If it returns 0, access is verified.
 BusyBox: Checks specific paths and executes su -c which busybox to verify installation.
 Performance: All checks run on a background thread (Dispatchers.IO) to keep your device responsive.
 Key Features:
 Ultra Low Footprint: ~2MB.
 Privacy First: No ads, no data collection, and no internet permission.
 Optimization: Reduced animations for devices with less than 4GB RAM.
 Modern UI: Material You design with Monet theming support.
 Wide Compatibility: Supports Android 6.0 and higher.
 Universal: Works with Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, and older methods.
 Credits and Resources:
 This project acknowledges the incredible work of the following developers and tools: Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, mtkclient, Shamiko, Tricky Store, Zygisk Next, Play Integrity Fix, and the TWRP/OrangeFox teams.
 Note from Developer:
 If you find this tool helpful, please consider starring the project on GitHub!

fdroid:com.brouken.player.description:
Android video player based on the ExoPlayer library. It uses ExoPlayer's FFmpeg extension with all its audio formats enabled (it can handle even special formats like AC3, EAC3, DTS, DTS HD, TrueHD etc.).
It properly syncs audio with the video track when using Bluetooth earphones/speaker.
Supported formats
 * Audio: Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, ALAC, PCM/WAVE (μ-law, A-law), MP1, MP2, MP3, AMR (NB, WB), AAC (LC, ELD, HE; xHE on Android 9+), AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD
 * Video: H.263, H.264 AVC (Baseline Profile; Main Profile on Android 6+), H.265 HEVC, MPEG-4 SP, VP8, VP9, AV1
 * Containers: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, Ogg, MPEG-TS, MPEG-PS, FLV
 * Streaming: DASH, HLS, SmoothStreaming, RTSP
 * Subtitles: SRT, SSA, ASS, TTML, VTT
HDR (HDR10+ and Dolby Vision) video playback on compatible/supported hardware.
Features
 * Audio/subtitle track selection
 * Playback speed control
 * Horizontal swipe and double tap to quickly seek
 * Vertical swipe to change brightness (left) / volume (right)
 * Pinch to zoom (Android 7+)
 * PiP (Picture in Picture) on Android 8+ (resizable on Android 11+)
 * Resize (fit/crop)
 * Volume boost
 * Auto frame rate matching on Android TV/boxes (Android 6+)
 * Post-playback actions (delete file/skip to next)
 * Touch lock (long tap)
 * No ads, tracking or excessive permissions

- Reorder your apps
- Hide the apps you don't use
- Change the apps' alignment (top / bottom / left / right / center)

fdroid:com.simplexray.an.name: SimpleXray
fdroid:com.simplexray.an.description:
SimpleXray is a high-performance proxy client for Android, built upon the robust Xray-core.
It features an innovative approach: directly executing the official Xray-core binary. This method isolates core logic from the app layer, boosting stability and maximizing Xray-core's native performance. SimpleXray aims to provide a stable and efficient network experience.
Key Features
- Enhanced Stability: By running Xray-core as an independent process, SimpleXray avoids common stability issues, significantly improving reliability.
- High Performance: Leverages Xray-core's native speed and efficient tunneling for low latency and high throughput.
- User-Friendly: Offers a clean, intuitive UI and simplified setup, making it easy for users to configure and manage connections.

- Competition billing: Detailed recording of assignments including automatic time calculation.

fdroid:com.tideo.autobrightness.name: Tideo Auto Brightness
fdroid:com.tideo.autobrightness.summary: A glass-box replacement for Android's adaptive brightness
fdroid:com.tideo.autobrightness.description:
You taught Android your brightness preferences and it is still wrong. Tideo
replaces the opaque on-device ML of stock adaptive brightness with deterministic,
inspectable math: a tunable lux-to-brightness curve you can see and shape, smooth
animated transitions, circadian (time-of-day) scaling, per-context overrides, and
an optional privileged "super dimming" mode that takes the screen below the system
minimum.
To use it, first disable the system's stock Adaptive/Auto Brightness
(Settings > Display), then launch Tideo, complete onboarding, and toggle the main
service on from the Dashboard.
Features:
* Three-zone perceptual brightness curve with a live, editable graph.
* Automatic curve fitting: adjust brightness by hand during normal use and, after
 a handful of points across varied lighting, the wizard suggests a fitted curve.
* Reactivity control: per-range dead zones that kill sensor jitter without making
 the screen sluggish.
* Smooth animated transitions with override detection: drag the system slider and
 Tideo steps aside, then resumes per your rules.
* Circadian scaling synced to local sunrise/sunset, shifting the whole curve
 across the day.
* Super dimming (privileged): drives Android's Reduce Bright Colors below the
 hardware floor, plus a PWM-flicker-aware software-dimming mode.
* Context automation: load profiles automatically by foreground app, time window,
 location, charging state, Wi-Fi SSID, or day of week.
* Profiles: five built-in presets plus save / overwrite / factory-restore and
 JSON import/export.
* Live Debug scene: a glass-box readout of every runtime variable and decision.
* Emergency recovery: flip the phone upside-down and shake to force brightness to
 max with an SOS vibration.
* Surfaces: foreground-service notification with actions, a Quick Settings tile, a
 home-screen widget, and boot-start.
Privilege tiers:
The core pipeline is fully functional at the BASIC tier, which uses only the
user-grantable WRITE_SETTINGS permission. The optional ELEVATED tier unlocks super
dimming and requires a one-time WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant that YOU perform via
adb, Shizuku, or root. It is never granted automatically.
About the permissions Tideo requests:
* Background location and location: used only by the optional location-aware
 context rules and the once-a-day sunrise/sunset refresh for circadian scaling.
* Usage access (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS): used only by per-app context rules to read
 the foreground app; granted from a Settings screen, not a runtime dialog.
* Accessibility service: optional and presentation-only. It draws the debug/context
 flash overlay system-wide. It does not read screen content and does not consume
 input events. With it off, Tideo falls back to a foreground toast.
Privacy:
Tideo is local-first with no analytics, ads, or accounts. It makes one outbound
network request, and only as a last resort: if you opt in and enable circadian
scaling and no on-device location is available, it falls back to a single HTTPS
request to ipwho.is to estimate your city from your public IP. This fallback is off
by default and can be turned off under Circadian > Date & location. Automatic lookup
runs at most once per day, and the resolved coordinates are saved only on-device;
the user-triggered Use current location action can make an additional request after
on-device location fails. Everything else runs entirely on-device.
Tideo is a ground-up Kotlin/Compose rebuild of the Advanced Auto Brightness Tasker
project, ported with exact behavioural parity. It is not affiliated with Tasker.

fdroid:io.github.alunoadsnoite.focusfeed.name: FocusFeed
fdroid:io.github.alunoadsnoite.focusfeed.summary: Offline Pomodoro with app blocking and earned social breaks
fdroid:io.github.alunoadsnoite.focusfeed.description:
FocusFeed helps you focus and turn completed work into earned breaks.
Choose installed apps to block, start a configurable Pomodoro, and earn 20% of completed focus time as a break balance. Spend that balance to temporarily release selected apps. Blocking resumes automatically when the break ends.
Features:
• Configurable focus timer, pause, resume and stop
• Installed-app selection with icons and search
• Native foreground monitor and blocking overlay
• Local balance and daily completed-focus history
• Session restoration and protection-status feedback
• Completion and break-expiry notifications
No account, advertisements, analytics or backend. All progress stays on your device.
Usage access and draw-over-other-apps access are needed for blocking. Notification permission is optional. Accessibility access is not required.
After a reboot or interruption, unfinished focus is restored paused without awarding credit for downtime. Android may restrict or stop background monitoring, and certain apps can hide overlays. This is a voluntary focus aid, not an unbreakable parental-control system.
Choose Brazilian Portuguese, English or Spanish in Settings.

fdroid:io.github.lydavid.musicsearch.name: MusicSearch
fdroid:io.github.lydavid.musicsearch.summary: MusicSearch is an app for browsing songs, artists, and anything related to them
fdroid:io.github.lydavid.musicsearch.description:

fdroid:io.github.u_20240816.trovepass.name: TrovePass
fdroid:io.github.u_20240816.trovepass.summary: Offline password generator — one master password for every site
fdroid:io.github.u_20240816.trovepass.description:
TrovePass derives a password for each of your websites and apps from a single master password — offline, with no account, on the device alone.
WHAT IT DOES
* Derives a site's password from your master password: the same site, login and options always produce the same password, on any device, with nothing stored.
* Remembers the site, login and options you used, so you never have to recall the counter and the character classes behind a password.
* Saves a password only when you press Save on it, and seals what you save with a key this device holds.
* Shows a fingerprint of your master password — a squared tile in two colours — so a typo is visible before it derives the wrong password.
* Speaks 85 languages, and asks for no permission of any kind.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
* No account, no sign-in, no sync, no telemetry, no analytics.
* No network code, and no network permission: there is nothing here that could send anything anywhere.
* The master password is never stored, in any form. Nothing asks you to unlock anything either — saved passwords are sealed with a key that never leaves the device.
THE SAME PASSWORDS AS LESSPASS
Both apps derive a password from the same inputs in exactly the same way, quirks included, so a password you generated with LessPass is the password TrovePass gives you. This is an independent implementation of the published format, not a fork.
WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who would rather remember one master password than fifty: a site name and the master password are enough, on any device, with no account to create and nothing to lose if the phone is lost.
LICENCE
GPL-3.0-or-later. The complete source of this app is published under that licence.

fdroid:org.metabrainz.android.name: MusicBrainz
fdroid:org.metabrainz.android.description:
MusicBrainz is an open music encyclopedia that collects music metadata and makes it available to the public.
MusicBrainz aims to be:
- The ultimate source of music information by allowing anyone to contribute and releasing the data under open licenses.
- The universal lingua franca for music by providing a reliable and unambiguous form of music identification, enabling both people and machines to have meaningful conversations about music.
MusicBrainz is maintained by a global community of users and we want everyone, including you, to participate and contribute.
Visit https://musicbrainz.org/ to know more
MusicBrainz App is designed to do the following:
- View release information by scanning a barcode
- Search for information about artists, releases, release groups, labels, recordings, instruments, and events.
- View collections
- Tag audio files like Picard
- Send Releases to your Picard
- Donate to the MetaBrainz Foundation
MusicBrainz captures information about artists, their recorded works, and the relationships between them.
Recorded works entries capture at a minimum the album title, track titles, and the length of each track.
These entries are maintained by volunteer editors who follow community written style guidelines.
Recorded works can also store information about the release date and country, the CD ID, cover art, acoustic fingerprint, free-form annotation text, and other metadata.
The source code for this app is available on GitHub at https://github.com/metabrainz/musicbrainz-android
This app uses icons designed by Freepik and Flaticon, leverages the Spotify Android SDK for playing tracks.

apple-macos:6746876898.description:
Find your way, book a ride, and message home with mobile data for your trip. Dingo lets you choose an eSIM plan for your destination and keep track of your remaining data in one app.
MOBILE DATA WITHOUT THE DRAMA
Travel already gives you enough to think about. We built Dingo to help you stay connected without constant sales pitches. Our push notifications focus on useful updates, such as your remaining data and service availability in the country you're visiting. We won't chase you with promotional emails.

apple-macos:6807020284.name: Traveled – My Travel Map
apple-macos:6807020284.description:
See your travels come together on one beautiful map.
Add the countries you've visited, the cities you remember and the years you were there. Traveled turns your travel history into a personal map that grows with every journey.
Add notes and a few favourite photos, and your map becomes a visual journal of the places that became part of your story.
YOUR WORLD, YOUR TRAVELS
Tap a country to see when you were there, which cities you visited and the memories you kept. Been somewhere more than once? Traveled remembers every visit. Planning somewhere new? Add it as a planned trip.
THREE WAYS TO SEE YOUR JOURNEY
• Visits — countries deepen in colour every time you return.
• Years — see your map coloured by the years you travelled.
• Atlas — explore your travels on Apple's map, with seas, borders and cities showing through.
Filter by year, focus on a country, or simply zoom out and see where life has taken you.
A TRAVEL JOURNAL WITHOUT THE CLUTTER
Traveled isn't a social network. There are no followers, feeds or travel scores.
Keep the things worth remembering: countries, cities, dates, notes and a few favourite photos.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-in. No Traveled cloud.
Your trips, notes and photos are stored on your device, not on our servers. Traveled has no analytics, no advertising and no tracking.
START FOR FREE
Build your travel journal with unlimited trips, countries, cities, years and notes. Add planned travels, filter by year, focus on individual countries and import an existing .traveled journal.
No trip limit. Nothing expires.
TRAVELED PRO
One purchase unlocks:
• Photos — keep the few photos that tell the story of each trip and see them on your map.
• All map styles — unlock Years and Atlas alongside Visits.
• Export — save your complete journal, including photos, as a .traveled file for backup or transfer to another device.
No subscription. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Your travels aren't a checklist. They're part of your story.
Put them on the map with Traveled.

apple-macos:6778096521.description:
The free, private note app for iPhone, iPad & Mac. No subscription, no account, no tracking — just fast handwriting, PDF markup, and backup to YOUR own cloud.
Write naturally with Apple Pencil, organize notes into colorful subjects, and keep everything synced to your own Google Drive or iCloud. Nothing lives on our servers — your notes stay yours.
WRITING & TOOLS

ORGANIZE
• Subjects → notebooks → pages, drag to reorder

• Search your handwriting instantly with on-device OCR
PDF & IMPORT/EXPORT
• Import and annotate PDFs
• Export as PDF, PNG, or the native .scribble format
• Share notes with other ScribblePad users
AUDIO
• Record audio synced to your strokes — replay your notes in time
PRIVATE BACKUP & SYNC (OPTIONAL)
• Back up to your own Google Drive (the app only sees files it creates) or iCloud
• Works fully offline — the cloud is yours, not ours
No sign-up. No ads. No data collection. Just a beautiful place to think.

apple-macos:6773389497.description:

Bring old scanner back to life, this app quickly discovers old and new scanners that are wifi connected.

flathub:io.github.erenseymen.android-tv-.summary: Control an Android TV over the network via ADB
flathub:io.github.erenseymen.android-tv-.description:
TV Remote is a modern GNOME application that lets you control your Android TV 
 from your Linux desktop. It discovers Android TV devices on your local network, 
 connects via ADB (Android Debug Bridge), and provides an intuitive remote control 
 interface.
 Features:
 Automatic network scanning to discover Android TV devices
 Low-latency input (35-70ms) using scrcpy-server technology
 Full D-pad navigation, volume controls, and media buttons
 Keyboard shortcuts for all remote functions
 Text input for searching and typing on your TV
 Auto-connect to last used device on startup
 Native GNOME/Libadwaita design following HIG
 Setup: Enable Developer options and USB/Wireless debugging on your TV, 
 ensure ADB over network is enabled on port 5555, and accept the authorization 
 prompt on first connection.

flathub:io.github.greykaizen.tur.name: Tur

 core (tur-rs). It supports multiple download engines including its own
 adaptive range-stealing engine and external engines like aria2c, with
 yt-dlp integration for media downloads.
 Features:
 Multi-engine support: native tur-rs, aria2c, yt-dlp
 Persistent download queue with SQLite (UUID v7 IDs)
 Parallel segmented downloading for maximum speed
 Clean, modern UI with per-download instance view
 System tray integration and notifications
 Configurable settings per engine

fedora-packages:3dprinter-udev-rules/3dp.name: 3dprinter-udev-rules

fedora-packages:3dprinter-udev-rules/3dp.description: Normally, when you connect a RepRap like 3D printer to a Linux machine by an USB cable, you need to be in dialout or similar group to be able to control it via OctoPrint, Printrun, Cura or any other control software. Not any more. Install this rule to grant all users read and write access to collected devices based on the VID and PID. Disclaimer: Such device might not be a 3D printer, it my be an Arduino, it might be a modem and it might even be a blender. But normally you would add your user to dialout and get access to all of those and more anyway. So I guess be careful when some of the users should not get access to your blenders.

fedora-packages:gi-docgen/gi-docgen.name: gi-docgen
fedora-packages:gi-docgen/gi-docgen.description: GI-DocGen is a document generator for GObject-based libraries. GObject is the base type system of the GNOME project. GI-Docgen reuses the introspection data generated by GObject-based libraries to generate the API reference of these libraries, as well as other ancillary documentation. GI-DocGen is not a general purpose documentation tool for C libraries. While GI-DocGen can be used to generate API references for most GObject/C libraries that expose introspection data, its main goal is to generate the reference for GTK and its immediate dependencies. Any and all attempts at making this tool more generic, or to cover more use cases, will be weighted heavily against its primary goal. GI-DocGen is still in development. The recommended use of GI-DocGen is to add it as a sub-project to your Meson build system, and vendor it when releasing dist archives. You should not depend on a system-wide installation until GI-DocGen is declared stable.

firefox-addons:2954729.name: Enhanced YouTube Mod Tools
firefox-addons:2954729.summary: Enhanced moderation tools for YouTube livestreaming
firefox-addons:2954729.description:
Enhanced moderation tools for YouTube livestreaming
Adds Delete, Timeout and Ban buttons to YouTube live chat, the way Twitch has them. Trade your broom in for a brand new vacuum!
Hover over a message and the three buttons show up at the right edge. One click and it's done, no digging through the three-dot menu. If you'd rather have them always visible in front of the name, like in older versions, you can switch that in the settings.
What it does:
- Delete a message, time out a user or ban them (YouTube calls it "hide user on this channel") with one click
- Quick timeout: pick a length once, from 10 seconds up to 24 hours, and the clock button applies it straight away without YouTube's dialog
- Track a user: open the three-dot menu on one of their messages and choose Track. Their messages get an orange highlight until you untrack them
- Keyword highlighting: add your own list of words, and any message containing one gets a red outline and a SPAM label
- Type /user name or !user name in the chat box to open that user's channel activity. They need to have a recent message in chat
- Bigger chat text if you want it (13 to 24 px)
- Counts your mod actions per day and in total, and you can export the log
- Every button can be turned off separately
- Works in dark and light theme
Good to know:
- You have to be a moderator or the owner of the channel. The buttons use YouTube's own moderation menu, so they can only do what YouTube lets you do.
- YouTube has to be set to English for the buttons to work.
Privacy: nothing is collected and nothing leaves your browser. Settings and the action log are stored locally.
New in 1.2.0
This version is mostly a rewrite to make things reliable.
- Buttons no longer misfire or get stuck when chat is busy
- Quick timeout now applies the length you picked
- Highlights no longer show up on the wrong messages
- Buttons appear on hover by default, so chat doesn't jump around. The old always-visible layout is still in the settings
- New option to fade the buttons when the mouse stops moving
- The right-click Timeout/Ban menu entries are gone, and the extension asks for fewer permissions

firefox-addons:2912375.summary:
Opens new tabs in the same group as the active one — right after, at the beginning, or at the end.
Supports Firefox’s native tab groups, vertical (sidebar) or horizontal (classic) modes.
firefox-addons:2912375.description:
New Tab Same Group is a Firefox extension that improves tab organization by automatically inserting new tabs into the same group as your current active tab — right after it, at the beginning, or at the end of the group, based on your preference.
This extension only works with native tab grouping v138+
🚀 Features
 ✅ Automatically groups new tabs with the active one
 🎯 Choose where new tabs are inserted:
 After active tab (default)
 At the beginning of the current group
 At the end of the current group
 🧠 Smart tracking of the source tab to ensure consistent behavior
 ⌨️ We removed half-working shortcut features to keep it simple
 🖤 Fully supports Firefox's native tab groups
 🔒 Zero tracking, zero external dependencies
 🧩 Works perfectly with both vertical tab layouts and classic horizontal tabs 
🛠 Requirements
 Firefox 138 or higher
 The browser’s native tab grouping system must be enabled
⚙️ How to Enable Tab Groups in Firefox
This extension works with both classic horizontal tabs and vertical tabs in the sidebar .
If you don’t see tab groups:
 Open the sidebar via F1 or View → Sidebar → Tabs 
 Right-click on a tab and choose Move Tab to New Group 
If tab grouping is missing entirely:
 Go to about:config 
 Search for browser.tabs.grouping.enabled 
 If it exists, set it to true 
 Restart Firefox
 🟣 Note: This extension only works with native tab grouping , not third-party tab managers. 
🧩 Installation
Download from addons.mozilla.org

bluejetty:00038469:ios.description:
Shia+ is the ultimate free Muslim companion app designed to support you in your daily spiritual journey. With a range of features including accurate prayer times, multiple Adhan options, a Qibla compass, a Dua guide, and much more, Shia+ has everything you need to deepen your connection with Islam. Plus, with no in-app purchases or ads, you can use Shia+ without any distractions.
Features:
• Accurate prayer times based on your location.
• Multiple Adhans or notification tones to choose from.
• Adhan Player to hear the full Adhan whenever you'd like.
• Countdown the remaining time of each prayer.
• Islamic calendar that will always remind you of important Islamic events.
• Description and history of each Islamic event.
• Wherever you are in the world, the Qibla compass will point you in the right direction.
• Prayer guide to assist muslims just learning to pray or anyone that just needs a quick reminder.
• Dua (supplication) guide for any occasion.
• Qadha tracker to make sure you never forget your qadha prayers or missed fasts you have left.
• 99 names of Allah feature to deepen your understanding of His attributes.
• Daily A'maal tracking to help you build righteousness and remember Allah throughout the day
• Tasbih al-Zahra counter with audio pronunciation option.
• Tasbih counter with audio pronunciation option.
• Read a brief narrative of the events that took place during the tragedy of Karbala.
• Motivational Islamic videos.
• Home Screen widgets to get quick access to the day's prayer times, upcoming prayer time, upcoming Islamic calendar event, and Daily A'maal stats.
• Lock screen widgets to get quick access to the day's prayer times, upcoming prayer time, upcoming Islamic calendar events.
• Pray for Others feature allows you to set a prayer and add the names you wish to pray for every day.
• Apple Watch app to seamlessly access prayer times through the WatchOS app or through complications on your watch face.
• Many more features and updates to come!
No in-app purchases: All features and Adhans are unlocked for your use.
Ad-free: Use Shia+ without any distractions!

Total Privacy Protection
Your browsing data belongs to you. Proxy Browser ensures your sessions remain private with secure proxy servers and a strict no-logs policy. We never track, store, or sell your browsing history.
Lightning-Fast Proxy Servers

No Logs. No Worries.

bluejetty:00026367:ios.description:
BLK
Look.Match.Chat.
BLK is the #1 Dating app made for Black Singles with a simple mission: To create an exclusive community where Black men and Black women can find meaningful connections with people who share similar likes and interests.
BLK is easy and fun to use: 
• Simply scroll through a personalized list of profiles. 
• If you're interested, slide the profile to the right to give the person a ‘Yeah’, or click the 'Heart' icon. 
• If the feeling's mutual, then you're a match and can start chatting in our app right away. 
• Not interested? Slide the profile to the left to give the person a ‘Nah’, or click the ‘X’ icon. 
Right when you join, all members can: 
• Become part of an exclusive community for single black men and black women
• Customize who and what they’re looking for
• Receive a personalized group of profiles to look through every day
• Chat with other members if they’ve liked you back
Go Premium and you can also:
• Send 5 Super Likes per week to stand out from the crowd and let people know that you're really interested 
• Rewind on people to give them a second chance
• Boost your profile each month to be one of the top profiles in your area for 30 minutes
• Send unlimited amount of likes to other members
• Have an uninterrupted experience with no ads!
Become Elite and you can:
• Get all of the Premium benefits PLUS 
• Remove the mystery and See Who's Liked You for instant matches!
So what now? Join the community, spread the word, find a match, and have fun! 
And don't forget! Check us out every day! We're growing fast and there's someone new to match with every day!
Privacy Policy: https://www.blk-app.com/en/privacy-policy Terms & Conditions: https://www.blk-app.com/en/terms-of-use 
If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of your subscription. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Current subscription starts at 9.99, and one-month, 3-month, and 6-month packages are available. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. If you don’t choose to purchase a subscription, you can simply continue to use BLK.
All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.

bluejetty:00013882:ios.name: Branch: A Better Payday
bluejetty:00013882:ios.summary: Welcome to a better payday. One with fast, flexible payout options for your earnings—whether that’s wages, tips, mileage reimbursements, direct deposit, or more. When your company offers Branch, you can receive a free digital bank account
bluejetty:00013882:ios.description:
Welcome to a better payday. One with fast, flexible payout options for your earnings—whether that’s wages, tips, mileage reimbursements, direct deposit, or more. When your company offers Branch, you can receive a free digital bank account and debit card that you can take with you for life, plus free financial wellness tools right at your fingertips. And it’s all possible through our simple, 90-second signup.
With your Branch account and card, you can save, spend, or send earnings however you like. 
SAVE
Keep your money securely in the Branch digital wallet; with a dedicated Savings Goal feature you can even set aside funds for specific financial goals.
SEND
Send your money to external bank accounts if needed, or to peers by connecting other P2P apps.
SPEND
Use your Branch Card to shop in-person or online, pay for gas and groceries, and get cash for free at more than 55,000 ATMs. 
With Branch, you can…
+Get Fast, Flexible Access to Your Earnings
Branch pushes money into your account the moment your company pays you. No more waiting for bank delays or paper checks.
+Create Your Own Payday
If your employer opts in to earned wage access, you can advance up to 50% of your earned wages on-demand to cover unexpected expenses.
+Enjoy Fee-Free Banking Options
Say goodbye to overdraft charges, in-network ATM fees, and other hidden bank fees. 
+Access Free Financial Wellness Tools
Earn cash back rewards on everyday spending, set aside funds for your unique savings goals, see personalized spending insights, and more. 
+Pay Bills
Use Your Branch Card or digital wallet to pay for recurring bills, subscriptions, and automatic payments.
+Transfer Money Easily
Quickly move money between other bank accounts when needed.
+Pay On the Go
Contactless payments are easy to use by enabling Apple Pay or Google Pay.
Sign up in 90 seconds or less and start accessing your earnings right away. Need help? Our responsive customer support (from real people!) can help you via phone or in-app chat.
Banking Services provided by Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC. The Branch Mastercard Debit Card is issued by Evolve Bank & Trust pursuant to a license from Mastercard and may be used everywhere Mastercard debit cards are accepted.

toolani is the best app for cheap international calls. Save up to 90% on international calls without any loss of quality to over 200 countries from the US. And the best of it, it works without the use of internet. No extra SIM. No extra contract. toolani works with every provider.
Download the app, sign up and make a free test call.
For new customers only, we offer 20% extra credit on your first top up. 
Depending on your needs, our top up packages range from $5 to $20.
- Our top rates to the EU: UK, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Switzerland, Spain, Germany and Portugal
- Our top rates to Asia: India, Pakistan, China, Sri Lanka and the Philippines
- Our top rates to the Americas: Cuba, Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Canada
- Our top rates to Africa: Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Kenya, South Africa
Why toolani?
* It's up to 90% cheaper than with your current provider.
* Make international calls to any phone: fixed and mobile line.
* No internet connection necessary. No extra SIM, no contract.
* Absolutely risk-free
How toolani works:
The app automatically recognizes all your international contacts. If you have enough credit, simply click on the contact you want to call and you will get connected instantly. 
With toolani you will always get the best call quality. The app connects you via a local landline number in your country to the person you want to call abroad. This means call quality is always really high because your calls don't use the internet.
What is the difference between toolani and international calling cards?
Functionwise none. Except that toolani stores your contacts and also recognizes your already existing ones on your phone. You don't have to worry about typing in long access numbers in your phone everytime anymore. Also, with your toolani credit you are not bound to one specific country as you often are with calling cards. You can use your credit to call every country worldwide.

Созданием персональных подборок занимается искусственный интеллект, поэтому в них будет только то, что вам интересно. Хотите заказать стильные кроссовки для спортзала? Интересуетесь заказом одежды для детей? В вашей подборке уже собраны лучшие предложения интернет-магазина Спортмастер!

• Афиша. Лекция, забег, мастер-класс и даже заплыв — с Афишей Спортмастер вы не только сможете попробовать что-то новое, но и получите за это бонусы от нас. И полезно, и практично!
• Медиа. От обзоров инвентаря до новых интересных фактов о спорте и ЗОЖ — совершенствуйте свои знания всегда и везде.
• Маршруты. Пробежка или прогулка станут еще интереснее. Выберите понравившийся маршрут или создайте свой.
• В движении. Новинка от Спортмастера — иммерсивный аудиосериал-тренировка, который поможет вам выйти на новый, более осознанный, уровень отношений со спортом.
• Live-трансляции. Обзоры новых коллекций, тест-драйвы, готовые образы от стилистов, призы и уникальные промокоды у вас в кармане.

• Большой ассортимент женской, мужской и детской одежды и обуви, аксессуаров и инвентаря. Всемирно известные торговые марки: adidas, PUMA, Nike, Reebok, ASICS, Kappa, The North Face, Vans, Columbia, Demix, ECCO и другие производители брендовых вещей для спорта и активного отдыха.

• Разные способы оплаты: онлайн, оплата при получении, рассрочка и кредит.
• Клубная бонусная программа. Регистрируйтесь, копите бонусы, оплачивайте ими покупки!
• Полезные сервисы: тренируйтесь, совершенствуйтесь, постигайте новое и становитесь лучшей версией себя вместе со Спортмастером совершенно бесплатно.

bluejetty:00042207:ios.description:
Find the best fishing spots and cast with confidence.
Fishidy is the only fishing app powered by Fishing Hot Spots® - a trusted name in the industry for over 40 years - and provides the most comprehensive and reliable fishing maps available.
Get access to extensively researched fishing tips and techniques specifically tailored to the top fishing destinations in the U.S.
You're only a few taps away from joining over 1 million Fishidy members who are having more success on the water!
LOCAL FISHING SPOTS
• Discover the best places to cast a line
• Access publicly-shared catches and spots
• See which baits are working when and where
LOG CATCHES AND SPOTS
• Can always be kept 100% private
• Track your most successful patterns
• Auto-capture weather conditions
RESEARCHED WATERWAY INFO
• Fishery details and insights
• Shoreline, seasonal and stocking info
• Marinas, boat ramps, and access points
LOCAL FISHING REPORTS
• Always know when the fish are biting
• Customizable waterway activity alerts
• Connect with others who fish nearby
GO PREMIUM
• Depth contours and navigation aids
• Unlock Fishing Hot Spots® with coordinates
• Expert-verified tips, presentations and lures
• Accurate mapping of structure and vegetation
• Fish habitat: reefs, rock piles, cribs, etc.
• Fishing insights, tips and forecasts
• Instantly identify the most productive water
• Access your maps offline in remote locations

▶ DISCOVER THE Q
bluejetty:00177754:ios.description:
Listen to the divine words of Allah with Quran Pro—featuring world-class recitations, custom playlists, daily inspirational verses, and comprehensive Quranic features designed to enhance your spiritual journey as a Muslim.
▶ DISCOVER THE QURAN ◀
[WORLD-CLASS RECITERS]
• Explore recitations from the world’s best Quran reciters, including new mesmerizing voices that bring the words of Allah to life.
[CUSTOM PLAYLISTS]
• Curate your own playlists with Duaa, Ruqia, and your favorite surahs for a personalized listening experience.
[RAMADAN FEATURES]
• Follow the countdown to Ramadan, watch prayers online, and get inspired with daily Quranic quotes and reminders.
[QURANIC SUPPLICATIONS]
• Access a collection of authentic Quranic supplications (duas) for your daily spiritual needs.
▶ ENHANCE YOUR SPIRITUAL ROUTINE ◀
[VERSE OF THE DAY]
• Receive daily inspiration with the Verse of the Day, offering meaningful Quranic verses every day to uplift your iman (faith).
[SEAMLESS TRANSLATIONS]
• Read the Holy Quran in Arabic alongside translations in French, English, and other languages, with options for tafsir (explanations and meanings) to deepen your understanding.
[OFFLINE ACCESS]
• Download recitations, playlists, and tracks for offline listening, ensuring you can access the Quran anytime, anywhere without an internet connection.
▶ INTERACTIVE READING EXPERIENCE ◀
[CLEAR TEXT & TRANSLATIONS]
• Read the Quran with clear text, multiple font options, and translations to choose from, enhancing your understanding of the divine message.
[FULL-SCREEN MODE]
• Enjoy an immersive reading experience with full-screen display in both portrait and landscape modes.
▶ MULTI-PLATFORM INTEGRATION ◀
[AIRPLAY & CARPLAY]
• Stream recitations seamlessly using AirPlay and CarPlay, integrating your Quranic experience across all your devices.
[BACKGROUND AUDIO]
• Continue your spiritual journey while multitasking with background audio play, complete with repeat, shuffle, and timer functions.
▶ CUSTOMIZATION & CONVENIENCE ◀
[PLAYLISTS & BOOKMARKS]
• Sync your personal playlists and bookmarks across all your devices, ensuring your progress and preferences are always saved.
[INTERACTIVE WIDGETS]
• Stay in control of your content right from the home screen with our new interactive widgets.
[DARK MODE]
• Fully supported dark mode for a comfortable reading and listening experience in low light conditions.
▶ UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR FREE ◀
[FREE WITHOUT LIMITATION]
• Enjoy all the features of Quran Pro without any restrictions, providing an unparalleled Quranic experience at no cost.
▶ PREMIUM AUDIO & OFFLINE DOWNLOADS ◀
[HIGH-QUALITY AUDIO]
• Enjoy unlimited high-quality audio for downloading and streaming over 8000 surahs.
[OFFLINE DOWNLOADS]
• Download all reciter playlists with one click for offline listening.
▶ CROSS-DEVICE LISTENING ◀
[SEAMLESS INTEGRATION]
• Listen across multiple devices with one subscription, including Apple Watch, Apple TV, CarPlay.
[12 LANGUAGES SUPPORT]
• Experience the app in 12 different languages.
Quran Pro is more than just a Quran app—it’s a comprehensive toolkit designed to enhance your connection with the Quran, whether you're at home or on the go. Strengthen your iman and deepen your understanding with Quran Pro.

bluejetty:00141205:ios.name: Tower Control Manager
bluejetty:00141205:ios.summary: Take control of various airport and immerse yourself in the challenging world of ground operations. As the Tower Control Manager your responsibility is to manage the traffic of plane on the ground, ensuring they taxi to the correct runways
bluejetty:00141205:ios.description:
Take control of various airport and immerse yourself in the challenging world of ground operations. As the Tower Control Manager your responsibility is to manage the traffic of plane on the ground, ensuring they taxi to the correct runways without delays. Precision is key as you coordinate aircraft movements, guiding plane to their designated spots while avoiding potential crashes and collision with your pilot. The stakes are high—one wrong move can lead to disastrous plane collision or traffic jams on the tarmac. Stay alert on every airport and plane, where the safety of each plane in your pilot hands.
Features:
- Airport Management: Take control of multiple airport, ensuring smooth plane operations, from takeoff to landing and pilot.
- Realistic Plane Traffic: Manage aircraft traffic on the ground and in the air, guiding plane to their correct runways.
- Plane Collision Avoidance: Prevent plane collision and potential collision during takeoff, landing, and taxiing across the airport. Aviod collision is your pilot main goal.
- Flight Control: Direct every flight from takeoff to landing, ensuring each aircraft follows the correct runway and traffic patterns.
- Pilot Experience: Step into the shoes of a pilot, managing aircraft during intense takeoff and landing scenarios at high traffic airport.
- Jet Traffic Management: Handle jet traffic across your airport, coordinating safe landing and takeoff sequences. Avoid collision between the aircraft with your expert pilot.
- Aircraft Emergency Response: Quickly respond to pilot emergencies to avoid crash and collision on the runway and during flight.
- Runway Operations: Oversee runway traffic at the airport, ensuring safe landing and takeoff for every plane under your command. Airport and pilot are involved to operate all the planes.
- Flight Safety Management: Maintain safety at your airport by preventing plane collision, managing traffic, and ensuring smooth takeoffs and landings.
- Advanced Aircraft Pilot Controls: As a pilot, manage jets through challenging takeoff and landing procedures, avoiding collision and maintaining control of aircraft traffic.

bluejetty:00026943:ios.description:
Unlock a world of Big Savings with discount offers, specials and deals on ClicFlyer- The Ultimate Shopping Companion for smart shoppers like you. ClicFlyer is an app that is transforming the shopping experience for people like you in KSA, Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Egypt ,Jordan & South Africa by creating a single platform with easy access to weekly offers catering to your family needs, from all the leading retailers.
Discover, compare and keep tabs on the latest offers and flyers from your favorite supermarkets, hypermarkets and retail stores- All on one app.
Maximize your weekly and monthly savings-Use ClicFlyer and never miss a deal again.
Features you will absolutely love:
• Interactive Flyers: You can conveniently browse through flyers and even click on the offers you like to see more details and save, sort and track them.
• Mark your favorite retailers: Once selected, they will appear on the top.
• Shopping List: Create your shopping list or once you save an offer you like, it will appear in your shopping list. You can compare, sort and filter by items, categories and retailers. Save the top offers from different stores and make a shopping list of maximum savings. 
• Search Bar: Our free search allows you to search by brand, product and categories. It also provides smart suggestions. 
• Store Information: Click on a deal for store availability along with maps and open hours to over 10000 listed stores.
• Categories: The category page has 15+ categories including grocery, Electronics, Health and Beauty, Baby and Mom, Home and Garden etc. that makes it convenient for you to browse offers.
• Filters and Discount Slider: There are filters for the type of retailers you are looking for and also a discount slider on flyers which helps you set the discount range and filter the rest of the offers out.
• Online Coupons: Online coupons for instant savings! 
• Share: Share deals, flyers and shopping lists with friends and family on numerous social media platforms. Share the joy of saving!
• Get Notified: View notifications in your own inbox by clicking on the bell icon and never miss a deal again.
• Trending: Stay updated with the most popular offers.

During special festival seasons and days like White Friday, Ramadan, Black Friday, Christmas, New year's , Eid, National Day, Heritage Day etc. this app is especially a must. ClicFlyer makes the whole process of discovery and savings seamless for its users.

Sport fishing, free and better than other free fishing apps.

Enjoy a virtual adventure in nature’s great outdoors and visit stunning fishing locations through relaxing gameplay – Catch the fishing fever this season with the ultimate fishing simulator app. 
Unwind, Relax & Go Fishing
Every fisherman or angler knows there’s nothing like coming back from work, picking up fishing tackle and heading to the nearest ocean or freshwater lake for some quality sport fishing. If it’s the fishing off-season, or you don’t have an angling boat at hand, simply open Let’s Fish! With realistic scenery in the heart of nature, you will feel like you are on an actual fishing trip, standing on the fishing dock, holding your fishing rod, staring at the water and waiting for your fish to take the bait.
Over 60 Stunning Locations
Travel to different photo-realistic locations in nature across all continents, like Rio Negro, Alaska, the Norwegian Fjords, American Lakes, South American rivers or oceans. Find the most appropriate fishing gear for each location and choose between a fishing rod, a net, or other options.
Over 650 Species of Fish
Catch various species of fish, from small and medium breeds like catfish, albacore and skipjack tuna or salmon to large fish species such as coelacanths, peacock bass, and even white sharks and whales. We are constantly adding more fish species and new unique features to the app.
Accessorize all the Way
Enjoy a variety of fishing tackles. Replace your natural worm bait and experiment with fly fishing or lures. With Let’s Fish’s virtual gear, online fishing is a truly authentic experience. We have the complete fishing tackle and equipment every angler would love to use: rods, hooks, lines, reels, landing nets, bait, ground bait, buffs... you name it! Let’s Fish has it all – “hook, line and sinker”
Competiton, player vs player duels, rankings and tournaments

You can easily become a fishing king and fish expert in this free sports games and free fishing simulator. You will need a good fishing gear and a strategy to match the best baits and rods (you should use other equipment for sea fishing, spin fishing,and float fishing) with the appropriate fishing location. You can't find a shark in cold arenas nor catch a big fish as trout, salmon or bass using a small rod.
Join Let’s Fish for your next outdoor angling adventure!

bluejetty:00124413:ios.description:
Welcome to the digital Multiverse! Magic: The Gathering is the original trading card game- and now you can download and start playing for free with your friends from anywhere!
Magic: The Gathering Arena empowers you to discover your strategy, meet the planeswalkers, explore the multiverse, and battle friends around the world. Collect, build and master your unique deck that will become its own legend. Your battle is only the beginning; duel on stunning battlefields, and enjoy Arena’s game changing battle effects and immerse yourself in the game. Start playing for free, challenge your friends, unlock cards, and feel the magic of the original fantasy CCG!
NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY
Never played Magic before? No problem! Magic: The Gathering Arena’s tutorial system takes you through the playstyles so you can find your strategy and decide if you’re the type to overwhelm your opponent with brute strength, if subterfuge is more your style, or anything in between. Meet characters from around the multiverse and try out spells and artifacts that make learning to play the original fantasy collectible card game quick and fun. It’s never been easier to play Magic! Collect cards to build a deck that matches your personality, then master your strategy to battle friends and be part of the TCG that started them all.
GAME ON(LINE)
The original TCG is now digital! Explore the fantasy worlds of Magic: The Gathering Arena and build your deck, play a variety of game formats to collect cards, master multiple strategies, and hone your skills against friends or the AI. With multiple game formats like Draft and Brawl, 15 unlockable collectible decks, and explosive card combo effects: Your ideal Magic: The Gathering playstyle is at your fingertips! Show off eye-popping cosmetics like avatars, card sleeves, and pets and collect daily rewards to grow your collection and build powerful decks that reflect your personal strategy.
CHALLENGE AND PLAY
Duel your friends for glory or enter in-game tournaments for exciting prizes! With Draft and Brawl pairing, there is always someone to game with. Special in-game events offer exciting rewards, and with Esports qualifiers your Pro-Magic dreams are closer than you think in the Arena Premier Play League! Queue into casual battles to hone your strategy at your own pace, or battle in Esports qualifiers and frequent tournaments to flaunt your mastery.
FANTASY AND MAGIC
Dive into the fantasy planes of Magic: The Gathering and write your own legend through Magic’s immersive lore and vibrant card art. Find your path through the multiverse using only favorite characters and their most iconic spells and artifacts, or create a theme deck with a narrative that makes sense only to you. Your story is only just beginning!
All prices inclusive of VAT. 
Wizards of the Coast, Magic: The Gathering, Magic: The Gathering Arena, their respective logos, Magic, the mana symbols, the planeswalker symbol, and all character names and their distinctive likenesses are property of Wizards of the Coast LLC. ©2019-2026 Wizards.

bluejetty:00145426:ios.description:
Do you find yourself glued to your chair for hours? Feeling stiff, sluggish, or experiencing back pain from too much sitting? It's time to stand up and move with Moova!
Moova is the #1 movement break reminder for desk workers, remote professionals, and anyone living a sedentary lifestyle. Whether you're deskbound at home or in the office, Moova makes it easy to prioritize well-being with personalized stand up reminders and engaging activities that improve mobility and keep you tension-free.
Hourly activity breaks can:
• Relieve back pain, neck pain, sciatica, and stiff shoulders
• Reduce RSI (repetitive strain injury) and carpal tunnel risk
• Correct text neck and forward head posture from screen time
• Increase flexibility and mobility in muscles and joints
• Lower the risk of DVT (deep vein thrombosis) from prolonged sitting
• Reduce blood sugar levels more effectively than a 30-minute workout
• Improve posture, energy, and sleep quality
• Boost circulation, metabolism, and core strength
▶ WHY MOOVA? ◀
[ EASY-TO-FOLLOW STRETCH ROUTINES ]
Guided 5-minute desk stretch routines and gentle exercises to improve flexibility and combat stiffness — ideal for long days at the desk.
[ GUIDED ACTIVITY BREAKS ]
Accessible exercises for all fitness levels. No equipment needed — move, walk, breathe anytime. Perfect as a quick work break or pomodoro-style focus session.
[ BUILT FOR ADHD & FOCUS ]
Struggle with time blindness or hyperfocus? Moova's gentle break reminders help you stay aware of time passing, take regular movement breaks, and return to work refreshed. A focus timer that cares for your body too.
[ WALKING BREAK STEP COUNTER ]
Track your steps during walking breaks with the built-in pedometer, contributing to your daily step goal.
[ CUSTOMIZABLE BREAK REMINDERS ]
Reminders tailored to your schedule, ensuring regular movement without disrupting your work routine. Set hourly alerts or customize your own ergonomic break schedule.
[ ACTIVE HOUR ACTIVITY TRACKER ]
Track daily movement and sedentary patterns with daily, weekly, and monthly breakdowns.
[ MINDFULNESS AND RELAXATION ]
Breathing exercises designed to reduce stress, increase focus, and improve mental health.
[ HEALTH APP INTEGRATION ]
Sync activities for a holistic health overview within Apple's Health App.
[ SCIENTIFIC BACKING ]
Grounded in research, routines designed by experts to offset sedentary lifestyle risks including hip flexor tightness and slouched posture.
[ OFFICE-FRIENDLY ROUTINES ]
Discreet desk exercises you can do right at your workstation.
[ UPGRADE TO PREMIUM ]
Unlock full potential with our premium subscription, starting with a free 7-day trial.
▶ What Users Are Saying ◀
• "The office workouts are perfect for keeping me from getting sore from sitting all day."
• "Game changer for my lower back pain."
• "This app has improved my stiffness and tension significantly."
• "Having ADHD, the reminders are perfect for helping me break hyperfocus and ensure I take time to care for myself while working hard."
-----------
Don't let long hours at your desk take a toll on your health. Download Moova today.
Questions or feedback? support@getmoova.app
Terms: https://www.getmoova.app/terms
Privacy: https://www.getmoova.app/privacy

bluejetty:00140473:ios.summary:

Why settle for either cutting-edge tec
bluejetty:00140473:ios.description:
Ready for a banking app that redefines what you expect from digital banking? You’re in the right place. With us, it’s all about giving you a banking experience that’s smarter, faster, and more secure.
Why settle for either cutting-edge tech or financial stability when you can have both? We combine the innovation of a fintech with the security of an FDIC-insured bank, giving you powerful features with the peace of mind you deserve.
YOU’RE SECURE
Before we tell you what makes us stand out, let’s start with what makes us safe. Primis is an FDIC member bank, which means the federal government insures your deposits. Plus, with advanced encryption protecting your data, your money and information stay secure every time you log in.
YOU’RE IN GOOD COMPANY
Customers with millions of dollars trust us to safeguard and grow their money. We have a team dedicated to tackling fraud and keeping your money safe from cyber scammers. 
YOU CAN CALL US 24/7/365
366 on leap years. Our Virginia-based customer care center is open all the time, staffed with real Primis teammates. Some digital banks outsource customer service to overseas call centers. That’s not our style. 
NO FEES. NO KIDDING.
No account fees, no per-item fees, no overdraft fees—and no ATM fees. With Primis, we believe banking should be easy, not loaded with fees and fine print. For checking, we’ll refund ATM fees from other banks on the business day your statement cycle ends. (Heads up: Savings Accounts are not eligible for refunds of ATM fees from other banks.)
MOVE MONEY.
We expect you’ll want to spend your money and make deposits. Some banks want to charge you for this, which blows our mind. With Primis, you can send money to friends and family as fast as a text – with no transfer fees. Make deposits and schedule bill payments any time all from within our app. You can even get paid early. Once we’re notified of an upcoming direct deposit, we’ll go ahead and credit your account, up to two days early.
ACCOUNTS THAT STAND OUT. 
 We’re not just another pretty face. Our tools are top-notch, and our products speak for themselves. Choose an account that earns competitive interest or one that rewards you with every debit card purchase.

Chinese Chess brings Xiangqi strategy to your phone and tablet with online Game Center play, offline AI practice, and local two-player matches.

bluejetty:00151997:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw Explorer!
This is a relaxing, fun, and addictive jigsaw puzzle game. Slide puzzle pieces to restore the image, exercising your brain while unwinding your mind. You can download the game for free on iPhones and iPads, training your logical thinking and concentration in a laid-back atmosphere.
The gameplay is simple and intuitive, with difficulty progressing gradually. Whether you want to pass the time or challenge your cognitive limits, Jigsaw Explorer meets your needs!
What’s more special: after completing each level, you unlock a puzzle piece of a world landmark, gradually revealing iconic global landmarks and embarking on your own personalized world tour!
How to Play:
1. Slide the puzzle pieces with your fingers and drag them to the correct position.
2. When pieces are correctly connected, they will automatically snap together for easy overall movement.
3. Complete the puzzle by correctly assembling all the pieces!
Game Features:
- Easy Controls: Simply slide the pieces to play.
- Automatic Merging: Connected pieces automatically stick together, making the game easier and more enjoyable!
- Multiple Difficulty Levels: From easy to hard, the number of pieces and challenges progressively increase.
- Varied Categories: Covering dozens of themes including food, animals, and natural landscapes — every playthrough offers a fresh experience!
- Offline Mode: No internet needed, enjoy puzzles anytime, anywhere.
- Collection System: Complete puzzle challenges to collect world landmarks and start your global journey!
Download now and start your puzzle adventure!
Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or looking for a casual way to relax, JigsawExplorer delivers immersive cognitive fun and visual enjoyment.

bluejetty:00185924:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00185924:ios.description:
"Aurcus Online" is a 3D MMORPG for smartphones featuring Non-targeting combat system. 
Apart from the targeting system (select the target for automatic attacks) of the usual MMORPG (Online RPG), the non-targeting system allows you to hit the enemy in the striking range.
With this non-targeting system, you are able to enjoy even more exhilarating experience, and more real time-like and exciting battles in this MMORPG (Online RPG).
Furthermore, PVPs where you go against other players, and the addition of new fields will be provided in updates, expanding the world even wider.
The basic game play is available without payment, so please give it a try to experience the stimulation of non-targeting system, and if you have any requests or suggestion for the game, please let us hear you from "Contact" in the official website of "Aurcus Online".
[Story]
Levaria, the land protected by the spirits.
Countries have fought with swords and magic for hundreds of years for their order and independence.
A few years ago, the advent of the Dark Force brought further chaos to the world.
Nations were perished overnight and many towns were invaded.
Not only monsters getting wild in various places but also the ancient beast is about to awake by the dark power of death.
To cope with the Dark Force, the alliance of the countries was inevitable.
However, the common enemy was not enough to wash away the grudges from the past.
The Galleria Kingdom proposed the founding of cooperative organization, and the conclusion of "Blood Oath".
That is an ancient spell that cannot be discarded even by the destruction of the world.
Thus, in the midst of the emergence of the Dark Force and the discord of the countries,
a stateless organization- Sword of Aurcus was born.
People start to gather to join the organization.
And you are just one of them right now...
-------------------------------------------- 
**Please Note**
-This game is an online game. You will need to connect via Wi-Fi on iPod touch or iPad.
-The running speed may change depending on your device.
-You may not be able to access the game depending on the connection environment or due to emergency maintenance.
-Please play in good manner to avoid troubles with other players.

You don’t have to strain your eyes and read the Bible because from Genesis to Revelation is being read. This reading is not typical Twi reading, but modern reading.
Brethren, this is the Twi Bible Asante you are looking for with great features.
There is no other Twi Bible with complete audio Clean and perfect than this. Versions.
The FASTEST Twi Bible app and most efficient way to read & study the Bible. Quickly navigate to any verse and easily access tools to help further your understanding of the Bible.
 Specifically tailored for speakers of the Akuapem Twi dialect, this app provides a seamless and enriching experience for anyone seeking to explore the holy scriptures in their native language.
Key Features:
1. Complete Twi Akuapem Bible: Immerse yourself in the rich and poetic language of Akuapem Twi with the entire Bible at your fingertips. From Genesis to Revelation, every chapter and verse is thoughtfully translated to bring the sacred text closer to your heart.
2. User-Friendly Interface: Navigating the scriptures has never been easier. Our user-friendly interface ensures a smooth and intuitive experience, allowing you to focus on the Word without distractions.
3. Offline Access: Access the Twi Akuapem Bible anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. Carry the divine teachings with you, whether you're in the comfort of your home, on a journey, or attending a worship service.

6. Audio Bible: Immerse yourself in the spoken word of God with our upcoming Audio Bible feature. Listen to the scriptures being read aloud to enhance your understanding and connection with the divine message.
Experience the power and beauty of the Twi Akuapem Bible in a digital format that complements your modern lifestyle. Download the app now and embark on a spiritual journey that transcends language barriers, bringing you closer to the heart of God.
May the Twi Bible Akuapem app be a source of inspiration, comfort, and guidance on your path of faith.

bluejetty:00171123:ios.description:
Get the latest, most-accurate weather forecasts from Northeast Kansas’ #1 weather team. Plan your day with a quick glance at your current conditions and what’s in store the next few hours; or plan the week with the extended 10-day forecast.
When severe weather strikes, you won’t be caught off-guard thanks to alerts from the 13 NEWS Weather team and the National Weather Service. You’ll be able to track the storm on the interactive radar. Our meteorologists will explain what you can expect during live streams during bad weather and daily quick videos on the sunny days.
And it all comes in a clean and easy-to-use design!
The WIBW Mobile Weather App includes:
• Access to station content specifically for our mobile users
• 250 meter radar, the highest resolution available
• High resolution satellite cloud imagery
• Future radar to see where severe weather is headed
• Current weather updated multiple times per hour
• Ability to add and save your favorite locations
• Daily and Hourly forecasts updated hourly from our computer models
• A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
• Opt-in push alerts to keep you safe in severe weather
• Severe weather alerts from the National Weather Service

bluejetty:00142567:ios.description:
Your mobile access to your gym
Does your gym use the MySports app to service you digitally? Good for you! This app will change your training experience and make life much easier. 
Conveniently book classes and appointments via your smartphone!
No need to call, no need to come in person - if you want to book a class with a limited number of participants, an EMS or personal training appointment, you can do so conveniently via the app. Simply select a service, set an appointment and nothing stands in the way of your training. If something should come up, you can of course make changes at any time - at the touch of a button.
All training data at a glance
In the MySports app, you can take a look at your individual training plan at any time and log all your activities in detail. On the other hand, your data including your health profile, fitness level and training progress are also available to the studio so that your coach can always provide you with the best possible support and motivation. If necessary, your coach can easily adjust your training plan on his end- MySports shows you the updates immediately.
Manage your membership
With the self-service area, you can manage your gym membership from the comfort of your own home. Change your contact details or enter your new bank account. You can also request idle periods and view the details of your contract.
Optionally, you can also participate in the new sports sponsorship programme by sharing your step data from the HealthKit.
The app was released in the past under the name NoExcuse.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00089391:ios.description:
Create your own AI agents in one click to automate custom workflows across your tools, with no technical skills needed. Spend less time on busywork and more time on the work that matters.
Your AI agents let you talk to your tools like you talk to your team: take action, flag what needs attention, and keep projects on course, all through a familiar, secure chat interface.
Start on your own, then invite your team to work with the same AI agents in a group chat. It’s as easy as texting, so everyone can get started instantly and collaborate with the same AI agents in the same chat.
WHY CHOOSE ZENZAP?
• Ready in One Click: Put AI agents to work without a developer or technical setup.
• Custom Workflows: Automate tasks and processes built around how you actually work, giving you and your team hours back.
• Connected to Your Tools: Get work done across the tools you already use, just by asking.
• Built for Collaboration: Work with your team and AI agents in the same conversation.
• As Easy as Texting: Talk about work and get it done in one familiar interface.
• Gets Smarter Over Time: Your AI agents learn from your conversations and connected tools, adapting to how you work.
• Secure & Controlled: Decide who can access your AI agents and what they can do, while chat history and files stay off personal devices and under company control.
KEY FEATURES
• AI Agents: Create AI agents in one click, customized for the way you actually work. Talk to them like you would talk to a coworker.
• Automated Workflows: Create custom workflows for any task or process across your tools, in your own words. Your AI agents put them into action.
• Connected Tools: Let AI agents take action across the tools you already use.
• Full Admin Control & Compliance: Manage access to chats and AI agents, and decide what AI agents can do. Zenzap is GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 compliant, plus HIPAA compliant with a signed BAA for healthcare teams.
• Structured Communication: Organize chats around your workflows, with your team and AI agents together. Assign work to an AI agent or colleague and track progress.
• Calls & Video Meetings: Start a voice or video call from any chat, with recordings and searchable transcriptions so anyone who missed it can catch up.
Put AI agents to work across your workflows. Download Zenzap today.

bluejetty:00028793:ios.description:
TIDY HEALTH PHR is an AI-assisted Personal Health Record that keeps track of your whole healthcare journey in one place — conditions, medications, doctor visits, tests, logs, documents, care team contacts - and then can answer your medical questions based specifically upon your complete personal health records.
Get timely reminders for appointments, medications, screening tests, and daily logs. Easily share with those who need to know. Use widgets to stay on top of your health or to enable others to access your vital data in an emergency.
Tidy Health approaches your wellbeing holistically and considers aspects that electronic medical records and doctor portals often overlook - such as supplements, biomarkers, alternative resources, mental health, preventive health, and longevity factors. 
Built mobile first, Tidy app is fast, reliable, and integrated into Apple's robust ecosystem - user interfaces are familiar and learning curves do not require technical expertise. It fully integrates with Apple Health App and is intended for those taking care of chronic conditions in themselves or others. 
Best of all, Tidy Health AI is totally private and secure - all data is saved locally on your own trusted devices and not stored by third-party cloud services. You own your data - and keep it forever - even if Tidy Health goes away someday. 
Founded by a Harvard trained physician, Tidy Health is meant to allow patients and caregivers stress-free control of their personal health information. 
Our mission is simple - make navigating the complexities of our healthcare system easier, healthier, and less stressful. 
Tidy Health is FREE to use, with unlimited advanced features available with a low-cost Tidy+ Premium membership that helps us innovate and improve.
We love hearing from our users and typically respond within 24 hours - send feedback or questions using our in-app chat feature or drop an email direct to jon@tidyhealthphr.com
Want to partner with us? Tidy Health also supports health plans, self-insured employers, and healthcare organizations. 
Medical Disclaimer: Tidy Health PHR is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice and care, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult with qualified healthcare providers. 
See Terms of Use: https://www.tidyhealthphr.com/terms

bluejetty:00173264:ios.description:
Masterpieced is a unique puzzle game that immerses you in beautiful works of art and the stories behind them.
As each puzzle begins, you are given a picture along with words of the artist’s story behind their masterpiece. Your objective is to solve the puzzle, strategically using both picture and story. With every placed piece, colors build, music plays, and clues are revealed...
Features...
- Hundreds of beautiful works of art created by artists past to present, across a wide variety of artistic mediums and genres.
- Puzzles featuring Vincent van Gogh and many of his contemporaries by the Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam! Learn about Van Gogh and his paintings and experience these masterpieces in a way never experienced before.
- Puzzle illustrations are paired with stories written by each artist - each giving you a glimpse into what inspired them to create their masterpiece.
- Over 3 hours of custom-composed music and beautiful sound effects provide an even deeper dimension to gameplay.
- Experience gameplay together with family and friends anywhere around the world with real-time multiplayer!

bluejetty:00062089:ios.name: Collins Spanish-English
bluejetty:00062089:ios.summary:
Over 100,000 translations • Conjugates thousands of Spanish and English verbs • Hundreds of usage notes and examples • No internet connection required
Carry a dependable Spanish and English reference everywhere you go with the Collins Pro
bluejetty:00062089:ios.description:
Over 100,000 translations • Conjugates thousands of Spanish and English verbs • Hundreds of usage notes and examples • No internet connection required
Carry a dependable Spanish and English reference everywhere you go with the Collins Pro Spanish-English Translation Dictionary. This app contains dictionary data from HarperCollins in our popular Ultralingua interface. Use our verb conjugation tool to find complete conjugations of thousands of verbs in all standard forms, and the number translator to convert numerals into Spanish or English text instantly.
DICTIONARY:
• Over 55,000 entries with 100,000 translations
• Tap-and-hold any word or phrase and choose "Speak" from the popup menu to hear that word spoken using Apple's built-in text-to-speech feature.
• Noun genders
• Slang, technical language, and regional differences in spelling and usage
• Hundreds of usage notes about troublesome constructions
• Smart search results in case you misspell or mistype
• Search-as-you-go displays words and narrows your selection as you type
VERBS:
• Conjugations for thousands of Spanish and English verbs
• Includes all standard tenses and forms
• Smart search finds infinitives and catches misspellings
• Must-have reference tool for any student or language professional
• On iPhone/iPod touch, conjugate a verb from the dictionary results by tapping it
MORE:
• Translate numerals into Spanish and English text with the number tool
• Language swapper button to switch from Spanish-English to English-Spanish
• Tap the history button to view the 50 most recent dictionary definitions, verb conjugations, and more in one place. Sort the list alphabetically or by date, and choose to clear the list completely or delete one entry at a time.
• No internet connection required
• Change your device settings to view the app display in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, or German
REVIEWS:
"It is the most useful app on my ipod touch. You don´t have be connected to the internet which is a serious plus." -User review
View our reviews below to see why users love this app, and remember to let us know what you think!
This universal app will run on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch, so you can purchase it once and load it onto all your devices. The iPad and iPhone/iPod touch versions look and behave differently to give you a great experience on every device you own. The interface will change, but you’ll always have the same outstanding language data and tools inside.
Dictionaries are available from Ultralingua for many languages, including combinations of English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, and more. See what else we have to offer by searching for Ultralingua in the App Store.
Follow us on Twitter and become a fan on Facebook for app news, language learning tips, and more:
http://www.twitter.com/ultralingua
http://on.fb.me/ifI8Hy
