bluejetty:00131664:ios.description:
Wir machen die Welt für Sie verständlich. Mit mehr als 500 Journalistinnen und Journalisten bietet Ihnen DER SPIEGEL verlässlichen, unabhängigen, ständig aktuellen Journalismus. Wir decken auf, liefern Hintergründe und erklären Zusammenhänge. Nachrichten, kompakte Briefings, lesenswerte Reportagen: alles in einer schnellen App. 
Hier finden Sie aktuelle Nachrichten und Hintergründe und den digitalen wöchentlichen SPIEGEL übersichtlich in einer App. 
• SPIEGEL-Startseite: die wichtigsten Nachrichten, direkt von unserem Newsdesk, tagsüber gesteuert aus Hamburg und Berlin, nachts aus Sydney. 
• Eine zentrale Navigation: Die Navigation erlaubt Ihnen den direkten Einstieg in unsere Schlagzeilen, zum Games-Angebot – und nun auch zur wöchentlichen digitalen Ausgabe und allen anderen digitalen Magazinen des SPIEGEL in einer kompakten Übersicht. Laden Sie einzelne Magazin-Ausgaben als PDF-Download in der App herunter und lesen Sie diese bequem offline. Entdecken Sie hier den SPIEGEL-Journalismus in seiner ganzen Vielfalt – übersichtlich und hochwertig präsentiert: SPIEGEL BESTSELLER, SPIEGEL GESCHICHTE und mehr.
• DER SPIEGEL digital lesen: alle Reportagen, Analysen und Service-Artikel aus unserem SPIEGEL Digitalabo. 
• EXTRA: Entdecken Sie jetzt unser SPIEGEL Extra! An jedem Wochentag ein neues Angebot für die Themen des Alltags: Arbeit, Fitness, Geld, Gesundheit, Genuss, Reisen, Familie und Liebe.
• Einstellbare Push-Benachrichtigungen: Ob Eilmeldungen, Leseempfehlungen, Briefings oder Aktuelles aus Ihrem Lieblingsressort – wählen Sie aus, welche Push-Benachrichtigungen Sie erhalten wollen. Dank Push-Mitteilung verpassen Sie auch keine Ausgabe des wöchentlichen Magazins. 
• Schlagzeilen: alle Nachrichten des Tages in chronologischer Reihenfolge. 
• Audio: Erleben Sie unser vielfältiges Angebot wie unsere Premium-Podcasts »MAD KINGS«, »NDA: Die Akte Kasia Lenhard«, »Firewall« oder »Die Lage«, unseren täglichen Nachrichten-Überblick. Oder entdecken Sie weitere wie unseren Auslands-Podcast »Acht Milliarden« oder »Smarter Leben« – den Podcast für ein besseres Leben. 
• Ihr Konto: Push-Einstellungen, die persönliche Merkliste sowie weitere Einstellungsoptionen wie Dunkelmodus sowie Schriftgrößen.
Mehr Perspektiven, mehr verstehen. Unsere digitalen Abo-Angebote auf einen Blick: 
• DER SPIEGEL im Digitalabo: unbegrenzter Zugang zu allen SPIEGEL-Inhalten auf allen Endgeräten für 26,99 Euro im Monat. 
• Werbefrei lesen: die App weitestgehend werbefrei und ganz ohne Werbetracking für monatlich 4,99 Euro lesen. 
Feedback, Ideen, Wünsche? Bitte kontaktieren Sie uns unter app@spiegel.de. Unser Anspruch ist, unsere Produkte und Inhalte ständig zu verbessern. DER SPIEGEL im Digitalabo und die Werbefrei-lesen-Option werden über Ihren iTunes-Account abgewickelt und mit Kaufbestätigung bezahlt. 24 Stunden vor Ablauf verlängert sich das Abo automatisch um einen Monat. Für DER SPIEGEL im Digitalabo entfallen 15,60 Euro auf das PDF/ePaper des SPIEGEL. In den Einstellungen Ihres iTunes-Accounts können Sie jedes dieser Abos jederzeit kündigen. Um das Digitalabo oder die Werbefrei-lesen-Option außerhalb dieser App zu nutzen, müssen Sie das jeweilige Abo direkt nach dem Kauf mit einem SPIEGEL-ID-Konto verknüpfen. Mit dem Kauf akzeptieren Sie unsere Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen (https://www.spiegel.de/nutzungsbedingungen) und unsere Datenschutzerklärung (http://spiegel.de/datenschutz-spiegel).

bluejetty:00044520:ios.description:
Bayview Shuttle is your go-to app for getting around the Bayview and Hunter’s Point area. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be an on-demand Bayview Shuttle ride or another public transit option.
How it works:
-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you the best journey available at that time. 
-Book Bayview Shuttle rides directly in the app for you and any additional passengers
-Never miss your ride with live arrival times for your bus and ride tracking for your Bayview Shuttle journey.
-There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- FOR THE COMMUNITY: The Bayview Shuttle was made to empower the Bayview/Hunters Point community because transportation shouldn’t be an issue in your daily lives. With Bayview Shuttle, getting around the neighborhood and connecting to the rest of the city has just become a breeze. 
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best public transit journey available at that time. Using the Bayview Shuttle, you’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- AFFORDABLE: Bayview Shuttle offers the same affordable pricing as all Muni rides, including a number of discounts for seniors, riders with disabilities, and riders with low income.
- ACCESSIBLE: The app allows you to travel in a vehicle that meets your mobility needs
- SAFE: The Bayview Shuttle prioritizes your safety. Our drivers are thoroughly vetted, ensuring a safe and secure journey to your destination.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00133959:ios.summary:
Combining Mi Fitness with smartwatch or smartband devices, users can track their health and fitness data.
Mi Fitness supported：Xiaomi Watch Series, Redmi Watch Series, Xiaomi Smart Band Series, Redmi Smart Band Series.
Keep track of your wo
bluejetty:00133959:ios.description:
Combining Mi Fitness with smartwatch or smartband devices, users can track their health and fitness data.
Mi Fitness supported：Xiaomi Watch Series, Redmi Watch Series, Xiaomi Smart Band Series, Redmi Smart Band Series.
Keep track of your workouts
Map your route, monitor your progress, and achieve your goals. Whether it's walking, running, or biking, you can easily track it right from your phone.
Monitor your health information*
Mi Fitness APP assists you in managing your personal health, helping you to always maintain your optimal state. By connecting Xiaomi or Redmi smartwatch/band devices, important health indicators such as heart rate, sleep, stress, and energy can be monitored and risk warnings generated throughout the day. Health data such as weight and women's health can also be manually recorded and managed.
Sleep better*
In conjunction with Xiaomi or Redmi smartwatch/band devices that has sleep monitoring functionality, you can record your sleep information every night. By conducting in-depth analysis of the different stages of sleep, including deep sleep, light sleep, and rapid eye movement, as well as monitoring your sleep heart rate, breathing quality, body movements, and other sleep-related data, the device generates a personalized sleep report. This report can help remind you to adjust your sleep habits in a timely manner.
Easy payments with wearable device
Link your Mastercard cards to Mi Fitness and enjoy the convenience of making payments on the go with your wearable device.
Ask Alexa for convenient access
With Alexa, you can easily access important features like checking the weather, playing music, and starting a workout. Just ask and you're good to go.
Stay informed with notifications
Receive notifications, messages, and emails directly on your wearable device, so you can stay informed without having to constantly check your phone.
ECG Jurisdiction Statement
The ECG feature uses “移动心电房颤提示软件” (Mobile ECG Atrial Fibrillation Notification Software; model: ECG-V1), which is registered as a medical device in mainland China by the Beijing Medical Products Administration (Registration No. 京械注准20252210775). The ECG feature is available for use only in mainland China and is not available in other countries or regions.
ECG Intended Use and Limitations
The software works with compatible Xiaomi wrist-worn devices to record, store and display transmitted ECG data and identify sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation in adults. Its notifications are for reference only and are not a direct basis for clinical diagnosis. It is not intended for users under 18 or users with other known arrhythmias.
*Disclaimer
Except for manually entered health information, the app's general fitness and wellness services synchronize and record information from connected watches or bands. General fitness and wellness data, results and suggestions are for reference only and are not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment. The ECG feature is subject to the intended use and restrictions stated above. If you feel unwell, seek advice from a healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00123577:ios.description:
Cook with confidence and convenience. RecipeBox is the ultimate recipe organizer and meal planning companion for busy home chefs. Save all your favorite recipes from any website or app – from popular food blogs to Instagram and TikTok posts – and keep them organized in one place. Plan delicious meals for the week and automatically generate smart grocery lists so you can spend less time stressing and more time cooking. It’s like having a personal kitchen assistant, right in your pocket, inspiring you to eat better and save time each day.
KEY FEATURES:
• Save Recipes from Anywhere: Import recipes from any website or social platform (yes, even Instagram and TikTok) with a tap. RecipeBox strips out the clutter and saves just the recipe, so you can focus on cooking.
• Smart Grocery List & Shopping: Instantly turn recipes into a grocery list. Our smart list generator groups items by aisle and recipe. With one more tap, send your list to Walmart, Instacart, Kroger, H-E-B, AmazonFresh, and other partners for pickup or delivery – seamless grocery shopping from within the app.
• Meal Planner: Plan your meals for the week or month. Schedule recipes to your in-app calendar and build meal plans that suit your lifestyle. RecipeBox helps you balance what’s for dinner each night and even suggests meals based on ingredients you have.
• Organize Your Recipe Collection: Categorize recipes into custom collections (by cuisine, occasion, diet, etc.) – like your personal digital cookbook. Whether it’s family secrets or new Pinterest finds, keep everything neatly sorted and searchable.
• Discover & Search 2M+ Recipes: Need inspiration? Search over 2,000,000 recipes by keyword or ingredient to find your next favorite dish. Filter results by dietary preference (healthy, vegan, keto, and more) to find exactly what you’re craving.
Why RecipeBox? We’re built for home cooks who want to simplify meal planning and keep all their recipe inspiration in one place. RecipeBox helps you turn “What’s for dinner?” into an organized plan with a curated grocery list – making home cooking easier, healthier, and more fun.
Download RecipeBox for free and start saving recipes today. Your kitchen adventures are about to get a lot simpler!

bluejetty:00175617:ios.description:
Blokus is a fun board game to play with both your friends online or with computer AI locally.
Instruction:
1. Select a piece you want to place on the board; The larger the piece, the more points you earn!
2. For the first piece, you need to touch the starting point of your color on the board; For later pieces, you need to connect with previous piece ONLY with corners, no edge touch!
3. Try to place as many pieces (and points) on the board, while limit your component space so your component has no room to place pieces!
The AI difficulty will increase as you play better! 
You have to win 2 consecutive games to proceed to the next level!
Think hard to beat the AI!
To play with your friends or anyone else online, you need to sign in GameCenter using your AppID, then choose to start online game.
For online games, place your first piece to start the matching process, or join games started by others.
Have fun!

bluejetty:00114876:ios.description:
Your Voice, Reimagined: Step Into the Multiverse.
Discover VoiceWave AI, the AI voice generator and voice transformer built for creators and anime fans. Ever imagined your lines spoken by a legendary hero, a mysterious rival, or an iconic villain? Or need studio-quality character voiceovers without hiring a voice actor? VoiceWave AI redefines your sound and lets you step into any character you can imagine.
At the heart of VoiceWave AI is a text-to-speech engine built for character expression. Type your script and our AI brings it to life in a rich, natural, character-inspired voice. From a single line to full narration, every generation preserves emotion, pacing, and personality so the result feels alive, not robotic. Support for 12 languages and 10 distinct voice styles means your creative range has no limits.
KEY FEATURES
- Infinite Character Library: A growing collection of character-inspired voices, from heroic shonen leads and cool anti-heroes to playful companions and menacing overlords, updated daily with new additions.
- Text to Speech, Perfected: Type any line and generate clean, expressive character audio in seconds, from a one-line quip to a multi-paragraph script, with tone and emotion kept consistent throughout.
- Multiple Languages: Generate character speech in 12 languages for dubbing, localization, or creative projects. Switch seamlessly without losing personality.
- Record to Morph: Record your voice and transform it into any character you choose, preserving your timing and emotion. The AI captures the nuances that make each character recognizable.
- Studio-Quality Audio: Cutting-edge AI delivers crisp, lifelike results ready for any project, from TikTok edits to professional narration.
- Privacy First: Processing is secure and your recordings are never retained without your permission.
FOR CONTENT CREATORS
Dub anime edits with character-accurate voiceovers. Produce narration for YouTube, Shorts, Reels, and fan dubs without voice talent. Create original skits or full-length voice dramas with multiple characters. Export and drop directly into your editing timeline.
FOR FANS AND SOCIAL
Surprise friends on Discord, WhatsApp, or iMessage with personalized voice gags and in-character messages. Birthday greetings from their favorite hero, squad roasts in villain voice, or everyday chaos in your group chats.
FOR GAMERS AND STREAMERS
Bring an RPG persona, villain arc, or kawaii sidekick into Discord lobbies, Twitch streams, and party chat. Switch voices mid-game, roleplay with your audience, and make every session unforgettable.
CLONE YOUR OWN VOICE
Record a short sample to craft a personalized voice that can speak any text you write. Create fun voiceovers for storytelling, build an original character, or produce unique audio for your next project.
AI AUDIO ENHANCEMENT
Upload any audio file and our AI refines it to studio standards, removing background noise, muffled dialogue, and uneven tones for crystal-clear clarity.
WHY VOICEWAVE AI
- Unmatched Selection: A library of heroes, rivals, and villains across every genre that grows daily.
- Cost-Effective: One app replaces traditional voiceover services and audio editing tools.
- Continuous Updates: New character styles added constantly based on community demand.
- User-Centric: Built for creators, gamers, cosplayers, and beginners alike.
DOWNLOAD VOICEWAVE AI TODAY
Step into the future of voice transformation. Fun character voiceovers or professional-grade audio, VoiceWave AI is your all-in-one solution.
DISCLAIMER
VoiceWave AI generates original, character-inspired AI voices and does not replicate any real person or licensed character. For entertainment and creative use. Use responsibly and respect intellectual property.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.easeus.com/privacy.htm

bluejetty:00099193:android.description:
Looking for an all-in-one PDF reader, PDF viewer and document tool for your Android phone?
All PDF Reader & PDF Viewer is a smart, fast, and easy-to-use app that helps you read, edit, convert files, scan documents, and manage PDF files in one mobile solution.
Whether you need to open Word, Docx, Excel, view photos, scan paper receipts with your camera, or merge PDF documents, this app works as a PDF reader, PDF editor, PDF converter, and PDF scanner in one place.
🔑 Key Features
📘 PDF Reader & PDF Viewer
• Fast and smooth PDF reading experience
• Open and view PDF, doc, docx, word, excel, image, or photo files
• Smart zoom, page search, page jump, and easy navigation
• Light & dark mode switch for comfortable reading
• Offline access – read PDF files anytime
• Reliable performance for large documents
Enjoy a practical PDF reader designed for fast reading and easy access.
🛠️ PDF Editor & Annotator
• Highlight, underline, strike text while reading
• Draw and add notes directly to PDF documents
• Edit PDF files easily
• Set password to protect important documents
This is more than a viewer — it’s a complete PDF editor for daily editing needs.
🔄 PDF Converter & PDF Maker
• Convert PDF to images and image to PDF
• Convert PDF files from Word, Docx, Excel, and photos
• Manage document formats in one place
• Convert and share files easily
📂 File Manager & Document Management
• Built-in file manager to organize documents
• Merge or split PDF pages
• Rename, delete, search, and share files
• Manage PDF, Word, Excel, Docx, and images
• Scan documents from your device
• Set favorites for important documents.
Keep your files organized with a file manager designed for efficient document access.
📷 PDF Scanner – Camera to PDF
• Scan paper documents, cards, notes, and books
• Use your phone camera to create PDF files
• Mobile scanner with image processing
• Turn photos into PDF
A practical PDF scanner for work, study, and daily tasks.
💡 Why Choose All PDF Reader & PDF Viewer?
💯 Advanced PDF reader and viewer with fast loading and zoom support
💯 Complete PDF editor, converter, and scanner
💯 Easy document management
💯 Merge, edit, and convert in one tool
💯 Easy-to-use interface
💯 Offline reading and password support
💯 Designed for Android devices
Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who works with PDF documents, Word files, Excel sheets, photos, and scanned paper files daily.
🚀 Download PDF Reader & PDF Viewer now to read, edit, scan, convert PDF files, and manage documents anytime, anywhere.
Your smart PDF reader, PDF editor, PDF converter & file manager — all in one app.

bluejetty:00165027:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00165027:ios.description:
►DON’T BURST MY BUBBLE
Well actually… In this delightful puzzle game, that’s exactly what you’ll be doing! The goal here is to pop all the colorful balloons and clear the playing field, thus allowing your own bubble of happiness to remain intact and, who knows, maybe even get stronger. Each level offers you different goals and obstacles that you’ll need to clear to solve the puzzle, so you’ll never get bored of having to repeat the same motions over and over again.
Because really, who doesn’t love colorful balloons and making things go pop? This game has it all, from great rewards, unique levels and fun graphics - so sit back, relax, and have a blast popping balls left, right, and center in this fun, idle game that is jam packed with sweet features.
►POP IT REAL GOOD
• Practically endless fun – ready, aim, and blast away across nearly 300 bright and exciting levels! This puzzle bubble game not only has dozens upon dozens of unique levels for you to attempt, but there are also all sorts of different objectives in each level to really keep things interesting and engaging. From strategic challenges to time-based tasks, you’ll never run out of puzzles to pop.
• Don’t worry, be happy – each new level brings new objectives and different obstacles that you’ll have to work to overcome, thus keeping you on your toes. Your mind will stay sharp as you work to pop the balls and balloons – but don’t worry, you’ll still be able to relax and chill out. Thanks to punchy graphics, fun themes, and mental engagement you’ll walk away feeling like you used your time well as a professional bubble popper.
• Keeping it cool – To help you solve all those levels, we’ve created tons of fun boosters that will get you flying through puzzles and blasting balls and sweets! Plus, in addition to the boosters, there are chests and other useful rewards that will enhance your gaming experience. Despite the pressure to complete levels, you’ll soon find yourself entering a balloon popping zen state of relaxation – even better, you can play without being conned to the internet for the true relaxing experience!
►LET’S GET IT POPPING
So get the ball rolling (or popping) and come test out both your aim and your wits with this delightful bubble puzzle! Feast your eyes on the delightful graphics and enjoy a moment of relaxing downtime as you attempt exciting levels, all without being tied down to an internet connection. 
Download now to pop and blast your stress away! 
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00015244:ios.description:
Freddi Fish 3: The Case of the Stolen Conch Shell
Freddi and Luther have arrived at the Founder’s day festival but the celebrations have come to a halt because Luther’s Uncle Blenny, the Grand Exalted Keeper of the Conch, stands accused for it’s disappearance. 
Who is the real culprit? Dive into another case with our favorite Junior Detectives are we solve the Case of the stolen Conch Shell. 
—User Reviews— 
“This is a superb beginning computer game for ages 4 to 8. A lot of thinking (outside the box!), problem-solving and decision-making.” 
“This game is one of our favorite Humongous games. It is challenging, yet fun. Once you solve the mystery, they will change the locations of the items that you have to find, so it’s not mundane.”
FEATURES:
• Explore the underwater festival as Freddi and Luther in a title that changes at the start of each new game, giving a fresh new experience each time.
• Every location is filled with wonders, a touch and who knows what will appear, with over 500 secret touchscreen points there’s a new surprise every time you play.
• Fun music mini-games keep things lively for you and your child.
• Many new characters to interact with.
This product uses ScummVM which is released under the GNU GPL v2. 
For more information, please visit - https://www.scummvm.org 
The GNU GPL can be viewed here - https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

bluejetty:00120590:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Spanish.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Spanish empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Spanish required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Spanish the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Spanish so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in spain.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Spanish.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!

bluejetty:00152907:ios.description:
Boba Sort Puzzle – A Sweet & Soothing Bubble Tea Sorting Game
Did you know?
Watching bouncy pearls swirl inside bubble tea can be relaxing on its own.
It lifts your mood, eases stress, and helps you focus without pressure.
Now, that calming bubble tea moment is right at your fingertips.
Boba Sort Puzzle is a cute, relaxing, and completely free sorting puzzle game.
No more pouring water—this time, you’re crafting colorful, dreamy bubble tea!
Swipe to pour pearl milk tea between cups and sort the pearls by color.
Your goal is simple: create perfect cups filled with one single color of pearls.
With thousands of levels to enjoy, it’s the perfect mix of sweet, relaxing, and brain-teasing fun.
How to Play
Easy to learn and endlessly satisfying—perfect for bubble tea lovers and puzzle fans!
• Open your tea shop and sort mixed pearl tea into the correct cups
• Swipe to pour: tap one cup, then another
• Only matching colors can be poured together
• Complete each cup with one color of pearl tea to win
Game Features
• A fully immersive bubble tea experience
Enjoy soothing pearl sounds and smooth, satisfying pouring animations.
• Helpful power-ups when you’re stuck
Use Time Rewind, +1 Cup, and other tools to solve tricky levels.
• A true stress-free brain spa
Simple controls, calming music, and relaxing visuals make it perfect after work or school.
• Light yet rewarding brain training
Improve logic, focus, and spatial thinking in a cozy, pressure-free way.
Why You’ll Love Boba Sort Puzzle
• Instant mood booster
Colorful pearls and cute art bring joy at first glance.
• Easy focus and flow
Get absorbed in bubble tea bliss and let stress melt away.
• Gentle brain workout
Challenge your mind without ever feeling overwhelmed.
• Fun rewards to collect
Unlock new cups and backgrounds as you clear more levels.
Download Boba Sort Puzzle for FREE and run your own bubble tea shop!
Sort the bouncy pearls, brew perfect drinks, and become the ultimate Boba Brew Master in one of the most relaxing and satisfying sorting games.

bluejetty:00077595:ios.description:
Physical therapy exercises for knee, hip, lower back and balance, designed by a Physical Therapist with 25+ years of experience.
Trusted by Thousands for Recovery
- 68% of people stay committed to their daily exercises
- Helping people before and after surgery
- Direct chat with licensed Physical Therapists
NEW in Curovate
- Core stabilization program for lower back pain
- MPFL recovery program for kneecap stability
- Standing balance test using just your phone
- Redesigned, easier-to-use home screen
- Improved Achievements page to track your progress
Specialized Programs For:
- ACL Surgery & Injury Recovery
- MPFL Recovery
- Total Knee Replacement
- Knee Osteoarthritis
- Hip Replacement
- Lower Back Pain & Core Stabilization
- Balance Training
- Pre-Surgery Preparation (Prehab)
- Knee & Hip Strengthening
Comprehensive Knee Care, From Injury Through Recovery
Whether you are recovering from an ACL injury, preparing for ACL surgery, or rehabilitating after ACL reconstruction, Curovate provides daily video-guided physical therapy exercises rooted in published rehabilitation protocols. Our MPFL program guides you through recovery after kneecap dislocation or MPFL reconstruction. Our knee replacement program supports total knee replacement recovery, and our knee osteoarthritis program offers gentle, progressive exercises to manage stiffness and stay active. Measure your knee range of motion at home with no special equipment.
Core Exercises for Lower Back Pain
Our new core stabilization program offers progressive core exercises and back strengthening exercises designed by a licensed Physical Therapist. Build a stronger, more stable core at home with daily video guidance.
Measure and Improve Your Balance
Test your standing balance at home using just your phone, then follow balance training exercises to help you feel steadier and more confident on your feet.
Before Surgery: Preparation Matters
Preparing for a procedure? Curovate offers dedicated prehab programs before ACL surgery, knee replacement and hip replacement. Building strength and range of motion before surgery may help you feel more prepared. Always follow the instructions of your surgeon and care team.
Hip Replacement & Strengthening
Recovering from a hip replacement, or want stronger hips and knees without surgery? Curovate guides you through gentle, progressive exercises with daily structure and reminders to keep you consistent.
Everything You Need to Recover
- Professional video exercises from licensed Physical Therapists
- Personalized program based on a short starting questionnaire
- Knee range of motion and standing balance measurement
- Chat with a licensed Physical Therapist
- Achievements, progress charts and adherence tracking
Your Recovery Journey
1. Answer a few questions to find your starting stage
2. Follow daily guided exercises
3. Track your range of motion and progress
4. Connect with a Physical Therapist when needed
5. Return to the activities you love
Real Recovery Stories
"Excellent guide and progressive treatment plan for recovery from knee replacement." - App Store Review
"Thanks to Curovate I am making progress" - App Store Review
"The PT is very responsive in answering my questions" - App Store Review
A Note on Your Care
Curovate is designed to support, not replace, care from your healthcare providers. Please consult your surgeon or physical therapist before starting any exercise program, especially after surgery.
Subscription Plans
Every program includes 5 days of full access before choosing a plan:
- Monthly Plan: $12.99 USD
- Annual Plan: $45.99 USD (Save 70%)
Subscription Information
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings
Privacy: https://curovate.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms: https://curovate.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00165903:ios.name: Web Messenger for Dual Chat
bluejetty:00165903:ios.summary: Web Messenger is an advanced browser with some most essential capabilities, such as Desktop View. Web Messenger App allows you to browse web in desktop view, which comes handy for using/debugging websites that are only available for desktop
bluejetty:00165903:ios.description:
Web Messenger is an advanced browser with some most essential capabilities, such as Desktop View. Web Messenger App allows you to browse web in desktop view, which comes handy for using/debugging websites that are only available for desktops.
Changing user agent also allow users to access third-party applications' web offerings. Which are normally not usable on mobile browsers, by just enabling the desktop view (enabled in default) you can simply use them as you are in a Desktop! 
Web Messenger is an in-app browser that allows users to access some developer features. Such as changing the headers and cookies that are being sent to the websites with each request. And directly to manage the browsers storage functionality both cookies and the local storage of it. Also it allows you to change your User-Agent, actually in default it is changed to Desktop user agent so that when you are browsing, you are seen as a Desktop and the website gives you it's desktop view rather than the mobile one.
By also altering the Headers and Cookies, you may transfer your sessions, or test your websites/webAPI's functionalities in different use cases. For both cookies and headers, it is supported to Deactivate them rather than Deleting and Re-creating between your test cases.
Several advanced features such as View Port manipulation also available over the settings. For anything you can think of please approach us using the Contact Us button in the Settings Page. And don't forget to share your thoughts on the App Store.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are accessible over the Settings page also during a purchase. If you have already subscribed, please tap the Restore Purchases button in the Settings Page. Premium removes all the limits and allows unlimited usage. To cancel it please go to the App Store App, Tap Your Profile Icon at the top-right, go to subscriptions and find the one for this app and tap Cancel.
LEGAL DISCLAIMER: This application is not endorsed by or affiliated with WhatsApp Inc. WhatsApp Messenger, WhatsApp Web, Meta Inc., Telegram LLC. Telegram, its name, trademark, and other aspects of the app are trademarked and owned by their respective owners.
Read more about our terms, conditions, and privacy here:
• Visit our Privacy Policy at: https://dualbrowser.iosapp.mobi/dualbrowser/privacy.html
• View our Terms of Service at: https://dualbrowser.iosapp.mobi/dualbrowser/terms.html

bluejetty:00081148:ios.name: Reading Log Bookshelf Tracker
bluejetty:00081148:ios.summary: RLT is the ultimate app for book lovers! RLT is your go-to reading tracker app, designed to help you keep track of your reading journey with ease. Whether you’re a casual reader or a voracious bookworm, RLT has all the features you need to
bluejetty:00081148:ios.description:
RLT is the ultimate app for book lovers! RLT is your go-to reading tracker app, designed to help you keep track of your reading journey with ease. Whether you’re a casual reader or a voracious bookworm, RLT has all the features you need to enhance your reading experience. Say goodbye to messy notebooks and hello to a seamless, ad-free reading tracking experience!
Key Features:
1. Add Books Easily
With RLT, adding books to your reading list is a breeze. Choose from three convenient methods:
Online Search: Quickly find and add books by searching online. Just type in the title or author, and we’ll do the rest!
ISBN Scan: Use your device’s camera to scan the ISBN barcode on your book. RLT will automatically fetch all the book details for you.
Manual Entry: Prefer to enter details yourself? No problem! Manually input book titles, authors, genres, and more to keep your library up-to-date.
2.Reading Timer
Track your reading time effortlessly with our built-in reading timer. Simply start the timer when you begin reading and stop it when you’re done. This feature helps you understand your reading habits and make the most of your reading sessions.
3. Log Reading Sessions
Keep a detailed log of all your reading sessions. RLT allows you to record the date, time, duration, and pages read for each session. This way, you can monitor your progress and stay motivated to reach your reading goals.
4. Add Notes to Books
Enhance your reading experience by adding notes to your books. Jot down your thoughts, favorite quotes, and important points as you read. Your notes are saved with the book, making it easy to revisit them whenever you like.
5. View Reading History
Curious about your reading journey? RLT provides a comprehensive view of your reading history. See all the books you’ve read, the time spent on each book, and the progress you’ve made. Relive your reading adventures and celebrate your achievements!
6. Tons of Reading Stats
RLT offers a plethora of statistics to give you insights into your reading habits. Track the number of books read, total reading time, average reading speed, and more. Our detailed stats help you understand your reading patterns and improve your efficiency.
Why Choose RLT?
1. Ad-Free Experience

bluejetty:00174179:ios.description:
Kickstart your journey to health and happiness with Radiance, a home fitness, meal planning, and balance app. With guidance from 4 world-class trainers, from dynamic cardio to Pilates and dance workout - Radiance makes it easy and fun to achieve your fitness goals, because why settle for boring workouts? Whether you're looking to lose weight, build strength, tone your body, boost energy, or simply live a healthier lifestyle, Radiance has a plan for you! 
What's inside the app? 
HOME FITNESS, PILATES AND TRAINING PLANS 
No matter your fitness level or schedule, we offer various home workouts: from Pilates, strength with cardio training, walking and high-energy dance workout, functional training, and more home exercises. 
- On-demand workouts: home fitness, including dance workouts & Pilates, perfect for busy women! Access short, intense workouts that deliver results. 
- At home exercises: no gym? No problem! Enjoy flexible, fun workouts that require minimal equipment. 
- Functional and strength training: innovative training plans designed to enhance both strength and mobility, promoting a balanced, healthy body. 
- Walking & dance workouts: exercises that combine fun and fitness, and make it easy to stay motivated and active, help relieve stress and boost your mood. 
- Beginner-friendly Pilates: accessible home Pilates workouts designed for consistency and progress at your own pace. 
MEAL PLANNING & NUTRITION SUPPORT 
Eating healthy made easy! Enjoy customized meal plans and an extensive Cookbook to meet your nutrition & protein goals. 
- Personalized meal plans: classic, vegetarian, protein, and vegan options. 
- Macronutrient breakdown: make informed food choices that support your fitness and weight loss goals. 
- Easy meal planning: customize your meal plan and create quick grocery lists to make cooking enjoyable. 
- Cookbook: over 300 healthy, easy-to-make recipes, all categorized for convenient meal planning.
- Innovative GLP-1 meal plan designed to support your weight loss journey. Did you know strength training and a protein diet are keys to your success?
BALANCE & MINDFULNESS 
Radiance isn’t just about fitness, nutrition, and diet - it’s about holistic well-being. That’s why we’ve added a robust Balance section to help you relax, de-stress, and get better sleep. 
- Extensive mindfulness content: 5 categories, including guided meditations, calming sleep stories, and even facial yoga, all designed to improve your well-being. 
- Sleep support: struggling with sleep? Unwind and relax with soothing home exercises.
- Holistic wellness: mental and emotional support you need to stay inspired and motivated. 
Radiance follows well known worldwide health publications rules to propose a healthy diet plan. More info about diet guidelines can be found on our website: https://joinradiance.com/info 
This app provides users with extensive features, including workouts, meal plans, Balance and more, all of which require an active subscription. Users are required to make payments to have access to these exclusive features that are designed to enhance your fitness journey seamlessly. 
Payments for access to the application will be auto-renewed if it is not turned off at least 24 hours before the current period. The account will be debited at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Users can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in the app’s settings. 
Radiance provides diet plans that cannot be taken as a medical diagnosis. If you wish to get a medical diagnosis, please contact your nearest medical center. 
Terms of service / Terms of use: https://app.joinradiance.com/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://app.joinradiance.com/privacy-policy

Direct your ideas with AI agents. Take full control of your videos and edit collaboratively with your team on a professional grade timeline editor. Generate images, video, voice, sound and music with 200+ AI models—all in invideo.

YOU DIRECT. AI AGENTS EDIT.
Tell Agent Two what you want to create or change. Develop your idea into a video, shape a scene or refine an existing edit through everyday language.
Guide the story, pacing, visuals and sound as the project takes shape. Keep directing until the result feels right.

Keep creative direction, review and editing connected as your project moves toward its final cut.

bluejetty:00126857:ios.description:
SEM Mobile te permite usar el estacionamiento medido en cualquier municipio asociado, todo desde una misma app. Cada ciudad tiene sus propios usuarios y vos podés cambiar de municipio cuando lo necesites, sin instalar nada nuevo.
Mejoramos la app para que administrar tu estacionamiento sea más rápido y tengas toda la información a tu alcance. Vas a poder cargar crédito para el estacionamiento o pagar infracciones a través de una conexión segura que respeta la privacidad de tus datos. Además, podés pagar escaneando el código QR del cartel que encontrás en la calle, sin necesidad de tener la app instalada.
También vas a tener todas las vías de contacto con el centro de atención de estacionamiento medido y la información de las redes sociales de tu ciudad.
Descargá la app y registrate fácilmente desde tu smartphone, o actualizá tu app y volvé a ingresar con tu usuario y contraseña de siempre.
Si las ciudades evolucionan y mejoran, ¿por qué nosotros no íbamos a hacerlo?
Como siempre, tus comentarios y sugerencias son bienvenidos.

bluejetty:00077365:ios.description:
The town of Moonbury has always been wary of the outside world's medical advances, preferring to rely on its traditional healing methods. However, when the mayor's daughter falls ill and the local witch doctor can do nothing to help her, they are forced to look outside their small community for help. The Medical Association decides to send their most accomplished chemist - you - to help cure the mayor's daughter and convince the residents of Moonbury of the wonders of modern alchemy.
Gain their trust and tend to each person when they fall ill in this open-ended sim RPG!
FEATURES
- Take care of Moonbury’s inhabitants: diagnose their illnesses, gather ingredients and brew potions to cure them.
- Heal the town : Upgrade buildings, expand your gathering area and transform the townsfolk’ lives in many ways.
- Build relationships with Moonbury’s inhabitants, earn their trust and eventually find love with your chosen sweetheart! 
- Team up with your loyal dog that follows you wherever you go and helps you in your work.
- Relax in a wholesome, colourful world and live the apothecary life you want!
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 15 Optimization (including pro max)
If you run into a problem, please contact us at https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/12-playdigious/ with as much information as possible on the issue.

bluejetty:00031816:ios.description:
Martie offers deals up to 80% OFF your favorite brands like Momofuku, Stumptown Coffee, Hydroflask, Supergoop!, Purely Elizabeth and thousands more! 
With 250+ new deals every week, no two days are the same at Martie. The app makes it easy to get first dibs on the best new deals. Discover something new with Martie!
When you shop at Martie, you're doing more than saving up to 80% on everyday essentials. You're helping lower the environmental impact of excess manufacturing, shipping, and waste. One cart at a time, you’re making a difference! 
How does it work? By sourcing surplus and overstock beauty, home and pantry items directly from top brands, Martie helps customers shop smarter. But Martie shoppers aren’t just looking for deals. They love the thrill of discovery and the impact of shopping sustainably. That makes Martie more than a discount store—it’s a daily destination for smart, conscious shoppers.
You might find packaging updates or a seasonal redesign, forecasting errors or shorter best by dates. Rather than sending great products to waste, brands work with Martie to get amazing products in the hands of smart, sustainability-minded shoppers—like you.
When you shop on the Martie App, you can easily stay up to date on the best deals, get step by step delivery information on your orders, reorder your favorites, and have access to our customer service team with any questions.
Fast Facts:
• Up to 80% off retail price, always
• 250+ new deals launch every week, 5,000+ brands!
• Free shipping for orders $50+
• Fast, easy delivery, right to your door 
• No memberships, subscriptions or commitments
• Save food from going to waste
• Thousands of 5-Star Reviews
• Shoppers save on average $600 a year, by shopping with Martie!
• Featured in Eater, The Strategist, The Cool Down, Kitchn, NBC, ABC & CBS!
Based in sunny California, we are a small team with big ideas. Text us at 213-788-1204 or send us an email to hello@martie.com.

bluejetty:00016203:ios.name: > Tic Tac Toe
bluejetty:00016203:ios.summary:
Tic Tac Toe ⑤ (Five in a Row) is a strategic board game also known as Caro in Vietnam, Omok (오목) in Korea, gomokunarabe (五目並べ) in Japan and wuziqi (五子棋) in China. 
It is the extended version of Tic Tac Toe - you win with 5 pieces in a row
bluejetty:00016203:ios.description:
Tic Tac Toe ⑤ (Five in a Row) is a strategic board game also known as Caro in Vietnam, Omok (오목) in Korea, gomokunarabe (五目並べ) in Japan and wuziqi (五子棋) in China. 
It is the extended version of Tic Tac Toe - you win with 5 pieces in a row instead of 3. The board is 15x15. The game is also sometimes called XO.
Players alternate turns placing X or O on an empty intersection. X makes the first move.
The first player to get an unbroken row of five stones wins the game.
Caro X brings this great game to your iPhone. You can enjoy Caro in family game time, or you can also enjoy the game by playing with the AIs of varying difficulties. Beware that it is very challenging to beat the best AI in this game!
You will also gain experience points by winning against the AIs (+1 for Easy, +3 for Medium, +5 for Hard, and +7 for Expert).
Features:
◆ Undo
◆ Save/load unfinished game
◆ AIs with 4 levels of difficulties
◆ Timer based game
◆ Zoom in and zoom out.
The variation of Five in a Row supported in this game is free-style. A player just needs to make a row of five or more stones to win.

bluejetty:00148836:ios.description:
Love business simulations, tycoon games, and economic strategy? Don't miss RESOURCES! This location-based multiplayer business simulator (GPS, similar to geocaching) combines idle miner mechanics, money games, and tycoon gameplay - perfect for fans who want to make money through strategic empire building!
Start your career as a business tycoon and become the new competition for thousands of players worldwide! Claim resource deposits, build mines, extract materials like in classic idle miner games, and collect lost cargo containing valuable goods! Trade smartly as a savvy manager, sell your products at high prices on global markets, and manufacture premium goods in your factories. Prove yourself as a wealthy industry magnate and make headlines with your mining empire!
GPS-based Business Simulation Features:
- Scan the real world for resources using GPS integration
- Build mines at actual coordinates and develop resource deposits
- Idle miner mechanics - Earn money passively even when offline
- Collect lost cargo containing valuable materials in your area
- Manager game elements - Optimize your production chains strategically
Business Tycoon Gameplay:
- Multiplayer economic simulation with thousands of players worldwide
- Trading system - Trade on global markets like a real capitalist entrepreneur
- Factory management - Process and refine raw materials into luxury goods
- PvP battles - Raid competitors for additional resources and money
- Auctions for rare items and exclusive premium materials
Money Game for Every Playstyle:
- Play relaxed at home or actively go on GPS treasure hunts
- Complex business simulation meets mobile gaming convenience
- Empire building mechanics - Continuously expand your business empire
- Idle game elements ensure constant progress and money generation
- Manager game features for strategic economic planning
RESOURCES combines the best elements of classic tycoon games, idle miner mechanics, and innovative GPS integration. As a business simulator, it offers both casual money games and deep strategic empire building. Whether you're an idle game fan, trading expert, or economic simulation enthusiast - become the ultimate business magnate!
No paywalls, no forced advertisements - fair and competitive even without spending real money!
Start your career as a business tycoon now and dominate global markets in this unique GPS business simulator!

bluejetty:00115749:ios.description:
Discover the True Value of Your Vinyl — Instantly
What if that dusty record in your garage is worth hundreds—or even thousands? VinylSnap makes it easy to find out. With one quick photo, instantly identify your vinyl, get a reliable market price, see grading suggestions, and save it to your collection.
VinylSnap is your go-to vinyl companion, perfect for collectors, resellers, or anyone who just found a box of old LPs in the attic. Try it free and see what your records are really worth!
What Can VinylSnap Do?
- Reliable Market Valuation  
 Get a trusted reference price before you buy, sell, or store—know if you’ve found a $10 album or a $1,000 treasure.
- Instant Identification with Rich Details  
 Scan the label to unlock pressing info, release year, tracklist, and artist stories—works with most 12", 10", and 7" records.
- Grading Suggestions  
 Helpful VG / VG+ / NM guidance based on visible wear, label clarity, and jacket condition—so you can price and sell with confidence.
- Your Digital Vinyl Shelf  
 Save every record you scan and track your collection’s total value over time—see how your vinyl library grows in worth.
- Learn & Explore  
 Read exclusive articles on record-breaking vinyl sales, collector tips, and essential guides for anyone new to vinyl—so you know what to look for and how to protect it.
Who Is VinylSnap For?
 • Beginners  
 Just getting into vinyl? VinylSnap helps you understand what you have and how much it’s worth—no experience needed. 
 • Collectors  
 Build a well-organized vinyl archive, track your investments, and make sure your most valuable pressings are properly graded. 
 • Resellers  
 Use VinylSnap to make fast, informed decisions while crate-digging. Know what to buy, what to list, and what to keep.
Why Choose VinylSnap? 
Accurate — Trusted valuation and grading in seconds  
Effortless — Just scan the label, no manual searching  
Insightful — Background knowledge at your fingertips  
Organized — Manage your entire vinyl library in one clean app
Start Scanning with VinylSnap Today! Download now and discover the value behind every record.

bluejetty:00165411:ios.description:
Curious what your friends appreciate about you?
Peek is a school-based friendship app where you can exchange positive polls with people you already know.
Vote about friends you already know. With your permission, Peek uploads encrypted contact names and phone numbers to find friends, suggest voting choices, and help you invite contacts. Sharing your contacts does not send invitations. Peek will not contact anyone in your contacts without your explicit consent. School polls and school friend lists become available after school verification.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your school and grade
2. Add friends you know; verify your school to access school friends
3. Answer positive polls about your friends
4. Receive Picks when your friends choose you
SEND AND RECEIVE POSITIVE PICKS
- Choose the friend who fits each poll best
- Receive Picks when friends vote for you
- Discover the positive qualities your friends appreciate about you
- Get optional hints about the Picks you receive
JOIN YOUR SCHOOL COMMUNITY
- Participate in positive weekly school polls
- View your school’s community results
- Verify with an approved school email address or student ID
- Connect with verified peers from your school community
PEEK MEMBERSHIP
- Get additional hints about the Picks you receive
- See recent profile visitors
- Earn Double Stars on eligible Picks
Peek is designed to strengthen existing friendships through positive recognition and school community participation.
Download Peek and discover how your friends appreciate you.

bluejetty:00090984:ios.name: Pulse：Emotional resonance
bluejetty:00090984:ios.summary: The Pulse app boasts numerous remarkable advantages. Its fingerprint recognition technology is based on extensive research and optimization, and its accuracy far surpasses that of similar apps. It can interpret your emotional states with re
bluejetty:00090984:ios.description:
The Pulse app boasts numerous remarkable advantages. Its fingerprint recognition technology is based on extensive research and optimization, and its accuracy far surpasses that of similar apps. It can interpret your emotional states with remarkable precision through fingerprint information. Whether you are feeling joy, sadness, calmness or excitement, it can accurately capture these emotions and draw a detailed and precise emotional portrait exclusive to you, enabling you to have a clear and thorough understanding of your inner world. Meanwhile, our algorithm adopts an advanced machine learning model with the ability of self-optimization and learning. As the number of times users use the app increases, the accuracy of state matching will continue to improve, bringing you interpersonal connection recommendations that are more in line with your needs.
Moreover, the Pulse app serves as an innovative interpersonal bridge. It precisely matches users based on their states and recommends people with similar moods among a vast number of users. It focuses on building connections based on emotional resonance rather than other intentions.
For example, during the morning rush hour on a weekday, when you are hurrying to work and unlock your phone with your fingerprint, the Pulse app detects your fatigue and anxiety caused by work pressure and recommends colleagues who are also in the same workplace predicament to you. Then you can share experiences and encourage each other during the lunch break. On a weekend night, when you are feeling sentimental because of a movie, the Pulse app finds those who have the same emotions as you, allowing you to chat freely in the virtual space and dispel loneliness.
Whether you are on your commute, having leisure time in the afternoon, after exercising or during a break from studying, the Pulse app will always be by your side. Each fingerprint scan is like a key to opening a new experience, guiding you to explore the emotional world, helping you harvest sincere friendships and expand your social circle. Open the Pulse app and start a unique journey of spiritual exploration and interpersonal interaction, making your life more wonderful, warmer and full of surprises.

bluejetty:00017156:ios.name: Smurfs' Village
bluejetty:00017156:ios.summary: The evil wizard Gargamel and his ever present cat companion, Azrael, have finally found the Smurfs’ village and have scattered our lovable blue friends far and wide throughout the enchanted forest. Come along with familiar friends, like Pap
bluejetty:00017156:ios.description:
The evil wizard Gargamel and his ever present cat companion, Azrael, have finally found the Smurfs’ village and have scattered our lovable blue friends far and wide throughout the enchanted forest. Come along with familiar friends, like Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey, Greedy and the rest of the Smurf family, as they guide you on a family fun adventure to build a new forest village for the Smurfs to call home.
Based on the beloved classic Saturday morning cartoon, your adventure begins with a single mushroom home and a smurflightful plot of land. Harvest your smurfberries. Build charming huts, special mushroom houses, and beautiful bridges. And decorate your village with colorful gardens, lights, flower chairs, hammocks and more!
Create a Smurf ID for a secure way to add friends, explore and rate villages, and get a chance to become a Featured Village!
------------------------
FEATURES
FAMILY ADVENTURE - Build your very own Smurfs' village and create a new home for the Smurfs.
PLAY WITH YOUR FAVORITE SMURFS - The entire Smurf Family is here! Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Lazy Smurf, Baby Smurf, Handy Smurf, and Jokey Smurf.
HARVEST SMURFBERRIES - Use in-app purchase to speed up the growth of your crops and your blue village
SMURFY MINI-GAMES – While your village is growing, play multiple mini-games like: Greedy Smurf’s Baking Game, Papa Smurf’s Potion Mixing Game, Painter Smurf’s Painting Game, Lazy Smurf's Fishin' Game and a new free Handy Smurf minigame to unlock additional bonuses.
CONNECT WITH FRIENDS – Share your Smurfs Experience on Facebook and Game Center and send gifts to your friends' villages.
PLAY OFFLINE - Manage your village anytime without having to connect to the internet.
------------------------
USER REVIEWS
Long time love!
"I’ve been playing since 2011 and I still love it all the same. Keep up the good work and thanks for listening to your community!"" -SugarRushCandi
Best Game ever made yet
"We have played the Smurfs' Village for years. With every update, it gets better and better." -Rooroobooboo
Still Smurfing
"Thoroughly enjoyable game. Relaxing, stress free. Simple, smurfy fun. I’ve been playing for years. Love it." -islanduder
All ages! Three generations in my family play Smurfs' Village and LOVE it. Easy for kids, interesting for adults. To the Developers: Very Well Done!" -Turbo444
------------------------
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SmurfsVillage
Follow us on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GCGGardenCityGames
------------------------

bluejetty:00160049:ios.description:
Threaded Color: Cozy Knit Art
Looking for a relaxing coloring game as warm and comforting as your favorite handmade sweater? 
Welcome to Threaded Color — where digital art meets the tactile beauty of textiles. We’ve reimagined the classic color by number experience by replacing flat, lifeless pixels with high-definition knitted textures, delicate yarn patterns, and cozy handcrafted aesthetics.
Every tap is more than simply adding paint to a picture — it feels like weaving a surreal piece of art with your own hands.
Why Choose Threaded Color Instead of Ordinary Coloring Games?
Have you ever felt that other coloring games are:
- Repetitive — the same flowers and patterns over and over again.
- Flat and lifeless — lacking depth, texture, and personality.
- Overcomplicated — cluttered interfaces that create stress instead of relaxation and leisure.
Threaded Color is different.
 We focus on the beauty of cozy living aesthetics, creating a world filled with rich 3D textile textures and comforting handcrafted details. Completing each artwork delivers an incredibly satisfying sensory experience — like a relaxing visual ASMR moment for your mind. 
Features You'll Fall in Love With
 Realistic Knit Textures You Can Almost Feel
 Experience a whole new level of tactile-inspired coloring art with:
Classic cable knit patterns — beautifully layered woven textures.
Soft wool fibers — detailed fuzzy yarn effects that add warmth and depth.
Handcrafted artistic styles — inspired by real knitting and crochet art.
 Comforting & Heartwarming Themes
 Escape the noise of everyday life and step into a cozy little world inside this relaxing coloring book:
Cozy companions — scarf-wearing kittens, fluffy bears, and adorable woodland friends.
Slow living spaces — winter cabins, woven baskets, and sunlit cozy rooms.
Seasonal wreaths — unique floral artworks blended with soft yarn textures.
 The Ultimate Stress Relief Experience
 Designed to become your perfect evening leisure ritual:
Easy and relaxing — simply follow the numbers in our color by number gameplay. No artistic skills needed.
Mindful coloring — no timers, no rankings, no pressure.
Perfect before bedtime — gently clear your mind and relax into a peaceful night.
Perfect For Adult Players Who Love:
Knitting & crochet culture — ideal for yarn lovers and handmade art enthusiasts.
Calm and peaceful escapes — unwind after a long day with soothing coloring games.
Cozy aesthetic games & art styles — inspired by comforting vibes similar to Animal Crossing: New Horizons and Unpacking.
Premium artistic experiences — for adult players looking for something more textured, immersive, surreal, and visually unique.
Step into a world of warmth, texture, and creativity.
 Download Threaded Color today and begin your cozy knitting-inspired color by number journey. 
Subscription pricing and terms：
The app does not currently have a subscription.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy please go to the following link:
Terms of Use:
https://home.xlearning.group/terms_of_services.html
Privacy Policy:
https://home.xlearning.group/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00168500:ios.name: VERTICAL GAMES - OFFLINE GAMES
bluejetty:00168500:ios.summary: Introducing "No Wifi Games: Offline Games," your ultimate gaming companion that guarantees endless entertainment without the need for an internet connection. This meticulously designed app is a treasure trove of engaging mini-games, each of
bluejetty:00168500:ios.description:
Introducing "No Wifi Games: Offline Games," your ultimate gaming companion that guarantees endless entertainment without the need for an internet connection. This meticulously designed app is a treasure trove of engaging mini-games, each offering a unique challenge and hours of free gameplay to keep you entertained anywhere, anytime.
At the heart of our collection is the nostalgic "Flappy Bird," where precision and timing are key as you navigate a charming bird through treacherous obstacles. The simplicity of this game, combined with its addictive nature, provides a delightful challenge that harks back to the golden era of arcade games.
For dinosaur enthusiasts, "Dino Run" and "Dino Rise" offer thrilling escapades. In "Dino Run," you'll find yourself in a prehistoric world, dashing through deserts and dodging obstacles in a race against extinction. "Dino Rise," on the other hand, adds a vertical twist as you leap from platform to platform, ascending to new heights while avoiding perilous falls and collecting power-ups to aid your journey.
For those who enjoy a mental challenge, "2048" is a numbers game that combines logic, strategy, and a bit of luck. The goal is to slide numbered tiles on a grid to combine them and create a tile with the number 2048. It's a brain teaser that will test your mathematical prowess and strategic thinking.
"Ski Fun" brings a touch of winter sports to your fingertips. Swiftly navigate through snowy slopes, dodging obstacles and collecting bonuses. The crisp graphics and smooth controls make for an exhilarating experience that captures the thrill of skiing.
One of the standout features of "No Wifi Games: Offline Games" is the inclusion of real-time leaderboards. Even when playing offline, your scores are recorded and updated the next time you connect to the internet. This adds a competitive edge, allowing you to challenge friends and players from around the globe, striving to top the leaderboards in each game.
The beauty of these games lies in their accessibility. No wifi? No problem. Each game within "No Wifi Games: Offline Games" is designed to be played offline, ensuring that your gaming experience is never interrupted. Whether you're on a long flight, in a remote location, or simply looking to conserve data, these games are always at your fingertips, ready to entertain.
The app's intuitive design makes it easy to switch between games, offering a seamless gaming experience. With vibrant graphics, responsive controls, and captivating gameplay, each mini-game is crafted to provide hours of enjoyment.
In summary, "No Wifi Games: Offline Games" is more than just a game; it's a collection of experiences designed to bring joy, challenge, and excitement into your life, no internet required. Dive into this world of offline gaming where adventure awaits at every turn, and become a part of a global community of gamers who relish the joy of simple, yet immensely satisfying gameplay. Join us in this journey and let the games begin!

bluejetty:00186087:ios.description:
USCIS: Civics Test Study Tools is an official application of the Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), designed to help you study for the civics test portion of the naturalization interview. 
The Department of Homeland Security’s (DHS) U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Civics Test Study Tools application is an additional resource to study for the civics portion of the U.S. naturalization test. The application is currently available in English and Spanish. You can take a practice civics test to see if you can pass this exercise. (The actual civics test is not a multiple choice test. It is an oral test. You must answer correctly 6 of 10 questions to pass the actual civics test.) Or, try the Question Challenge game to see how many questions you can answer correctly in a row. The application will show your high score. All of the 100 official civics test questions and answers are available to help you prepare for the actual civics test.
FEATURES:
• English audio for questions
• Spanish audio for questions
• Option to change entire application to Spanish at any time
• Official list of 100 civics questions and answers for the U.S. naturalization test
• Challenge game to see how many questions you can get correct in a row

bluejetty:00034102:ios.description:
TransLoc is your personal assistant for getting to work on time, spending the day running errands or hopping around campus for classes. TransLoc is the only app with public transit options, a trip planner, ride-sharing and bus schedules.
Not sure how to get from point A to point B? No problem! Use the trip planner to find the best public transit routes, times and services to fit your schedule. You can even favorite the bus stops you use the most to always have arrival predictions at your fingertips.
Wondering if you have time to grab a coffee before getting on the bus? With TransLoc, you’ve also got access to scheduled and estimated arrival times…perfect for those mornings when a 5-minute coffee run is essential.
Where available, you can even bring the bus stop to you! TransLoc connects you to nearby ride-sharing services offered by your city or campus. Best of all, it’s cheaper than most private ride-hailing apps! Get to where you want to go for less than the other apps want you to pay.
ALL YOU NEED TO GET AROUND
• Quick access to the transit options nearest you
• Stay in the know with scheduled and estimated arrival times
• You can even pay with TransLoc (where available)
CHEAPER RIDESHARING
• Enjoy the same ride-sharing experience you’re used to at a price that’s about the same as a bus ticket
GET TO YOUR DESTINATION SAFELY
• TransLoc makes it easier to find and use public transit options near you
• Your city or campus runs the microtransit and ridesharing services, which are easy to spot and safe to ride on
BETTER & SMARTER
• Your TransLoc app is constantly updated with great features and enhancements.
• We’d love to hear your ideas on how to make the TransLoc app even better. Just use the feedback option within the app.

bluejetty:00026163:ios.summary:

Bus travellers can buy, gift, and activate
bluejetty:00026163:ios.description:
Plan your journey, track your bus, and travel with confidence using the First Bus app. With real-time updates, mobile tickets, and personalised tools, getting around by bus has never been easier. 
Bus travellers can buy, gift, and activate digital bus tickets, manage secure payments, and save favourite locations, stops, and services for quicker access. The app also supports account management, consent management, while providing access to help and support features. 
Whether you’re commuting, exploring, or travelling occasionally, the app helps you stay in control from door to door. 
Planning your journey 
Find the best routes using locations, stops, or service numbers. View routes, timings, and stop information to plan trips that suit you. 
Live Bus tracking 
See your bus in real time on an interactive map and get more accurate arrival estimates. This feature helps reduce waiting uncertainty, improves journey planning, and enables users to make informed travel decisions by knowing exactly where their bus is at any moment. 
Departure Board 
Check upcoming services for either your stop or route, with clear timings and filtering (such as First Bus only) options. The time and dates can also be easily adjusted for future travel plans. 
Favourites
Save your most-used stops, locations, and bus services for quick access every time you travel. 
Buying 
Buy, gift, and activate digital tickets directly in the app with a variety of filters. Secure payments and instant access mean no paper tickets needed. Tickets appear instantly ready to use in your account. 
Gifting 
Send tickets to friends or family quickly and easily. During the ticket buying flow, users can choose to gift a ticket instead of using it themselves, enter recipient details, and complete the purchase securely. 
Activating Tickets 
Activate your ticket in the First Bus app when you’re ready to travel. Once activated, it clearly shows its status and validity, making it quick and easy to present when boarding the bus. 
Account and Payments 
The First Bus app lets users securely manage their account and payment details in one place. Users can sign up, sign in, and reset their password if needed, as well as view and update their personal information and account settings. They can also choose to delete their account if required. 
Within the app, users can manage saved payment cards, set a default payment method, and remove cards at any time. All payment information is handled securely, helping ensure a smooth, safe, and convenient ticket purchasing experience. 
Preferences 
Choose your region, set walking distance preferences, and manage consent and notifications. 
Help and support 
Access FAQs , contacts and support resources in our dedicated help centre.

This app offers a fast and accurate spectrum analysis suitable for both amateur hi-fi enthusiasts and professional A/V engineers. ● Fullscreen mode

bluejetty:00022321:ios.description:
Block Ads: Web Browser Safe is the best ad blocker for Safari app and Ad-Free YTube experience. It will not only remove annoying ads but also secure your privacy with advanced tracking protection and gives users a peaceful and enjoyable web experience.
Have you ever been continually swamped with advertisements, pop-ups, banners, commercial links disguised within content, or auto-play videos that suddenly appear? By blocking annoying ads from the browser you're visiting, Block Ads: Web Browser Safe will rescue you from the persistent discomfort of these ads! It is free to use and does a fantastic job of removing advertisements for Safari.
With Block Ads: Web Browser Safe, you can enjoy a cleaner, faster, and more private browsing experience. Download now and start your web browser no ads!
KEY FEATURES of Block Ads: Web Browser Safe:
- Safari ads blocker.
- Ad-Free YTube 
- Block tracking: Protect your information from being tracked by websites and social media.
- Block ads from specific regions.
- Block adult sites: block 18+ websites.
- Block Sites: Add websites you wish to block.
- Allow List: Allow ads on specific websites.
- Hide Article Comments: Block comments where they aren't the primary focus.
Blocking ads in the Safari browser
Removes all kinds of ads in Safari including banners, pop-ups, video ads and everywhere else. Say goodbye to annoying ads and have a safe experience while surfing on websites.
Ad-Free YTube
It is easy to block all YTube ads: pre-roll video ads, text & banner ads. With Block Ads, you can save time by stopping those useless advertisements.
Privacy protection
Say no to trackers with advanced protection. The web is full of trackers that literally watch your every click. Block Ads: Web Browser Safe additionally blocks tracking sites on the web that collect information about you.
Block ads from specific regions
Block Ads: Web Browser Safe helps you block ads in specific languages such as English, German, Dutch, French, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese,...
Block site for adults
Some websites always appear with weird adult content like porn pop-ups, adult videos, dating apps or other 18+ content. With Block Ads: Web Browser Safe, you can block them entirely and browse without distractions.
Create Block Sites & Allow List
Manually add the website URL to block ads to the Block Sites and build blocking rules according to the actual situation. Block Ads: Web Browser Safe also includes a Allow List, enabling you to add trusted websites and perhaps those you want to support by allowing ads to your exceptions list.
Hide Article Comments
Block or hide the comment sections in articles where they aren't the main focus, allowing you to focus solely on the content.
Download now to make your internet-surfing isn't disruptive.
HOW TO ENABLE Block Ads: Web Browser Safe:
- Download Block Ads: Web Browser Safe in AppStore.
- Proceed to "Safari" browser settings.
- Select "Extensions" then tap "Content Blockers" and turn "ON" all our extensions.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS:
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
- Subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

Privacy policy: https://clever-ai-global.web.app/policy.html

bluejetty:00183065:ios.description:
The coolest game you'll play this year!
An incredibly fun adventure across a floating world, where you fire yourself out of powerful cannons!
Meet Bullet Boy, the courageous kid who rushes to escape a deadly tornado, while he tries to collect the missing pieces of some very mysterious, and fascinating statues.
Packed with highly dynamic mechanics. Avoid birds, buildings and weird machines, tap rapidly to dodge fast-moving obstacles, aim precisely to get to the next cannon, or shoot to the sky to elude multiple obstacles altogether, and quickly get to your goal!
You'll spend hours engaged in the action and the challenge of lots of levels, with randomly generated sections, and exciting progression along the whole game.
Unlock awesome power-ups to increase the fun and the possibilities of blasting your way through this peculiar and beautiful world.
The 7 reasons why you'll love Bullet Boy:
- Incredibly FUN!
- Fast-paced action and super dynamic game mechanics.
- More than 60 beautifully crafted levels.
- Charming 3D graphics and super-engaging soundtrack.
- Hours of challenging and delicious gameplay.
- Three amazing powerups to give a twist to the game mechanics.
- Upcoming updates with more levels, amazing new zones and more gameplay!
Bullet Boy is free to download. Some items in the game are available for purchase.
Download Bullet Boy and have a blast!
For questions and suggestions, please drop us a message to contact@pomelogames.com

bluejetty:00142748:ios.summary:
Learn German with real news and stories at your level, from A1 beginner to C1. A new story every day, tap-to-translate on any word and a quiz on grammar, vocabulary and der, die, das.
Readle teaches German the way you actually use it: by r
bluejetty:00142748:ios.description:
Learn German with real news and stories at your level, from A1 beginner to C1. A new story every day, tap-to-translate on any word and a quiz on grammar, vocabulary and der, die, das.
Readle teaches German the way you actually use it: by reading and listening. Just 5 minutes a day is enough to make steady progress.
HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your level (A1, A2, B1, B2 or C1) and a topic you enjoy.
• Read and listen to the story, recorded by native German speakers.
• Tap any word you don't know to see the English translation and an explanation.
• Check your understanding with a short quiz and save new words as flashcards.
WHAT YOU GET
【 2,000+ German stories and news 】
Real topics from the news, travel, culture, science, technology and more, rewritten for your level. A new story is added every day.
【 Instant dictionary in the text 】
Tap a word for its translation into English and many other languages, without switching apps.
【 Der, die, das and grammar in context 】
More than 170 grammar helpers explain key structures right inside the story. After each story, a quiz practices articles, grammar and vocabulary.
【 Native-speaker audio 】
Every story comes with audio, so you train listening and pronunciation while you read.
【 Flashcards that stick 】
Save words from the stories you like. Spaced repetition brings them back just before you would forget them.
【 Exam preparation 】
Build the reading and vocabulary you need for the Goethe-Zertifikat, telc, DSH and TestDaF.
TOPICS
Latest news (e.g. DW, ZDF, Tagesschau) · Travel and transport · Culture · Food · Entertainment · Science and medicine · Technology · People
WHO IS READLE FOR?
German beginners who want more than flashcards, learners moving to Germany, Austria or Switzerland for work or study, travelers, exam candidates – and anyone who wants to read and understand real German.
Download Readle for free and start your first German story today!
Follow Readle:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ReadleApp
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/readle.german/
Privacy policy: https://readle-app.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://readle-app.com/term-of-use/

Also included are some delight filled games like making the animals dance to and tap sounds where they can make the animals do tricks and change colors. It’s a barn load of fun for everyone!
Flashcards
