Sound Game
Now that your little ones have heard all the sounds and names of the animals they can test their knowledge in a cute and fun way- the sounds game! With 10 different games they can tap on the question mark and hear the sound and then choose which farm animal makes that sound. It’s engaging and fun!
Old McDonald Song
Of course every little farmer loves the Old McDonald song and when they tap on the barn on the main menu they will hear the song with vocals and see every animal the song makes reference to dancing along. It’s a great way to identify each animal as the song is playing, and is entertaining and fun!
Dancing Animals
Now that they have seen the animals dancing along to Old McDonald Had A Farm they can make the animals dance themselves by tapping on them. The really engaging part is the different music that plays with each animal includes the sound that animal makes! Little ones love to dance and the funky and fun music is sure to get them up and moving and dancing along. 
Tap Sounds
Another entertaining game is the tap sounds! Your little farmers can tap the animal and make it do tricks, like all the feathers appearing on a turkey, and a pig doing a flip. They will also see some of the animals change colors to further enhance the learning elements. This game will promote color recognition and is cute sweet fun!
Come to the farm and have a fun and musical time learning and playing with barnyard animals! A perfect app for first time users this engaging trip to the farm will get your little ones excited and knowledgeable about farm animals. Let their imagination and creativity blossom while they play and learn about barnyard animals!

bluejetty:00098522:ios.description:
Heart Beat lets you measure your heart rate using your smartphone camera and keep your wellness records in one place. Check your pulse in beats per minute (BPM), save results, and review your measurement history.
You can also manually log blood pressure, blood oxygen, stress levels, and heart rate variability (HRV) values.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR WELLNESS
Whether you're checking your pulse after exercise or reviewing your previous records, Heart Beat makes it easy to keep your wellness information organized and accessible.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH HEARTBEAT
Heart Rate Measurement
Measure your pulse using your smartphone camera and view your heart rate in BPM.
Pulse History
Save and review previous heart rate measurements.
Blood Pressure Log
Manually enter systolic and diastolic blood pressure readings taken with a separate monitor.
Blood Oxygen Log
Manually enter blood oxygen (SpO2) readings from a separate measurement device.
Stress Level Log
Record your stress levels manually and review previous entries.
HRV Log
Manually enter heart rate variability (HRV) values obtained from other sources.
Heart Health Education
Read general educational information about heart health and cardiovascular symptoms.
Measurement History
Review saved pulse measurements and manually entered wellness records.
Multi-Profile Support
Organize wellness records for up to three users.
YOUR WELLNESS RECORDS IN ONE PLACE
Keep a history of your pulse results alongside manually entered blood pressure, blood oxygen, stress, and HRV values. Heart Beat helps you maintain and review a personal record of your wellness information as part of your daily routine.
KEY FEATURES
Finger-based heart rate measurement using your smartphone camera
View your pulse readings for everyday heart rate tracking
Multi-profile support for up to 3 users
Daily summaries and heart rate measurement history
Manual stress level logging and wellness records
Blood pressure, blood oxygen (SpO2), and HRV logging for easy record keeping
IMPORTANT HEALTH INFORMATION
Heart Beat is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only. It is not intended for medical diagnosis, treatment, or emergency use.
The app uses your smartphone camera to measure pulse. It does not measure blood pressure, blood oxygen, stress, or HRV; users enter these values manually. Heart Beat does not detect or diagnose heart attacks, arrhythmias, or other cardiovascular conditions.
Do not use the app to make medical decisions. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms of a medical emergency.
Contact: support@heartbeatapp.co 
Privacy Policy: https://heartbeatapp.co/privacy
Terms: https://heartbeatapp.co/terms 
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00062484:ios.description:
My Little Princess Stores is a storytelling digital dollhouse game where every game is a new adventure. Have fun pretend playing in the princess village stores. Get the latest fashion at the Clothing store, dressup, makeup and lots of clothing. Find you new best friend and the local Pets store or simply visit the supermarket for some food and party items. There are lots more shops and locations for you to play and discover in Little Princess Stores.
** Over 15 million downloads worldwide by kids and parents 
Why Do Kids and Parents love our games?
My Little Princess games are a digital version of the classic dollhouse game. Our kids game has no rules or objectives, It is all about free play and pretending. This is what makes our games so exciting for kids. Everything a kid sees in the game is touchable or intractable. You can have a princess dress up party, apply girls makeup and customize every character. By connecting all of our games we are helping the kids to build a whole world around there own adventure.
Game Features:
- 10 NEW locations and stores to explore!
- Brand new characters to meet and play within both the My Little Princess games.
- BRAND NEW hot air balloon feature! Each of the My Little Princess games now have a hot air balloon “station,” where you place the characters inside and then touch the “liftoff” button. The game then opens up a map with an entirely different game to explore!
- Multi-touch support so you can play with friends together on the same tablet
- Use the hot Air balloon to travel between downloaded little princess games
Recommended Age Group
My Town : My Little Princess Stores is great for kids all ages between 4-12. Younger children can play with their parents, while older children can enjoy playing the game with their friends, or by themselves. All My Town games promote imaginative play, helping to develop creativity and empathy. Our games are used by autism and special needs therapists worldwide.
We Make Game That Kids Want To Play
If you love our games and you want to offer new ideas, dressing items, themes and even bugs we might have overlooked please make sure to contact us. We read and respond to each and every email or Facebook message.
Facebook : Https://www.Facebook.com
Twitter: Https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Website: Http://www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00083469:ios.summary:
CAR MANAGEMENT MADE EASY
Whether you own a collectible or ‘special-to-you’ car, or just a newer vehicle you love and care for, you know that it takes effort to stay on top of everything it might need so you’re always drive ready.
Featur
bluejetty:00083469:ios.description:
CAR MANAGEMENT MADE EASY
Whether you own a collectible or ‘special-to-you’ car, or just a newer vehicle you love and care for, you know that it takes effort to stay on top of everything it might need so you’re always drive ready.
Features At-a-Glance:
- Document your vehicle details
- Track and log To-Dos, share with your mechanic so you don’t forget anything
- Monitor maintenance status and customize reminders
- Digitize all your paper receipts and records
- Build a photo gallery of your favorite photos, easy to show to others
- Record your vehicle’s history timeline and provenance record
- Understand current market value dynamics for your vehicle
- Get AI driven help to diagnose or generate follow-along DIY guides
- Manage vehicle rotation by counting days parked
- Log your favorite drives
- Downloadable PDF report for you to save or share when needed
- 100% Private
DOCUMENT YOUR CAR DETAILS
Keep all your car details in one place, and always with you. Everything from your favorite photos of your car, to vehicle specific details, registration etc.. Everything is organized by vehicle, and there is no limit to the number of vehicles you can have in CARPORT.
LOG & TRACK YOUR TO-DOS
Every car has something it needs now, will need soon, or has things you would like to do. CARPORT lets you log and track your To-Dos so they are all in one place, on your phone, and easy to cross off the list as you knock them down, or email them to your mechanic so they can take care of them for you.
MONITOR CURRENT MAINTENANCE STATUS
Keep an eye on the critical four maintenance items: oil changes, brake service, battery life and tire age. Customize Service Rings specific to each vehicle and set your own preferred service intervals with reminders based on time or mileage. 
KNOW WHAT SERVICE YOU DID WHEN
Keep a record of your service or DIY work done, including digitizing your receipts so you can easily search them when needed and know what’s been done when.
TABULATE YOUR EXPENSES AND INVESTMENT
Digitize all your receipts, even ones from past owners if you have them. We organize and tabulate everything for you, so you’ve got a running total of your investment.
MARKET VALUES & DYNAMICS
Knowing the value of your vehicle starts with understanding what the market is for your type of vehicle and why.
MANAGE ROTATION
Track your drive dates so you know how long you’ve been parked, and when you need to get your car out on the road for a drive.
GET DIAGNOSIS OR DIY HELP
Use our AI generated prompts to diagnose an issue or question, then if you want you can generate a DIY guide
BUILD YOUR VEHICLE’S PROVENANCE
Document the historical timeline of your car, uploading anything and everything you know about past owners, events, restorations. Do it for yourself, but also for the next owner so they understand the value of what they could own.
MAP FAVORITE DRIVES
Have favorite drives you enjoy taking? Log them with CARPORT. We’ll generate a route map for you at the end. While you’re on y our drive CARPORT helps you find what you need while you’re on the road, including help if needed.
MULTI-USER ACCESS
If you share the effort of vehicle management with others, then you can share your vehicles and set access levels for each.
DOWNLOADABLE VEHICLE REPORT
Everything you upload, organized into a simple and free to download report available whenever you want it. Great if you like keeping a complete copy to print, or saved somewhere else, or to share with potential buyers if you’re selling your car.
100% PRIVATE
CARPORT is a private experience. That means what you do in CARPORT is only visible to you. There are no social platform links, or any internal display of data between users. All of our development is down with in-house employees, here in California. We never share or sell data with ANY third party.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00146672:ios.description:
Keep snoops out, protect your privacy, and stop thieves in their tracks. Turn your iPhone into an unbreachable vault with Who Touched My Phone: Antispy.
Whether you leave your device on an office desk, charge it at a café, or keep it in your pocket on a crowded subway, this all-in-one phone security app acts as your digital guardian. Utilizing advanced motion sensors, AI facial awareness, and clever decoy interfaces, it delivers real-time physical defense against unauthorized access.
Discover the ultimate anti theft alarm and snoop-catching toolkit designed for absolute peace of mind.
CORE SECURITY FEATURES
- Who Touched My Phone (WTMP): Wondering who unlocked your phone or tried to browse your apps? The app silently tracks background activity, snaps an intruder selfie using the front camera the second the screen wakes, and logs it in a secure, timestamped history log.
- Don't Touch My Phone (DTMP) Motion Alarm: Activate a physical defense shield. If anyone shifts, lifts, or tilts your phone, an earsplitting siren blasts instantly. Choose from a custom library of 10 unique alarm sounds (siren, cat meow, laughter, and more).
- Deceptive Fake Lock Screen: Outsmart nosey friends or partners. This feature displays a convincing, interactive fake iOS lock screen background. While the snoop thinks they are interacting with your phone, the app secretly captures their photo in stealth mode.
- Public Charging Security Alarm: Safeguard your device at public charging stations in cafés or airports. If anyone unplugs your charging cable without authorization, a loud alarm screams until your custom PIN code is entered.
- Anti-Tracking Airplane Mode Alarm: Professional thieves switch on Airplane Mode to disable Find My tracking. Our system monitors status and triggers a loud alert the moment it is switched on, featuring a customizable grace period (3, 5, or 10 seconds).
- Smart Pickpocket Alert: Uses the proximity sensor to guard against commuter theft. The exact millisecond your phone is pulled out of a pocket or bag, a loud siren sounds and locks the app behind a passcode screen.
- Anti-Spy & Privacy Checklist: Run an instant security audit. Scan your system for potential spyware indicators, review app permissions, check connected devices, and audit network status to patch structural vulnerabilities.
- Face Guard AI Monitor: Take intruder detection further. Using the front camera, the app continuously monitors who is looking at your screen and sounds an immediate warning if an unrecognized face is detected.
ADVANCED SUPPORTING SYSTEMS
Secure Passcode Protection: Set a custom PIN required to dismiss triggered sirens or review hidden history files.
- Fake Lock Screen Themes: Choose from 5 distinct decoy screen backgrounds to seamlessly match your personal style and deceive snoops.
- Apple Watch Support: Arm, disarm, and monitor live security alerts straight from your wrist with the companion Watch app.
- Global Localization: Fully localized in 15 languages, including EN, FR, ES, AR, PT, DE, RU, NL, TR, JA, HE, HI, IT, ZH, and ID.
PRIVACY-FIRST PHILOSOPHY
All intruder photos, system logs, and security data are processed and stored exclusively on-device. No personal data is ever accessed, uploaded to external servers, or shared with third parties.
PREMIUM ACCESS & TRIAL
Download the app for free and enjoy a flexible freemium experience.
- Free Trial: Get 3 free activations across our most popular tools: Don't Touch My Phone, Charge Security, Fake Lock Screen and Pickpocket Alert.
- Pro Upgrade: Unlock unlimited access to all 8 core security systems.
- Subscription Tiers: Weekly Auto-Renewing, Monthly Auto-Renewing, or Lifetime Purchase (One-time payment).
Download Who Touched My Phone: Antispy today.

Privacy Policy: whotouchedmyphone.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00062739:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Swedish.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Swedish empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Swedish required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Swedish the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Swedish so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in sweden.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Swedish.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Real-time radar images, severe weather alerts, accurate weather forecasts and much more - precise & timely to help keep you safe!
STAY INFORMED:
- Radar overlay shows the areas of rain, snow & mixed precipitation in high resolution and vivid colors right on the interactive map;
- Precipitation map provides precipitation forecast for the next 24 hours; 
- Satellite map illustrates the cloud cover;
- Choose background maps (standard, hybrid, satellite), search locations, add them to bookmarks and stay out of harm’s way.
KEEP YOURSELF SAFE:
- Read weather alerts with all the details you might need; 
- Receive push notifications whenever there’s a weather alert for the bookmarked location (tornadoes, hurricanes, freeze warnings, and more);
- Monitor important National Weather Service watches, warnings and alerts in the form of interactive polygons on the map. Tap one to see the full alert text.
VIEW WEATHER DETAILS:
- 24-hour and 7-day forecast;
- Current, today’s min & max and "Feels Like" temperature;
- Pressure, humidity, wind speed, visibility, dew point info;
- Chance of Precipitation;
- Sunrise & sunset time.
Coverage Info:
Radar images: the US (Continental US, Alaska (except northern), Hawaii, Northern Mariana Islands and Puerto Rico), Mexico (northern), Canada (southern), Australia, the UK, Ireland, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy (northern and north-western), Denmark, Austria, Sweden, Finland, Spain, Portugal, Switzerland, Norway, Poland, Andorra, Japan and more. See the full list on the developer’s website.
Precipitation, temperature, satellite maps; wind map; snow depth forecast; hurricane, wildfire, lightning trackers; detailed weather info, precipitation alerts: most of the world.
NWS watches, warnings: the US only. 
Governmental severe weather warnings: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK.

- Severe weather alerts for all saved locations
- Hurricane tracker
- Advanced precipitation forecast
- Lightning tracker
- Temperature map
- Rain alerts
- Air quality index
- Wildfire tracking
- RainScope
- Hourly forecast
- 14-day forecast
- Animated wind map
- Snow depth forecast 
- No ads

bluejetty:00062424:ios.name: Map Puzzles
bluejetty:00062424:ios.summary:
Can you rebuild these maps from the past and present? Like a jigsaw puzzle but each piece is a cut-out section of the map which needs to be put back into the right place. Now with 126 available map puzzles ready to play immediately!
EASY T
bluejetty:00062424:ios.description:
Can you rebuild these maps from the past and present? Like a jigsaw puzzle but each piece is a cut-out section of the map which needs to be put back into the right place. Now with 126 available map puzzles ready to play immediately!
EASY TO LEARN
Simple drag and drop interface that works for adults and children. A simple tutorial on "How To Play" is included. Puzzles in each pack start easy and get harder the more you do.
HARD TO MASTER
Puzzles range from easy (solve in minutes) through to very hard (may take an hour). But don't worry, your placed pieces are automatically saved so you can do the puzzle over several sessions. You can also turn on and off useful guides like outlines or a ghost image depending on how hard you want it to be. And if some pieces are too small, just turn on the Auto-Zoom feature.
Can you earn all the Game Center achievements?
EDUCATIONAL
The maps span time from ancient eras to the modern day. A range of map types are also represented including world, country, city, story, constellations, geological and weather. Once a puzzle is completed you can explore a zoomed in version to read the fascinating details on the map.
FAMILY FRIENDLY
All puzzles are family friendly with the easier puzzles well suited to your younger puzzlers.
PEACEFUL
An uncluttered puzzle solving space lets you be in the moment as you work your way through the puzzle at your own pace.
HELPFUL
Some of the puzzles are hard. If you get stuck, use the Shuffle button to get new pieces, the Auto Fill feature to put those difficult pieces into their correct places or a Ghost image to help you find the right place.
CONNECTED
Works on your iPads and Macs. In-App purchases of puzzle packs are shared between your devices and you can easily enable synching of Puzzle completion progress between them. Start a puzzle on one device and finish it on another.

bluejetty:00131989:ios.description:
The simplest and easy-to-use calorie counter app
- Automatically count calories by taking food photos!
- Recognizes even complex dishes from restaurants
- Meal plans and recipes (Keto, Paleo, Vegan, etc)
- Training plans created by top personal trainers
Automatically count calories by taking food photos! We believe calorie counting should be as simple, fun, and easy as taking a picture of your food. Calorie Mama can tell you the calories in your food just by analyzing your food photos. It can recognize thousands of food categories including staples such as fruits, vegetables, meats, grains, beverages; complex cuisines and dishes such as American, Western, European, Asian, Latin American; and US/Canada packaged foods with a front-facing image or barcode.
How It Works:
1) Snap a picture of your food 
2) Calorie Mama analyzes your food photo and suggests what the food might be
3) Confirm the food to log your calories!
The more you snap, the more accurate and smarter Calorie Mama gets!
More Details:
The creators of Fitness Buddy, Instant Heart Rate, Argus, and Sleep Time bring to you Calorie Mama, a simple, elegant food tracker and calorie counter uses food recognition machine learning algorithms to identify many different foods, including packaged goods and barcodes. We do a lot of fancy work behind the scenes with deep artificial intelligence (AI), neural networks, computer vision, image recognition, to provide you with nutrition data. Our food detection and identification platform can recognize Western, European, Asian and fusion cuisines. Snap a food photo and you’ll be surprised at what Calorie Mama can detect!
Unlock additional features by subscribing to Premium! Features include:
Automatically log additional nutrients such as carbs, fat, protein, cholesterol, fiber, vitamin C, vitamin A, iron, and sodium.
Ability to toggle ON/OFF what factors into your calorie budget (steps, exercise, etc.)
Customizable calorie goals tailored to your individual goals
Customizable macro/micronutrient goals for those who have a more sophisticated diet plan (bodybuilders, personal trainers, elite athletes, etc.)
Access to scientifically proven home workout plans to supplement your training and fitness goals
Access to premium features of all of Azumio’s apps including Argus, Fitness Buddy, Instant Heart Rate and Sleep Time
Calorie Mama integrates with Apple Health. Connect to Apple Health by going into Settings -> Devices & Apps.

Term insurance offers financial coverage to the policy holder for a fixed period. In case of death of the insured during the policy term, the death benefit will be paid to the beneficiary. Users can even avail tax benefits on term insurance plans.
Savings & Investment Plan
Our Savings and Investment plans help in wealth creation to provide financial security. These online investment plans help in systematic and disciplined investment ensuring you and your family achieve your financial goals.
Health Insurance
Depending on the health insurance plan selected, the policy provides coverage for all your health care needs like critical illness expenses, surgical expenses, hospital expenses etc.
Retirement Plans
Retirement & Pension plans provide financial security and help you create wealth so that you can achieve your retirement goals without compromising on your living standards.
Child Plans
Child Insurance Plans ensure that your child's future financial needs are taken care of even in your absence. There is really no better gift you can give your child better than insurance plans & child education plans

bluejetty:00182876:ios.description:
Hearts Free is a classic competitive card game, and MobilityWare’s artificial intelligence ensures YOUR play has the competitive edge, Hearts card master!
This free Hearts game will teach you how to play with our intuitive AI. Our artificial intelligence adapts to your Hearts card game play style. Play feels fair, even though your opponents are some smart bots. But while playing them can feel like a challenge, MobilityWare’s Hearts hints AI feature is at your disposal and the smartest of them all! AI bot opponents offer another major benefit - you can play them offline, so no wifi is required to play Hearts!
Ever play a card game with real online users and experience inconveniences? Never worry about other users taking too long or abandoning a game in this free card classic. Enjoy the adaptability of AI, and benefit from MobilityWare’s free Hearts hints system, which always puts you in a clear position to win the games you play! We guarantee when you play, you’ll just notice your sense of relaxation and fun.
Get Excited for Features!
Whether you’re going to Shoot the Moon as a Hearts card master or just starting to get into the game or totally new to Hearts, you’ll find our game has a feature for your comfort and challenge level.
Artificial Intelligence 
- We cannot stop talking about this card game’s adaptive and fair AI features! 
- Playing Hearts free is a cinch with smart opponents
- And our even more intelligent free Hints feature
Play Offline, Anytime
- Wifi? Who needs it?
- No need to wait around for real users to log on with this free Hearts card game
- And no need to have game delays when their internet lags
- Reliable AI bots want to play cards with you all day, no internet required
Fair Play
- Learn to play a game with our simple start guide and free automated advice (which you can turn off!)
- Use as many free Hints as you like, powered by the smartest AI in our app!
- Use the free Undo function as many times as you like if you need to rethink your moves
Some Tips for Hearts Beginners!
- Scoring points in Hearts is not a good thing (unless you collect ALL available points)
- Each hearts suit card is worth 1 point
- Beware the Queen of Spades - a card worth 13 points!
- If you collect all points available in the game, they get thrown to your opponents in a dramatic feat called Shooting the Moon!
About Hearts Subscription
Hearts Subscription is an optional subscription that gives you access to seamless play without any ads, the ability to play extra goals and exclusive themes.
You can subscribe to Hearts for a term of one month, six months or for one year. New subscribers can choose a one-week trial subscription at no cost. The monthly term costs US$4.99, the six month term costs US$9.99, and the yearly term costs US$24.99. The subscriber’s iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Renewal prices are US$4.99 per month, US$9.99 per six months, or US$24.99 per year. The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged for a renewal in the last 24 hours of the current period. Purchasers can manage their subscription and turn off automatic renewal in their Account Settings.
Subscriptions may be stopped by turning off automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A subscription cannot be canceled in the middle of its term.

Please see our Terms of Service at http://mobilityware.com/eula.php

bluejetty:00070095:ios.description:
Just in time for Rayark's 10th anniversary comes a sequel to their classic IP, DEEMO.
A kingdom created through music faces an uncertain future after a monster called 'The Ancestor' plagues the land with a destructive 'Hollow Rain'. This dangerous rain causes anyone it touches to 'bloom', turning into a flurry of white flower petals and ultimately vanishing from existence.
DEEMO II follows Echo, a girl who has bloomed but mysteriously re-appeared, and Deemo, an enigmatic station Guardian, as they journey through this rain-soaked world in hopes of finding a way to save it.
Features:
▲A Mysterious and Emotional Story:
Why did 'The Composer', the elusive being who created this world, suddenly abandon it? Why and how did Echo bloom and then come back to life? Accompany Echo as she uncovers the secrets behind these questions, journeying to uncover the truth and save the world.
▲A Combination of Rhythm and Adventure:
Explore Central Station with Echo, interacting with your surroundings as you get to know the many station residents while discovering clues and 'Charts', magical pieces of music with the power to clear away Hollow Rain. As Deemo you'll play those Charts, putting your musical skills to the test in fun and challenging rhythm sections, ultimately moving the story forward.
▲30 Core Songs + DLC Song Packs for a Total of 120+ Tracks:
Composers from around the world, including Japan, Korea, Europe and the Americas, have created an eclectic array of tracks for DEEMO II with an emphasis on acoustic instrumentation. Genres include Classical, Jazz, Chill Pop, J-Pop, and more. Infectious, emotive melodies will give music lovers dozens of fast favorites, and creative, syncopated rhythms will make sure rhythm-game aficionados have plenty to sink their teeth into.
▲Make Friends with Over 50 Station Residents:
Central Station is full of characters with their own personalities and stories. As Echo, you can chat with them as they walk about Central Station, living their lives, opening paths to different topics depending on the situation. As you talk with them and get to know them, you'll start to feel like you're part of an eccentric new community.
▲Storybook Graphics and Artstyle:
DEEMO II marries hand-drawn backgrounds with 3D models and a meticulous attention to detail that will make you feel like you're caught in a storybook, or an anime come to life.
▲Movie-Quality Animated Scenes:
DEEMO II is full of high-quality anime cutscenes, fully voiced by professional Japanese voice actors. Pair that with music composed by DEEMO and Sdorica vets, and you've got an audio and visual treat.
Rayark is well-versed in rhythm-game production, with popular titles like Cytus, DEEMO, Voez, and Cytus II under their belt. They are well-known for mixing fun and fluid rhythm gameplay with visual flair and deep storylines, providing full, rewarding experiences to get lost in.

bluejetty:00066200:ios.description:
GuessPhrase is the ultimate party game guaranteed to brighten up your game night and get the whole group laughing! Download this FREE word guessing game and turn any gathering into an unforgettable experience.
GuessPhrase is a fast-paced, family-friendly trivia party game you can play with friends, family, or coworkers. Split into teams of 4, 6, 8, or more, the bigger the group, the better the fun. The goal is simple: get your teammates to guess the word or phrase you're describing before the buzzer goes off. Think of it as the perfect mashup of charades, hot potato, and musical chairs, all rolled into one hilarious, high-energy card game experience.
Features:
Fresh Content from the Cloud, Every time you open the app, the latest decks are loaded automatically. Check back around every holiday for limited-edition specialty decks and seasonal word packs!
Sleek Card-Style Interface — A clean, modern layout makes browsing categories and playing rounds smooth and intuitive.
Dark Mode — Easy on the eyes for late-night game sessions. Toggle dark mode on whenever you're playing after hours.
Lightning Fast Performance — Over 50% faster than version 1, so you spend less time waiting and more time playing.
10,000+ Words & Phrases — A massive library of prompts across dozens of categories keeps every round fresh.
Customizable Rules — Set your own points-to-win target and adjust the buzzer countdown timer to match your group's style.
How to Play:
Split into two teams and sit in a circle, alternating teammates. When it's your turn, hold the device and describe the word or phrase on the screen — but don't say it! Your teammates shout out guesses while the clock ticks down. Pass the device to the next player after each correct guess. The catch? You don't want to be holding it when the buzzer sounds, or the other team scores a point. With tons of categories to choose from, every round feels different. Best enjoyed with 6–10 players, but works great with any group size.
Perfect for:
Game nights, house parties, family reunions, holiday gatherings, road trips, team building events, college hangouts, camping trips, and birthday celebrations.
If you have ideas on how to make GuessPhrase even better, we'd love to hear from you! We're a small team passionate about creating fun experiences, and your feedback means the world. If you're enjoying the game, please take a moment to leave a review, it helps us grow and keep improving. Thank you for playing GuessPhrase!
This app is in no way affiliated with or endorsed by Hasbro nor the Tonight Show and should not be confused with their product, Catch Phrase™.

bluejetty:00062066:ios.description:
Chessplode is modern chess for everyone, it makes chess fun even if you're bad ¯\_(ツ)_/¯, one simply move... can change all game.
-- THE MODERN RULE --
Chessplode is pretty much like chess with a really BIG twist... 
- CAPTURE a piece and everything in the same LINE and COLUMN will EXPLODE... 
- But if a KING is in that LINE or COLUMN it will be a really *boring* chess capture (no explosions)
-- THINK DIFF... *DISTINCT* --
This rule is pretty tricky, in regular chess you need to defend your KING, but in Chessplode it can save your pieces.
Remember, you can't capture some pieces because you could get check.
Sometimes you will checkmate capturing a piece that explodes.
And other you will be afraid of having several pieces in the same line or column...(POP!)
-- FRIENDS (Who love chess) REVIEW --
They find Chessplode a great challenge and love how they need to change the old way of thinking even if they are winning... a bad move and they will run out of pieces.
-- FRIENDS (Who *meh* chess) REVIEW --
Chess + Explosions... you got my attention. Some of these friends were casual chess players and others didn't really feel the attraction for chess. Both find Chessplode a really fun game. When they were playing regular chess they were not good, now they are the kings of the hill.
-- FEATURES --
* FREE TO PLAY
* Realtime chess battles multiplayer with people around the world.
* In multiplayer you can send an emoji (to express your feelings) with every move you submit. Instant fun!
* Play Levels created for other players, you can find really madness here, but you can undo your move... everyone can make a mistake.
* Create your own custom Level and submit it to everyone can play it. Challenge the world!
* Try local multiplayer battles with friends in the same device. Head to head!
* Practice playing versus Ziri.
* A lot of different color themes, play day and night with your favourite colors.
Thank you for playing "Chessplode"! I really hope you enjoy it as much as I did making it ;)

Chessplode is pretty much like chess with a really BIG twist... 
- CAPTURE a piece and everything in the same LINE and COLUMN will EXPLODE... 
- But if a KING is in that LINE or COLUMN it will be a really *boring* chess capture (no explosions)

-- THINK DIFF... *DISTINCT* --
This rule is pretty tricky, in regular chess you need to defend your KING, but in Chessplode it can save your pieces.
Remember, you can't capture some pieces because you could get check.
Sometimes you will checkmate capturing a piece that explodes.
And other you will be afraid of having several pieces in the same line or column...(POP!)

-- FRIENDS (Who love chess) REVIEW --
They find Chessplode a great challenge and love how they need to change the old way of thinking even if they are winning... a bad move and they will run out of pieces.

-- FRIENDS (Who *meh* chess) REVIEW --
Chess + Explosions... you got my attention. Some of these friends were casual chess players and others didn't really feel the attraction for chess. Both find Chessplode a really fun game. When they were playing regular chess they were not good, now they are the kings of the hill.

-- FEATURES --
* FREE TO PLAY
* Realtime chess battles multiplayer with people around the world.
* In multiplayer you can send an emoji (to express your feelings) with every move you submit. Instant fun!
* Play Levels created for other players, you can find really madness here, but you can undo your move... everyone can make a mistake.
* Create your own custom Level and submit it to everyone can play it. Challenge the world!
* Try local multiplayer battles with friends in the same device. Head to head!
* Practice playing versus Ziri.
* A lot of different color themes, play day and night with your favourite colors.

Thank you for playing "Chessplode"! I really hope you enjoy it as much as I did making it ;)

bluejetty:00062828:ios.summary:
Ventusky All-in-One Weather is a fusion of 20+ of the world's best models, live radar, satellite and 40,000+ webcams, delivering industry-leading accuracy for planning everything from morning jogs to transatlantic flights.
WE BRING A UNIQU
bluejetty:00062828:ios.description:
Ventusky All-in-One Weather is a fusion of 20+ of the world's best models, live radar, satellite and 40,000+ webcams, delivering industry-leading accuracy for planning everything from morning jogs to transatlantic flights.
WE BRING A UNIQUE SET OF FEATURES LIKE:
- Hyperlocal 14-days weather forecast with up to hourly resolution
- 80+ weather maps
- Live radar and lightnings detection
- 40,000+ worldwide webcam coverage
- Lock and home screen widgets with forecasts, webcams, or radar
- Integration with Watch OS
- 3D interactive globe
- Customizable push notifications for: wind, waves, freezing rain, pressure, lightning strikes, umbrella reminder or morning/evening summary.
- Professional features like isolines or weather fronts
- Dual wind animations for 2 different altitudes
- Extensive air quality information
- Hurricane and storm tracking - compare tracks from multiple models and stay safe
Use Ventusky everyday to plan your activities and stay ahead of the weather:
1) Joggers & Outdoor Athletes: Plan with Microscale Precision
For runners, cyclists, and hikers, Ventusky provides updates critical for avoiding sudden weather shifts.
Hyperlocal Wind Gust Maps: Visualize wind speed changes at high resolution, ideal for route planning in mountainous regions.
Lightning Strike Alerts: Receive push notifications for strikes within selected distance, synced to wearable device haptics for hands-free safety.
Feels-Like Temperature: Combines humidity, wind chill, and solar radiation to advise on heatstroke risks during summer runs.
2) Vacation Planners: Verify Conditions in Real Time
Travelers leverage global webcam network and 14-day forecasts to optimize itineraries.
Live Cams: Compare real-time footage from 40K+ coastal, ski resort, and urban cameras to assess conditions before departure.
Tropical Storm Preparedness: Track hurricanes predicting storm paths and landfall in advance.
Air Quality Indexes: Plan trips using SILAM model data on PM2.5, NO2, ozone levels and more.
3) Meteorologists & Professionals: Industrial-Grade Tools
Ventusky serves as a field toolkit for pilots, sailors, and researchers needing altitude-stratified data:
Aviation Wind Layers: Animate wind patterns at 16 altitudes (0m–13km) for flight path optimization.
Marine Forecasting: Access ocean current models and surge predictions for offshore operations.
Agricultural Planning: Display the monthly anomaly in precipitation in easy to use map.
MULTI-MODEL FUSION FOR UNMATCHED ACCURACY
Why Does Ventusky Outperform Competitors? Ventusky’s algorithms integrate data from the world’s most advanced numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems, each renowned for specialized applications. In addition to the well-known ECMWF and GFS models, it also displays data from the German ICON model, which stands out for its high resolution covering the entire world. A wide range of high-precision local models is available. Some are updated as frequently as every 10 minutes based on radar and satellite readings, providing highly accurate real-time precipitation data. Ventusky automatically selects the most precise model for your location, but you can also compare them yourself.
LIST OF WEATHER LAYERS:
Temperature (16 altitude levels)
Feels like temperature
Precipitation (1 hour, 3 hours, cumulated, monthly anomaly, Freezing rain, Rain, Snow)
Radar and lightnings
Satellite
Wind gusts
Air Quality (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, O3, CO, Dust, AQI)
UV-index
Probability of Aurora
LIST OF WEATHER LAYERS (PREMIUM)
Cloud coverage (High, Mid, Low, Base, Total cover, Fog)
Wind speed (16 altitude levels)
Air pressure
Thunderstorms (CAPE, CAPE*SHEAR, Wind shear, CIN, Lifted index, Helicity)
Sea (Significant, wind and swell waves period and height, Currents, Tidal currents, Tide, surge)
Humidity (4 altitude levels)
Dew Point
Snow cover (Total, New)
Freezing level
Visibility
The app is completely free of ads or tracking scripts. Do you have questions or suggestions? Visit my.ventusky.com.

bluejetty:00176567:ios.description:
Do you enjoy a puzzle game that only lets you draw 1 line to solve the challenges? What if instead of drawing a bridge, you MAKE A BRIDGE OUT OF YOUR CAR?
Sounds interesting? If you're bored and tired of playing traditional draw-line games, let's try a whole new concept of draw-to-bridge, where you draw a line to stretch your car and become a bridge. Try our new game: Car Climber: Draw Bridge 3D
Everyone can draw a normal and boring bridge. But do you have what it takes to make your car a bridge and help it reach the other side?
Let your creativity fly and draw a unique & special bridge that no one has done and wow the world with your creativity & madness.
Train your brain through 150+ puzzles and levels that we make for you. Each challenge will force you to use your brain to the fullest, and improve both logical IQ and creativity.
Draw & Build up a famous bridge that you love!
Let's dive into the game and build the craziest bridge ever
HOW DO YOU PLAY?
- Touch the screen to start drawing in the drawing panel.
- Hold and drag across to make the shapes you want.
- Once you finish, release your finger
- The car will stretch and follow the line you drew.
- Wait for the result: if the car reaches the other side, you win the level!
Very simple gameplay yet is very hard to master.
OUR UNIQUE FEATURES
- Don't be afraid to trial and error: you can always redo
- New and improved mechanics.
- Exciting levels.
- Relaxing music.
- No limit on playtime.
Start solving your favorite puzzle and play Car Climber: Draw Bridge 3D now!

Smooth contro
bluejetty:00019086:ios.description:
The enemy army have marched all the way to the gate of the last bastion. The Celestials looked to their greatest champions. Answer the call and embark on the Path of Vanquisher! Fight for the glory!
[Ultimate Game Experience]
Smooth control, smart blow feedback, realistic sounds, and stunning visuals with splendid special animation effects and detailed 3D graphics integrated to bring an ultimate game experience.
[Unique Celestial Transformation System]
With the unique Celestial Transformation system, courageous heroes can transform into invincible Celestials and mow down murderous enemies. Celestials with different capabilities are waiting to be unsealed in your journey, harness the power of Celestials and use them wisely to face different dilemmas!
[Sprite Companions]
In Era of Celestials, sprites are your most loyal protectors. In the heat of battle, they will always be right by your side! Different sprites provide different forms of assistance, and you may switch between them at will, opening up a wealth of strategies to help you overcome any situation.
[Spectacular Costumes]
Era of Celestials contains a bewildering array of spectacular costumes, complete with awesome glow effects. So now there's no excuse not to look your best, even on the battlefield.
[Real-Time PvP Battles]
From the 1v1 real-time combat of Showdown to the multiplayer brawls of the Sanguine Contest and Lava Expedition, Era of Celestials is filled with action-packed combat and generous spoils for the victors.
[Boss Hunts]
The Path of the Vanquisher is paved with amazing equipment, and hunting bosses is the main way of getting equipment and crafting materials in Era of Celestials. Kill world bosses, instance bosses, the evil dragons that show up for limited amounts of time, or any of the many other bosses to earn handsome rewards and send your BR soaring.

bluejetty:00119894:ios.description:
Fun painting app, based on Unlimited Layers with Blend Modes and Masks
Any brush can be used with 3 professional-level realtime technologies of calligraphy: Line Delay, Rope Stabilization and Correction, combine it for best results. With 100% calligraphy the line will be very smooth even if you are drawing with your finger
Brushes can be Dry, Glossy and Wet. There are 3 types of Wet brushes: Without Pull, With Pull and Super-Precise. Any brush can instantly became Smudge-brush with Finger instrument. Textured brushes are also supported
If you like to draw with simple round brush, there are quick settings for Hardness, Ovality & Rotation of your brush shape. Or, if you prefer realistic brushes, large Pro-Library of shapes (>1000 textures) can be used to create new brushes of any type
Apple Pencil is fully supported, including Touch Force, Tilt, Azimuth and Predicted Points. There are settings for each Pencil ability. You also can disable finger-painting, if you never use it
Gestures: 2-fingers tap for Undo and 3-fingers tap for Redo any action
For color choosing there are 2 different Color Pickers and Palettes with Gradient Mixer. Use long-pressure gesture for quick color choosing
Time-Lapse video recording is enabled by default
FEATURES LIST:
Create Animation:
* Unlimited frames of animation
* Multiple animation layers
* Export to mp4, hevc, gif, apng
Learn How to Draw by copying Professional Art:
* Use any Painting or Sketch as a Lesson
* Tap left side of screen to switch between your painting and the lesson

* Glossy brushes

* Light or dark interface
* Custom interface color

* Dynamic ssd/operative memory using for layers
* Masks

* Blend modes
* Opacity and visibility
* Import any image as a layer
* Transform without loosing image quality

The #1 annual guide in adult internal medicine.
Each year CURRENT Medical Diagnosis and Treatment (CMDT) undergoes extensive revision to deliver new clinical developments in every field of adult internal medicine—making it the most popular annual textbook of its kind.
For more than six decades, CMDT has been disseminating authoritative information that students, residents, and clinicians need to build their medical knowledge, expertise, and confidence. Written by top experts in their fields, chapters are formatted so you can find the most relevant diagnostic tools for day-to-day practice.
CURRENT Medical Diagnosis & Treatment 2025 provides:
- Emphasis on the practical aspects of clinical diagnosis and disease management
- Coverage of more than 1,000 diseases and disorders
- Hundreds of quick-access drug treatment tables with indexed trade names
- Essentials of Diagnosis provides snapshot of common diseases/disorders
- Diagnostic and treatment algorithms and tables present critical information at a glance
- Carefully curated references provide peer-reviewed, evidence-based information and PMID numbers for quick online access
- Hundreds of full-color photographs and illustrations
CMDT 2025 updates include:
“Year in Review” table highlights nearly 100 recent advances - impacting clinical practice
- New chapter on Substance Use Disorders
- New photos reflecting clinical conditions in a variety of skin tones
- Key updates to Viral & Rickettsial Infections chapter including concise directives on COVID-19 and measles
- Expanded coverage of major GI Disorders such as Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis
No internet connection is required to access the content after the initial download. Find information quickly using powerful SmartSearch technology. Search part of term for those hard to spell medical terms.

bluejetty:00141233:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain-teasers in adventure games! Seek and find all hidden objects that are needed to finish a criminal investigation. 
You are a magic detective who got an invitation to the annual Venice Masquerade. This is an important event for magical creatures because they have an opportunity to move freely around the city. You go to Venice and meet your friend. At this time, an unknown person, whose face is hidden by a mask, appears at the carnival square and revives the lion statue, jeopardizing the fragile peace between the worlds of Others and humans. After revealing the identity of the masked stranger, you will have to go through many trials and witness the choice between common sense and love… 
· PREVENT AN UPCOMING CONFLICT BETWEEN HUMANS AND MERFOLKS IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and hidden objects games after you finish the main story! More collectibles await you in this unique chapter, where you can use a clue for each task and unlock all new branches of the story!

Each location has a unique collection of various collectibles that will help you in a point & click investigation! Are you ready to go on an exciting Domini Games adventure quest and collect all the hidden pictures?
· ENJOY BONUS MATERIALS THAT INCLUDE CONCEPT ART, WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, AND MORE!
Our hidden object games for iPhone & iPad have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy!
· SOLVE MINI-GAMES AND INTERESTING RIDDLES!
Replay your favorite puzzle adventure to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck on any mystery finding games? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you to!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com

bluejetty:00013734:ios.description:
The ultimate FIELD GUIDE to Wild Berries, Fruits and Herbs of Europe and North America, all in the palm of your hand!
Finally, you have the option to identify species without the help of a heavy book. You get a comprehensive library full of facts, figures, and images. Learn where you can find certain species, learn if they are edible and how to prepare and cook them. 
Find inspiration and experience nature in a whole new way.
Apps and books help to determine what species it is, but you are still unconfident?
You now have the best chance to correctly determine the right species with the Online Species Consultation. Enthusiasts and Biologists from around the world will help identify what species it is.
You discover a species or make a great snapshot?! 
With the sightings function you are organizing your discoveries on the road or at home! For each sighting, you can store comprehensive information, e.g. photo, time, GPS position and location.
CONTENT
* 180 species - 2000 images
* Extensive description of the species
* Species names in 12 languages
* Scientific identification
* Online Species Consultation
* Capture and share sightings
* Quiz game
SEARCH AND IDENTIFY SPECIES BY
* APPEARANCE
- fruit, flower, leaf, tree, shrub, etc.
* EDIBLE
- toxic, edible, allergen, etc.
* CATEGORY/TYPE
- berry, stone fruit, apple fruit, nut, etc.
* TIME
- flowering, ripening, harvesting, etc.
QUIZ GAME
* Guess species from pictures
* Learn to distinguish different species
NATURE MOBILE on YouTube:
http://www.youtube.com/naturemobile
ABOUT NATURE MOBILE
The mission of NATURE MOBILE is to present exciting topics from nature and other areas to a wide audience of interested people, enthusiasts, and experts in an attractive way. You are an author or photographer, you have fascinating ideas or content, please contact us at support@naturemobile.org.

bluejetty:00099051:android.description:
Welcome to Dice Rollers – The Royal PvP Dice Adventure!
Step into the magical realm of Dice Rollers, where classic dice strategy meets thrilling player-versus-player competition! Roll your way through ever-changing game boards in a free-to-play experience packed with exciting combos and endless rivalries.
Roll. Strategize. Rule.
In Dice Rollers, you and your opponent take turns rolling dice, aiming to score epic combinations and outsmart each other on unique, game boards. Each match delivers inventive twists on the familiar Yatzy format: combo options are grouped into special grids — score across these grids to unlock mighty bonuses and climb the ranks of royalty!
Why You’ll Love Dice Rollers:
Head-to-Head Matches: Challenge players around the world in exhilarating real-time PvP showdowns.
Innovative Dice Boards: Play on fresh, randomized boards where combos are grouped for strategic bonuses and surprise unlocks.
Strategic Depth: Outsmart rivals by crafting clever combos, planning your rolls, and seizing bonus-scoring opportunities.
Play With Friends: Invite friends and family for friendly duels, or battle for daily bragging rights!
Key Features:
Ideal for fans of Yatzy, dice strategy, and competitive board game classics.
Easy to learn, tough to master – every match is a new puzzle!
Fast-paced, intuitive gameplay designed for mobile.
Beautiful design and smooth play experience.
Unlock achievements, collect exclusive in-game treasures, and master new gameplay variations with every session.

bluejetty:00182954:ios.description:
Step into the immersive world of Driving School Simulator: EVO, the ultimate game for mastering real driving skills! With exciting parking challenges, large freeroam maps, and a cutting-edge real sim experience, this game takes your driving abilities to the next level. Tackle traffic, upgrade your dream car, or explore open roads—EVO delivers nonstop fun.
Key Features That Set Driving School Simulator: EVO Apart
Real Driving Sim and Training
Learn to drive with precision! Our sim offers life-like controls, real scenarios, and practical lessons, ideal for beginners and experienced drivers.
Multiplayer car game – EVO adds a new dimension to multiplayer fun. Race with friends or challenge others in drag races.
Car racing games – Choose your sports car and hit the track for high-adrenaline races. Beat friends in online drag races or play time-attack on various tracks.
Realistic cars – From performance models to hatchbacks, muscle cars, and supercars, we’ve got everything. Detailed interiors/exteriors make EVO one of the most realistic driving games.
Realistic engine sounds – Hear V8 roars or W16 hypercar power with authentic sounds, pops, and upgraded exhaust effects for full immersion.
Challenging Car Parking Missions
Sharpen accuracy and control with intricate parking tasks in tight spaces.
Freeroam Open World Exploration
Relax on open roads! Drive through cities, highways, and landscapes in 2025 freeroam. Go solo or explore with friends.
Ultimate Car Customization
Transform your car with wraps, rims, spoilers, and performance upgrades like turbo or ECU tuning.
Traffic Games and Realistic Roads
Face real-world traffic challenges in busy cities or fast highways.
How to Make the Most of Driving School Simulator: EVO
Start Your Training: Learn essential techniques with guided lessons.
Multiplayer Madness: Join drag races, freeroam with friends, or try team challenges.
Explore Stunning Maps: Travel through vibrant cities like Washington D.C., Chicago, and Madrid, or hit the highways for an unforgettable adventure for their 2025 versions.
City Driving with Cars of All Types
Navigate urban traffic while driving various cars. Practice tight turns, stop at red lights, and handle crowded intersections in this advanced school simulator designed to make you a better car driver. Plus, we are adding vans, buses, and trucks to the roster, giving you even more vehicle options to master in the city. 
Why Choose Driving School Simulator: EVO?
Real Driving Experience: Authentic sounds and handling.
Fun for Everyone: Perfect for all ages, whether parking or exploring freeroam.
Multiplayer Features: Collaborate or compete in exciting modes.
Enjoy Now!
The most advanced real driving sim awaits! Master parking, explore freeroam, and conquer traffic challenges in this packed simulator.

bluejetty:00164230:ios.description:
◈◈【荣誉与推荐】◈◈
备受主流平台认可的诗意美学
Apple 官方多次力荐：「编辑精选」「编辑最爱」「十月最佳应用」及文化专题收录
诗，是无形的画；画，是有形的诗
诗词之美，终可被看见、被听见、被感受。
在「长相思」，我们以原创诗词动画，让千年的诗句“活”成流动的画卷。看山水在墨意中舒展，听情感随旋律起伏——诗与画，在此真正交融。
在这里，你不再只是读诗，而是走进诗中：
步入王维的松间明月，沉浸苏轼的江上清风；
看李清照的愁绪化作梧桐细雨，随李白的豪情共饮一壶盛唐。
诗，从此挣脱文字的边界，成为可沉浸的光影、可聆听的意境、可共鸣的陪伴。
我们相信，你会在这流动的诗画世界里，触摸到诗词真正的温度。
◈◈【诗画赏析 · 多维体验】◈◈
◈ 诗画庭院
在这里，你可以亲手打造一座古风庭院，一草一木皆由你安排。
更可邀李白对月举杯，请杜甫驻足题壁，看李清照执笔添香——
与诗人跨越时空相见，在互动与吟咏中，走进他们笔下的诗境与人生。
◈ 赏 · 诗画入眼，词韵入耳
在这里，诗词不仅是文字，更是可沉浸、可聆听的感官盛宴。
画 | 诗成画，画生歌
原创诗词动画，让千古名篇“活”成流动的光影诗剧。步入其中，你不是在读诗，而是在经历诗——看墨色晕开山河，听琴声落成词句，亲身体验“诗是无形画，画是有形诗”的至美交融。
听 | 诗亦歌，歌即诗
大量原创古风音乐，以现代旋律吟唱经典。让诗随歌声流入耳畔，在韵律中舒展意境，听见文字之外的情感流淌。
信 | 一日一诗，见字如晤
每日精选一句诗，配以手绘古风信笺。在碎片化的时代里，为你留存一份纸短情长的诗意温度。
◈ 学 · 会写诗，更会爱上诗
诗词学习计划：基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，为你定制科学记忆节奏，让背诵从此轻松、持久。
AI 智能创作：一键生成诗意段落，帮你突破写作瓶颈，激发更多灵感火花。
填字成诗：在游戏闯关中巧妙记忆诗句，让学习像解谜一样有趣。
◈ 心 · 你的心事，诗都懂得
基于你当下的情绪与状态，智能匹配与你共鸣的诗词。
无论喜悦、孤独、迷茫或宁静，诗不只是被传诵的句子，更是穿越千年而来、懂你此刻的温柔回应——让每一种心情，都能在诗里找到归宿。
◈ 雅 · 诗意，是一种生活
文坛：自由创作、分享诗笔记，与同好交流碰撞，见证彼此的灵光。
诗友圈：如果诗人有朋友圈——看他们用现代口吻调侃人生，搭配魔性古风表情包，让经典活泼起来。
布告：随时获取灵感锦囊：作文素材、诗词取名、经典摘录、祝福语……让诗意渗透日常。
◈ 语 · 与诗人，聊个知己
随时向诗人提问，像与老友对谈。
哪一句击中你，哪一句困惑你，皆可畅言。我们与诗在此，陪你走入字句深处，聊出更远的天地、更真的共鸣。

信 | 一日一诗，见字如晤
每日精选一句诗，配以手绘古风信笺。在碎片化的时代里，为你留存一份纸短情长的诗意温度。


◈ 学 · 会写诗，更会爱上诗
诗词学习计划：基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，为你定制科学记忆节奏，让背诵从此轻松、持久。

填字成诗：在游戏闯关中巧妙记忆诗句，让学习像解谜一样有趣。


◈ 心 · 你的心事，诗都懂得
基于你当下的情绪与状态，智能匹配与你共鸣的诗词。
无论喜悦、孤独、迷茫或宁静，诗不只是被传诵的句子，更是穿越千年而来、懂你此刻的温柔回应——让每一种心情，都能在诗里找到归宿。


◈ 雅 · 诗意，是一种生活
文坛：自由创作、分享诗笔记，与同好交流碰撞，见证彼此的灵光。
诗友圈：如果诗人有朋友圈——看他们用现代口吻调侃人生，搭配魔性古风表情包，让经典活泼起来。
布告：随时获取灵感锦囊：作文素材、诗词取名、经典摘录、祝福语……让诗意渗透日常。


◈ 语 · 与诗人，聊个知己
随时向诗人提问，像与老友对谈。
哪一句击中你，哪一句困惑你，皆可畅言。我们与诗在此，陪你走入字句深处，聊出更远的天地、更真的共鸣。

bluejetty:00015704:ios.summary: Are you ready to wave goodbye to belly fat and welcome those chiseled six-pack abs in time for the summer season? Look no further than our exceptional abs workout app, designed to help you sculpt and define your abs effectively. Regardless
bluejetty:00015704:ios.description:
Are you ready to wave goodbye to belly fat and welcome those chiseled six-pack abs in time for the summer season? Look no further than our exceptional abs workout app, designed to help you sculpt and define your abs effectively. Regardless of your fitness level, you can conveniently perform these workouts in the comfort of your home or any location of your choice, at any time that suits you. Dedicate just a few minutes each day to achieve the jaw-dropping abs you've always desired! This app is integrated with HealthKit, so you can find your calorie burn data in the Health App. You can turn on the "Apple Health" option to sync your calorie burn to Apple Health.
Tailored Workout Plans for Every Level
Our app offers three levels of workout plans meticulously crafted to guide you through a progressive journey of losing belly fat and building strong, toned abdominal muscles. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned fitness enthusiast, you'll find suitable workouts tailored to your abilities. Each day introduces fresh and invigorating exercises, ensuring your routine remains dynamic and captivating.
30 Days of Effective Workout Routines
Setting a clear goal is the key to attaining amazing results swiftly. Our app, Six Pack in 30 Days, empowers you to establish exercise goals by providing comprehensive, scientifically-backed 30-day workout routines. These routines gradually increase in intensity, effortlessly integrating exercise into your daily routine and transforming it into a healthy habit.
Your Personalized Home Trainer
Why spend a fortune on a personal trainer or waste time commuting to the gym? Six Pack in 30 Days becomes your personal trainer within the confines of your own home. Based on the principle of high-intensity circuit training, our workouts deliver results equivalent to those achieved in a gym setting.
Animated Demonstrations and Video Guides
Our program has been scientifically proven to strengthen all your abdominal muscles effectively. Through engaging animations and detailed video guides, you can confidently execute each exercise with precision, ensuring safety and maximizing the effectiveness of your workout.
Exciting Features
• Sync your data with Apple Health for comprehensive fitness tracking.
• Includes many exercise programs: Home Workout and Office Workout.
• No surprises or hidden charges - complete transparency throughout.
• Benefit from structured 30-day workout routines specifically designed to sculpt six-pack abs and cultivate a stronger physique.
• Achieve remarkable results with our training program focused on weight management and muscle building.
• Gradually increase exercise intensity to foster continuous progress and growth.
• Customize workout reminders to align with your schedule and preferences.
• Automatically track and record your training progress, simplifying your monitoring process.
• Suitable for everyone, including beginners, professionals, men, women, teenagers, and seniors - catering to diverse fitness levels and goals.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Six Pack in 30 Days is free to download and use. Should you choose to upgrade to the premium version, we offer an auto-renewing subscription option.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Read our full Privacy Policy at https://takalogy.com/privacy-policy/
For our full terms of use, please visit: https://takalogy.com/terms-and-conditions-of-use/

bluejetty:00149641:ios.description:
The official app of Copper Mountain. Make the most of your day at The Athlete’s Mountain. View mountain biking and hiking trails, see where to eat, what activities to do, and more! 
App features:
- See where you stack up against other mountain bikers on the Copper Mountain leaderboard
- Real-time lift & trail status
- Real-time weather data
- Find and track your friends on the mountain
- Send dynamic messages to your friends and family based on your location
- Track your bike day & season including every run and lift you ride, your vertical feet, linear miles, max and average speed
- Events and summer activity information
BIKE TRAILS AND LIFT REAL-TIME STATUS
Know which lifts are open.
REAL-TIME WEATHER DATA
See the real-time weather to help you plan out your adventurous mountain day.
FIND AND TRACK YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY ON THE SLOPES
Create your own private group to stay connected with friends on the mountain. See exactly what trail or lift each person in your group is on, in real-time, including the run difficulty rating and their percentage down the trail, as well as their current location on the resort map.
SEND DYNAMIC MESSAGES TO YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Send location-aware messages to your group by using the quick messages feature and let them know where conditions are sweet. When you see the “#” in your quick message, your location will automatically be dropped into the message. 
The app also syncs your workouts with Apple Health.
Created exclusively for Copper Mountain Resort by the creators of SkiLynx.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00165270:ios.description:
Time to Test Your Intelligence with Water Sort Master - Color Puzzle! 
Are you ready to find out how smart you really are? Dive into the world of Water Sort Master - Color Puzzle and challenge your brain in the most fun and engaging way possible! This puzzle game will keep you hooked as you sort colorful liquids into tubes, providing endless entertainment and mental stimulation.
Why You'll Love Water Sort Master - Color Puzzle
• Brain-Boosting Fun: Enjoy challenging your brain with sorting puzzles that test your IQ and strategic thinking. Each move requires careful thought and precision.
• Addictive Gameplay: Stack the colored liquids in tubes and experience the satisfaction of perfectly arranged colors in color sort game. Can you solve all the puzzles?
• Endless Challenges: With over 500 unique levels, there’s always a new puzzle waiting to challenge you and keep you engaged for hours on end.
How to Play
1.Tap and Pour: Tap on a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the water from the first bottle into the second. Simple mechanics that anyone can master.
2.Color Match: Only pour water if the top colors of both bottles match and there’s enough space in the receiving bottle. This requires strategic planning and foresight.
3.Capacity Limit: Each bottle has a maximum capacity. If a bottle is full, no more water can be added, so plan your moves carefully.
4.Restart Anytime: No timers or penalties mean you can restart any level at any time if you get stuck. Take your time and think through your color sort moves.
5.Strategize and Solve: Use your IQ and strategy skills to predict your next moves and ensure you don’t get stuck. Each puzzle is a test of your problem-solving abilities.
Features
• Free to Play: Enjoy all the fun and challenges without any cost. No hidden fees or in-app purchases required.
Simple Controls: Easy one-finger controls make the puzzle game accessible for everyone, from kids to adults.
• Colorful Graphics: Beautiful, vivid liquid make the color sort game visually appealing and enhance the overall puzzle game experience.
• Relaxing Sounds: Enjoy soothing ASMR sounds as you pour and sort the liquids. Perfect for relaxing after a long day.
• No Time Limit: Play at your own pace without any pressure. Ideal for both quick sessions and long, relaxing gameplay.
• Hundreds of Levels: With countless levels to play, you’ll never run out of puzzles to solve.
Additional Highlights
• Family-Friendly: Perfect for players of all ages, making it an excellent puzzle game for family fun and bonding time.
• Offline Play: No internet connection? No problem. Play anytime, anywhere, even when you're offline.
• Boost Your IQ: Improve your logical thinking and problem-solving skills at each level. It's like a workout for your brain!
• Exciting Rewards: Unlock exciting rewards and new levels as you progress. The more you play, the more you earn!
Ready to Become a Water Sort Master?
Think, strategize, and pour your way to victory! Whether you’re looking to kill some time or boost your brainpower, Water Sort Master - Color Puzzle is the perfect choice. With vibrant liquids, relaxing sounds, and endless challenges, you’ll find yourself coming back for more.
Download puzzle game now and embark on your journey to becoming the ultimate puzzle master. Enjoy the satisfaction of solving each level and watch your brainpower grow with every puzzle.

bluejetty:00129591:ios.description:
Welcome to the fascinating world of Farm Blast.
Farm Blast is a great puzzle game for those who are looking for an entertaining way to relax their brain and pass the time. Show off your strategic skills; tap and blast the bubbles to solve the puzzles, and build up your farm by completing the levels. Solving puzzles has never been so much fun
This game is easy to play, but challenging to master. You have to pop groups of bubbles of the same color by simply tapping on them. Since you only have a limited number of moves in each level, it depends on your clever blasts and combination of boosters for huge explosions. Try to clear the board with fewer moves to achieve a higher score.
Solve all the puzzles, clear all the levels, reach the target, and win cool boosters.
Rockets, bombs and rainbows will help you smash the blocks and pass the levels easier. Use these great boosters and power-ups at the right time to destroy bubbles, clear the board, collect stars and win great prizes! Simple gameplay, but hard to master.
Apple and Facebook Login are also available! You can continue without losing your progress on any device by logging into your account. 
Moreover, 'Daily Events' are here. You have the opportunity to participate in the various events and win even more.
Farm Blast is a free and exciting puzzle game that will keep you hooked for a long time. Get involved in the colorful adventure of Farm Blast; we look forward to your challenge!
So, what are you waiting for?

bluejetty:00127892:ios.description:
An ebook and audiobook app designed exclusively for purchases made at https://press.princeton.edu/.
Welcome to the Princeton University Press app, powered by Glassboxx. We are delighted to offer you an easy and secure way to enjoy your ebook and audiobook purchases.
No password required – you can either use our social sign on with Apple or Google, or simply log in with the email address used to buy the book and enter the verification code sent to your email – and your content awaits in the ‘My books’ area of the app, with formats clearly labelled. With the content in the cloud, downloading requires an initial internet connection. Once downloaded, you can access your books and enjoy them offline.
THE EREADER ALLOWS FOR:
• Page book-marking, opening the title at the right place when you pick up, even across multiple devices
• Font-size and font face changes, as well as dyslexic-friendly font
• Page colour themes (white, dark, and sepia) 
• Full text search
• Highlighting
• Annotations
THE AUDIO-PLAYER WILL:
• Auto-save your current position in the book – so that you can pick up right where you left off, even if listening on different devices
• Allow for skip forward/backward to recap where relevant
• Offer sleep timer option
• Play on lock-screen, enabling easy access to playback controls
• Play in background whilst browsing other apps
• Play immediately, and download in the background (provided internet access is available)
• Display accompanying materials for the audiobook
• Integrate with Apple Car Play
• Connect to Airplay devices

bluejetty:00099319:ios.summary: Tease Gone Wrong: Parent Pranks" is a hilarious and chaotic mobile game where players step into the shoes of a mischievous kid who loves playing pranks on their parents. Set in a fun, interactive home environment, this game lets you experie
bluejetty:00099319:ios.description:
Tease Gone Wrong: Parent Pranks" is a hilarious and chaotic mobile game where players step into the shoes of a mischievous kid who loves playing pranks on their parents. Set in a fun, interactive home environment, this game lets you experience the excitement and consequences of teasing your parents with playful tricks and surprises.
In Tease Gone Wrong, each level presents a new opportunity to set up pranks within various areas of the house, from the living room and kitchen to the bedroom and bathroom. But be careful! The pranks don’t always go as planned, and what starts as a harmless joke might quickly spiral into unintended chaos. Whether it’s a whoopee cushion under the chair or a bucket of water poised over a door, you’ll need to think fast and act creatively.
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter unique challenges and new tools to use for your pranks. Some levels require you to outwit your parents with clever setups, while others challenge you to escape from tricky situations when your pranks backfire. The fun is in the unpredictability will your prank succeed, or will it lead to a family disaster?
The game features vibrant, cartoonish graphics, making it suitable for players of all ages. With its light-hearted and playful tone, Tease Gone Wrong offers a fun way to unwind and enjoy a good laugh. It's an ideal game for anyone who loves a bit of harmless mischief and family-friendly entertainment.
Get ready for hours of fun, as you set up pranks, avoid getting caught, and experience the hilarious outcomes of your actions. Tease Gone Wrong: Parent Pranks will keep you laughing as you discover just how far you can push your pranks before things get out of hand

bluejetty:00129687:ios.name: Princess coloring book Candice
bluejetty:00129687:ios.summary: Candice Colors is a creative coloring and drawing app designed for young girls who love princess stories, magical creatures, and cute, friendly characters. The app invites children into a soft and reassuring creative world where they can co
bluejetty:00129687:ios.description:
Candice Colors is a creative coloring and drawing app designed for young girls who love princess stories, magical creatures, and cute, friendly characters. The app invites children into a soft and reassuring creative world where they can color elegant princesses, friendly mermaids, adorable ponies, cute animals, and kawaii-style illustrations created especially for kids.
The coloring experience is simple and relaxing, with child-friendly tools and gentle colors that allow young children to express themselves freely. Each coloring page is designed to be easy to understand and satisfying to complete, helping children build confidence while enjoying calm creative play.
Candice Colors also includes a guided drawing workshop where children can learn how to draw easy models step by step. These drawing activities follow the same beloved themes, including princesses, mermaids, ponies, animals, and cute fantasy characters. The models are designed for beginners and help improve fine motor skills while making drawing feel fun and accessible, even for very young artists.

bluejetty:00157995:ios.summary:

Use satellite imagery, vegetation and moisture data, field-level weather, scouting notes, and field his
bluejetty:00157995:ios.description:
OneSoil is a farm management app that helps you understand what is happening in your fields, plan fieldwork, and keep your team aligned.
Use satellite imagery, vegetation and moisture data, field-level weather, scouting notes, and field history to make better decisions throughout the season.
Whether you manage a few fields or a large farm operation, OneSoil helps you monitor crops, spot problems early, plan operations, and keep all field data in one place.
UNDERSTAND WHAT’S HAPPENING IN EVERY FIELD
Monitor crop development with satellite imagery, NDVI, moisture layers, and field history.
Compare field conditions over time, identify weaker zones, and decide where to scout first.
SPOT PROBLEMS EARLY
Track changes in vegetation and moisture to detect potential stress before it becomes visible from the road.
Use field layers and season history to understand whether a problem is new, recurring, or linked to specific zones in the field.
ADD AND ORGANIZE FIELDS FAST
Find and add fields in seconds with auto-detected field boundaries.
Organize fields by season and workspace, keep boundaries up to date, and manage all your fields without drawing everything manually.
SCOUT FIELDS AND SAVE OBSERVATIONS
Create scouting notes directly from the field, even offline.
Attach photos, mark problem areas, save geolocation, and keep observations connected to the right field, crop, and season.
PLAN OPERATIONS WITH FIELD-LEVEL WEATHER
Plan spraying, fertilization, scouting, and other fieldwork using weather data for each field — not just the nearest town.
Check precipitation maps, field-level forecasts, wind, humidity, temperature, and spraying windows to choose better timing for operations.
KEEP ALL FIELD DATA IN ONE PLACE
Store field boundaries, satellite images, vegetation history, moisture layers, weather, notes, photos, seasons, and field records in one app.
Use OneSoil as a single workspace for your farm data throughout the season.
COLLABORATE WITH YOUR TEAM
Share field context with agronomists, operators, consultants, or farm managers.
Work together in one workspace so everyone can see the same fields, notes, and updates.
START FREE. UPGRADE WHEN YOU NEED ADVANCED TOOLS.
Core field monitoring tools are available for free: add fields, view the latest cloud-free satellite image, check basic field weather, and create scouting notes.
A subscription unlocks advanced monitoring and planning tools, including season-long satellite history, 4-hour hyperlocal precipitation forecast, spraying window recommendations, and field boundary downloads.
Subscription pricing depends on your region and farm size. Available plans can be reviewed directly in the App Store.
WEB VERSION FOR ADVANCED PRECISION AGRICULTURE
Use OneSoil on mobile and web to get even more from your field data.
The web version supports advanced workflows such as productivity zones, variable-rate prescription maps, soil sampling, machinery data, and yield analysis.
Questions or ideas? Contact us at care@onesoil.ai or via the in-app chat.
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bOa8Jv2Zx8-wLq7VoiJpdqLM47UA2Jaf/edit
