bluejetty:00179004:ios.name: Kgo - Tra phạt nguội, Ôn GPLX
bluejetty:00179004:ios.summary:
Kgo - tra cứu phạt nguội, thông báo phạt nguội hàng giờ; ôn thi giấy phép lái xe 600 câu; học lý thuyết lái xe ô tô B1, B2; mua bảo hiểm ô tô; bảo hiểm ô tô pvi, bảo hiểm ô tô sài gòn - hà nội; tìm kiếm cây xăng, gara uy tín;
Kgo cam kết là
bluejetty:00179004:ios.description:
Kgo - tra cứu phạt nguội, thông báo phạt nguội hàng giờ; ôn thi giấy phép lái xe 600 câu; học lý thuyết lái xe ô tô B1, B2; mua bảo hiểm ô tô; bảo hiểm ô tô pvi, bảo hiểm ô tô sài gòn - hà nội; tìm kiếm cây xăng, gara uy tín;
Kgo cam kết là ứng dụng về ô tô hoàn toàn miễn phí; giao diện thân thiện và dễ sử dụng.
Chỉ với một lượt tải, một cú chạm, bạn được trải nghiệm 5 tính năng chính như:
 1. Ôn thi giấy phép lái xe (GPLX) đề 600 câu, học lái xe ô tô
- Ứng dụng học lái xe gồm đầy đủ 600 câu hỏi lý thuyết dùng cho: học lái xe máy bằng A1, học lái xe bằng B1, học lái xe ô tô bằng B2, học lái xe bằng C
- Bài thi giấy phép lái xe (gplx) ngẫu nhiên với hàng ngàn bộ thi chuẩn theo cấu trúc đề thi 600 câu của Tổng cục đường bộ Việt Nam
- Tìm kiếm nhanh và dễ dàng bằng từ khóa về luật đường bộ, thi sanh hình, biển báo giao thông
- Bộ 50+ câu hỏi hay sai nhất
- Chia sẻ mẹo và kinh nghiệm thi lý thuyết lái xe ô tô “trăm phát, trăm trúng”
- Tra cứu và hiển thị biển báo giao thông giúp dễ nhớ
 2. Kiểm tra phạt nguội, thông báo phạt nguội toàn quốc: nhanh - chính xác - kịp thời
- Chỉ cần nhập biển số xe để tra cứu phạt nguội
- Cập nhập thông tin phạt nguội hàng ngày hàng giờ từ nguồn uy tín csgt.vn
- Thông báo phạt nguội ngay khi có lỗi vi phạm
3. Mua bảo hiểm oto nhanh chóng, uy tín:
- Bảo hiểm ô tô PVI
- Bảo hiểm ô tô Sài Gòn - Hà Nội BSH
- Mua bảo hiểm ô tô online, thanh toán COD, nhận ấn chỉ tại nhà quy đường bưu điện
- Chiết khấu bảo hiểm oto cao nhất thị trường
- Mua bảo hiểm ô tô bắt buộc
- Bảo hiểm thân vỏ, bảo hiểm trách nhiệm dân sự 
 4. Thông báo khi sắp hết hạn hoặc quá hạn đăng kiểm
- Tra cứu thông tin đăng kiểm
- Quản lý thông tin đăng kiểm
- Thông báo tự động nhắc nhở khi đăng kiểm sắp hết hạn
 5. Nhắc ngay khi sắp hết hạn hoặc đã quá hạn bảo hiểm ô tô
- Thông báo thời hạn bảo hiểm ô tô
- Tra cứu tình trạng bảo hiểm ô tô
- Tự động gửi thông báo khi sắp hết hạn bảo hiểm ô tô
- Kết nối và mua bảo hiểm dễ dàng từ các hãng bảo hiểm uy tín
 6. Tra cứu thông tin luật đường bộ và các lỗi vi phạm thường gặp hoặc dễ gây nhầm lẫn
- Tra cứu luật đường bộ trực quan, dễ dàng
- Tra cứu lỗi vi phạm thường gặp
- Quy định về nồng độ cồn và chất kích thích
- Nghị định 100 mới nhất
 6. Tìm bãi đỗ xe, cây xăng, gara, chỗ rửa xe, ắc quy, làm lốp, cứu hộ
Kgo là ứng dụng trên thiết bị di động lớn nhất Việt Nam giúp người dùng tìm kiếm được điểm đỗ xe, cây xăng, gara sửa xe, điểm nạp ắc quy, địa chỉ làm lốp, địa chỉ cứu hộ thuận tiện và gần nhất. 
Kgo được ra đời để giúp cho việc sử dụng xe ô tô tại Việt Nam trở nên đơn giản và dễ dàng hơn.
 6+: Các tính năng sắp ra mắt:
- Mua và đánh giá bảo hiểm online
- Tìm kiếm, đánh giá giáo viên dạy lái xe
Kgo là ứng dụng cho oto giúp học lái xe, tra cứu phạt nguội, mua bảo hiểm oto hoàn toàn miễn phí, giao diện thân thiện, dễ dàng sử dụng. Học lái xe, tra cứu và mua bảo hiểm với chiết khấu cao mọi lúc mọi nơi. Ứng dụng dành cho người sử dụng oto hướng tới xây dựng cộng đồng cùng chia sẻ, đánh giá các thông tin về giao thông, ô tô. Với việc sử dụng Kgo, bạn dễ dàng cập nhật tin tức, luật pháp cũng như góp phần giúp cho văn hóa giao thông tại Việt Nam ngày càng văn minh.
Chúng tôi rất mong nhận được những đóng góp của các bạn để có thêm động lực hoàn thiện app.
Chi tiết xin vui lòng xem thêm tại: https://kgo.life/ 
Fanpage chính thức của Kgo: https://www.facebook.com/kgo.life

bluejetty:00186222:ios.name: Shoonya Kids: Learn Languages
bluejetty:00186222:ios.summary:
Built with a research grant from the U.S. Department of Education. Reading, phonics, and math in five languages — for ages 3 to 8. Shoonya Kids teaches early literacy and numeracy in English, Spanish, Hindi, Marathi, and Telugu. 
Children
bluejetty:00186222:ios.description:
Built with a research grant from the U.S. Department of Education. Reading, phonics, and math in five languages — for ages 3 to 8. Shoonya Kids teaches early literacy and numeracy in English, Spanish, Hindi, Marathi, and Telugu. 
Children can easily switch languages in a single app, bringing true multilingual learning and accessibility to their fingertips. 
WHAT CHILDREN PRACTICE 
Phonics & Reading — letter sounds, blending, digraphs, rhyming, syllable segmenting, CVC words, and high-frequency sight words 
Writing & Tracing — letter and number formation aligned to Handwriting Without Tears, the standard used in schools 
Early Math — counting to 100, skip counting, addition, subtraction, geometry, patterns, and positional words 
Vocabulary — themed words drawn from food, clothing, instruments, and daily life across cultures 
Progress is self-paced and Montessori-inspired, allowing children to choose their own path. Teachers can customize and differentiate learning for students with a dedicated teacher portal.
WHY IT'S DIFFERENT 
Genuinely multilingual. Shoonya Kids is built with input from pedagogy experts and Dual Language Immersion educators to provide a genuine learning experience. Content is designed for each language and not run through a translator, so that children learn the language as it is intended to be taught.
Research-backed. Developed under an SBIR grant from the U.S. Department of Education's Institute of Education Sciences, with WestEd as our independent research partner and classroom testing in California public schools. 
Built for how children actually learn. Designed in alignment with UNICEF and LEGO Group's RITEC framework and NAEYC's Developmentally Appropriate Practice principles. 
Safe by design. COPPA- and FERPA-compliant, no ads, no third-party tracking. 
WHAT EDUCATORS SAY 
"They don't even know they're learning because they think they're playing — but they're learning!" — Perla Estrada, TK Teacher, Dual Language Immersion, El Camino Elementary 
"It helps a lot to have technology that is authentic in Spanish and play-based — it's appropriate for the development and age of this group." — Stephanie Hernandez Jarvis, Kindergarten Teacher, El Camino Elementary 
"Shoonya's multicultural and multilingual platform is the state-of-the-art in early language and multiliteracy development." — Dr. Barbara Flores, Former President, California Association for Bilingual Education 
IN CLASSROOMS & AT HOME
PreK–2nd Grade: Foundational literacy and numeracy 
Dual Language & English Language Learners: Authentic Spanish, English, Hindi, Telugu and Marathi content 
After School & Summer Enrichment: perfect for independent learning rotations 
Common Core aligned: phonemic awareness and number sense 
Teachers get a dashboard to assign activities, track progress, and see accuracy and completion by student. 
Shoonya is available for at home use and used in homes across the world for multilingual learning.
RECOGNITION 
U.S. Department of Education Small Business Innovation Research Grant 
Most Innovative Consumer App — Octane High Tech Awards 
Spirit of Entrepreneurship Award in Science and Technology — Women's Economic Ventures
Antares REACH Grant 
Featured by NBC, Parentology, and Educational App Store Used by families and teachers in over 80 countries. 
TRY IT FREE 
A free version is always available to practice letters in five languages. 
Full curriculum access is $5.99/month, $19.99/quarter, or $57.99/year. Cancel anytime. Support: support@shoonyadigital.com 
Privacy Policy: https://www.shoonyadigital.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Service: https://www.shoonyadigital.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00074642:ios.description:
Are you ready to transform your health and achieve your weight loss goals? Look no further than the Mediterranean App, the all-in-one solution that brings the renowned Mediterranean diet to your fingertips. With this exceptional app, you'll embark on a personalized Mediterranean diet plan that caters to your unique needs and preferences, ensuring a sustainable and enjoyable journey towards a healthier you. 
Mediterranean App is a comprehensive diet and lifestyle platform, offering users a personalized experience right at their fingertips. By completing a detailed health quiz the app will create a free dietary profile where users are presented with tailored recommendations including their optimal daily calorie and water intake, calculated BMI, estimated metabolic age, and a predictive weight loss forecast if they adhere to the recommended Mediterranean diet plan. All recommendations are intelligently adjusted based on user's activity level, food preferences and lifestyle, providing a holistic approach to healthier living.
The Mediterranean App takes the guesswork out of healthy eating by providing you with a comprehensive meal plan designed by nutrition experts. Say goodbye to restrictive diets and hello to a balanced, flavorful approach that promotes weight loss, boosts energy levels, and supports overall well-being. Experience the benefits of the Mediterranean diet, which has long been celebrated for its ability to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve cognitive function, and enhance longevity.
But that's not all—the Mediterranean App goes above and beyond by empowering you to tailor your meal plan to suit your individual tastes and dietary requirements. Craving variety or have specific dietary restrictions? No problem! With just a few taps, you can adjust your meal plan and explore a vast collection of mouthwatering recipes that showcase the rich flavors and wholesome ingredients of the Mediterranean cuisine.
What sets the Mediterranean App apart is its incredible affordability. We believe that everyone should have access to the tools they need to live a healthy life, which is why we've made this groundbreaking app available at a remarkably low price. No longer will achieving your weight loss goals be a financial burden. Take advantage of this limited-time opportunity to transform your health without breaking the bank.
But that's not all—the Mediterranean App also comes with a convenient web version, allowing you to access your personalized meal plan and recipe library from any device. Whether you're at home, work, or on the go, you'll never be far away from the guidance and inspiration you need to stay on track and make healthier choices.
So why wait? Take control of your health, embrace the Mediterranean lifestyle, and achieve your weight loss goals with ease. Download the Mediterranean App today and embark on a life-changing journey that combines delicious flavors, customization, affordability, and convenience all in one package. Get ready to unlock the secrets of the Mediterranean diet and enjoy a happier, healthier you!
To access the diet plan and utilize all features of this app, an in-app purchase is required.
Privacy Policy: https://usamd.mymediterranean.diet/data-protection-policy
Terms of Use: https://usamd.mymediterranean.diet/terms

bluejetty:00014913:ios.name: Zoho Workerly— Temps & Workers
bluejetty:00014913:ios.summary: Zoho Workerly is a cloud-based timesheet management application for temporary workers (temps). As a temp, you can create and submit timesheets for all the jobs you're working on. You can also keep track of all your timesheets, and accept jo
bluejetty:00014913:ios.description:
Zoho Workerly is a cloud-based timesheet management application for temporary workers (temps). As a temp, you can create and submit timesheets for all the jobs you're working on. You can also keep track of all your timesheets, and accept jobs that interest you. 
Once your agent invites you to Zoho Workerly, you'll receive a username and password as a text message. You can use those credentials to log in to Zoho Workerly.
To get started, you need to either be assigned a job by your agent directly or accept a job from the temp portal. Once you're assigned to a job, you can perform these functions:
Create and submit timesheets
You can easily create timesheets for jobs. In each timesheet entry, you can not only log the number of hours worked but also update the amount of time spent working overtime.
Keep track of all your timesheets
You can simply head over to the Timesheets section of the app to access the timesheets for all your completed jobs and the ones you're currently working on. 
Accept jobs that interest you
When agents post jobs in the temp portal, you can have a look at the job details and then accept them if you're interested.
Get a clear picture of your current and upcoming jobs
Go to the Jobs section of the app to view the jobs you're currently working on and the ones that are scheduled next. 
Access all your past jobs
You can find all the jobs you've completed in the Job History section and access them whenever you want. 
Check in your work time with ease
You can easily Check in and Check out your work time and add the break hours for your day to day activities. Realtime Checkin also allows you to reset your work time.
For any questions or feedback, please write to workerly@zohomobile.com. We'll be happy to help.

Zoho Workerly is a cloud-based timesheet management application for temporary workers (temps). As a temp, you can create and submit timesheets for all the jobs you're working on. You can also keep track of all your timesheets, and accept jobs that interest you. 

Once your agent invites you to Zoho Workerly, you'll receive a username and password as a text message. You can use those credentials to log in to Zoho Workerly.

To get started, you need to either be assigned a job by your agent directly or accept a job from the temp portal. Once you're assigned to a job, you can perform these functions:

Create and submit timesheets

You can easily create timesheets for jobs. In each timesheet entry, you can not only log the number of hours worked but also update the amount of time spent working overtime.

Keep track of all your timesheets

You can simply head over to the Timesheets section of the app to access the timesheets for all your completed jobs and the ones you're currently working on. 

Accept jobs that interest you

When agents post jobs in the temp portal, you can have a look at the job details and then accept them if you're interested.

Get a clear picture of your current and upcoming jobs

Go to the Jobs section of the app to view the jobs you're currently working on and the ones that are scheduled next. 

Access all your past jobs

You can find all the jobs you've completed in the Job History section and access them whenever you want. 

Check in your work time with ease

You can easily Check in and Check out your work time and add the break hours for your day to day activities. Realtime Checkin also allows you to reset your work time.

For any questions or feedback, please write to workerly@zohomobile.com. We'll be happy to help.

bluejetty:00164240:ios.description:
The Slow-jogging metronome is a running cadence metronome designed for all runners. It is suitable for running beginners, healthy weight losers, and runners who want to improve their cardiopulmonary function and reduce sports injuries. Through precise tempo control, the Slow-jogging metronome helps you maintain a constant slow-jogging pace, thereby optimizing the running effect and making every step you take full of rhythm and comfort.
Why Slow jogging is recommended:
Slow jogging originated in Japan and was proposed by Professor Hiroaki Tanaka of Fukuoka University.
The principle of slow-jogging is based on the ""low-intensity, long-term"" aerobic exercise theory.
Low-intensity exercise can keep the heart rate between 60% and 70% of the maximum heart rate. This range is considered the best fat burning and cardiopulmonary function improvement range. Within this heart rate zone, the body primarily uses fat as a source of energy rather than glycogen, which aids in fat loss and weight management.
What are the benefits of slow jogging:
- Improve cardiopulmonary function: Long-term slow-jogging can enhance heart function and improve oxygen utilization.
- Reduce sports injuries: Because running is low-intensity and puts less pressure on joints and muscles, it can significantly reduce the risk of sports injuries.
- Promote fat burning: Under low-intensity exercise, the body is more inclined to use fat as energy, which helps with weight control and weight loss.
-Improve sleep quality: Regular ultra-jogging can improve sleep quality and help your body and mind relax better.
- Enhance mental health: During jogging, runners can often enjoy the relaxation and happiness brought by running, which helps reduce stress and depression.
Slow Jogging Metronome Guide:
-Pace regulator-
Supports cadence adjustment, choose your running cadence according to your daily habits, including the popular Japanese 180bpm tempo, 150bpm tempo, 200bpm tempo, etc. Quickly customize your running tempo!
-Super jogging beat-
There are a large number of 180bpm beat music to choose from. Follow the beat step by step without hurting your knees. The combination of music and beats allows you to enjoy while running, making running full of fun~
-Pedometer-
You just run and leave the data to us. Every time you jog, we will record the number of steps, kilometers, calories burned, and running time for you!
-Timer-
Set a small goal every day, set the exercise time, and start the slow-jogging timer to remind you regularly!
-data analysis-
Record your running data in detail, including speed, cadence, running time and calories burned, and showcase your progress with graphs and analytics reports.
-Free without ads-
Green and safe, simple and clean interface, no ads!
15 minutes a day, you won’t be out of breath or tired, and you can strengthen your heart and lungs. Whether you want to exercise or lose weight, the Slow Jogging Metronome is your best choice. Go ahead~
Download now and start changing now!

bluejetty:00135336:ios.description:
I-GUIDE helps you track your USCIS case using official data, follow your immigration court (EOIR) case, and understand how long the wait may be — all in one app.
I-GUIDE is an independent case tracker built for immigrants who want clear, reliable information in one place.
ONE TRACKER FOR ALL YOUR CASES
- Add a case by USCIS receipt number or A-Number — the app recognizes which one it is
- See USCIS and court cases in one list, filter and sort them
- Tap a case notification to open that case right away
USCIS
- Official USCIS API access: I-GUIDE is authorized to access USCIS case status data via the official USCIS API. Your case status comes directly from USCIS data sources
- Notifications when the status changes
- Full history of case updates
- Estimated wait time based on official USCIS statistics and historical case data
- Compare your case with average processing times for similar cases
- Track multiple receipt numbers — useful for families and dependents
IMMIGRATION COURT (EOIR)
- Detailed information about your immigration court case
- Track up to 10 cases
- Check your EAD clock
- Add your next hearing date to your calendar
- Get directions to the court or call it
- Information about the appeal process
NEW: IMMIGRATION COURT STATISTICS
- Approval rates nationwide, by court and by judge
- "My chances": approval rate for your court or judge and your nationality
- All case outcomes and trends by year
- Based on public EOIR data
ANNUAL ASYLUM FEE
- Reminder about your I-589 filing anniversary (by fiscal year)
- Quick link to pay and "Mark as paid"
IMMIGRATION GUIDES AND RESOURCES
Step-by-step guides:
- Asylum (I-589)
- Work permit and SSN (I-765)
- Adjustment of Status / Green Card (I-485)
- Travel Document (I-131)
- Immigration court process
- TPS, parole, humanitarian programs
- Living and working in the United States
FORM SAMPLES AND TEMPLATES
- USCIS form samples
- Immigration court motions and examples
- Templates for common situations
MY DOCUMENTS
- Store and organize important immigration documents
- Keep key information in one secure place
IMMIGRANT PROFILE
- Manage your personal case information across multiple filings
SPECIALISTS DIRECTORY
- Immigration attorneys
- Translators (40+ languages)
- Accountants and tax specialists
- Insurance, mortgage and licensing experts
- Other services helpful for immigrants
LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (partially)
DISCLAIMER
I-GUIDE is an independent application and is not affiliated with USCIS or EOIR. The app does not provide legal advice. FORZ LLC does not represent and is not affiliated with any U.S. government entity. FORZ LLC is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

bluejetty:00019292:ios.description:
Old School RuneScape 
Old School RuneScape is the iconic fantasy MMORPG that defined a generation. Based on the original 2007 version of RuneScape, this is the only major MMO RPG shaped entirely by its players, with new content voted into the game by the community. 
With over 300 million accounts created since 2001, RuneScape remains one of the world’s most played online role-playing games. Whether you're new to Gielinor or returning for the nostalgia, Old School RuneScape delivers a deep, evolving sandbox RPG adventure. 
Master 24 Skills, Including Sailing 
Train across 24 unique skills, including the new Sailing skill. Captain your own ship, explore uncharted islands, and uncover powerful rewards on the open sea. 
From Combat and Slayer to Fishing, Runecrafting, and Sailing, this open-world MMORPG offers true progression and freedom. 
Choose your path: 
• Max every skill
• Build a PvP account
• Play as an Ironman
• Or explore at your own pace 
This is your MMO, play your way. 
Epic Quests & Story Adventures 
Embark on hundreds of immersive quests filled with humour, danger, and rich fantasy storytelling. Solve mysteries, defeat legendary foes, and shape your character’s legacy. 
From early-game beginner quests to Grandmaster challenges, Old School RuneScape delivers classic RPG quest design with modern depth. 
Bosses, Raids & Endgame PvM 
Take on powerful bosses and conquer epic raids, including: 
• Chambers of Xeric 
• Theatre of Blood 
• Tombs of Amascut 
Whether you're learning how to survive your first raid, or you're chasing the title of raid master, Old School RuneScape offers some of the most rewarding PvM in any MMORPG. 
Explore a Vast Open World MMO 
Adventure across the enormous world of Gielinor, from desert kingdoms and haunted swamps to tropical islands and now the open seas. 
Every region unlocks new training methods, bosses, skilling activities, and unforgettable quests in this living fantasy MMO. 
True Cross-Platform Gameplay 
Play Old School RuneScape on mobile and desktop with one account across the same game worlds. Skill on the go, complete a quest on mobile, then raid on desktop, your progress stays with you. 
Free-to-Play or Become a Member 
Start your adventure for free, or unlock the full MMORPG experience with Membership: 
• 9 additional skills 
• Hundreds more quests 
• Exclusive bosses and raids 
• Expanded world map and bank space 
Download Old School RuneScape today and begin your adventure in the world’s most community-driven MMORPG.

Terms and conditions: https://www.jagex.com/terms

bluejetty:00179781:ios.summary: Designed by musicians for musicians, the app’s beautiful, minimal and intuitive interface allows you to tune almost any string instrument on the go and stay up to date with the latest Roadie upgrades. Explore a wide variety of alternate tun
bluejetty:00179781:ios.description:
Designed by musicians for musicians, the app’s beautiful, minimal and intuitive interface allows you to tune almost any string instrument on the go and stay up to date with the latest Roadie upgrades. Explore a wide variety of alternate tunings, create your own custom tunings and consistently get the best sound out of your instrument.
With the free tuner you can:
- Tune any string instrument on the go including guitar, ukulele, mandolin and banjo.
- Choose from a multitude of tunings: standard, open G, open D, Drop D, half step down, D modal and much more.
- Access a high performance chromatic tuner.
- You can even create and save your own custom tunings! 
It’s fast, accurate and easy to use: simply pluck the string on your instrument, the app will listen directly from your device’s microphone and guide you visually until you reach the perfect pitch. 
It is also the perfect companion for all Roadie Tuners:
It serves as a control center for your tuning experience when using any of the Roadie Tuner products (the original Roadie Tuner, Roadie 2, Roadie Bass and Roadie 3). Through the app, you will also receive the latest firmware updates and feature improvements for your Roadie Tuner device. 
Create and store a profile for each of your instruments (electric, acoustic, classical, 7 and 12-string guitars, ukuleles, bass, mandolins, banjos, etc.)
Refine your advanced tuning settings: set Roadie to “Tune up” mode, change the reference pitch, tune with a capo and modify the desired frequency to the cent.
Access music news, our latest updates, and tips on how to improve your playing.
Create custom instruments such as a dulcimer or a santour or anything else with geared pegs.
Turn off and on Roadie’s beep and vibration function depending on your needs. 
Roadie Tuner makes tuning a breeze. Download the app so you can immediately get to playing.

bluejetty:00175199:ios.name: Live Home 3D - House Design
bluejetty:00175199:ios.summary: Build a home, renovate an apartment or plan your garden with Live Home 3D—an intuitive home, interior and landscape design app that turns all design tasks into an exciting process, while giving you the powerful tools that no other app in th
bluejetty:00175199:ios.description:
Build a home, renovate an apartment or plan your garden with Live Home 3D—an intuitive home, interior and landscape design app that turns all design tasks into an exciting process, while giving you the powerful tools that no other app in the store can deliver.
With Live Home 3D, you will be able to:
• Create detailed 2D floor plan layouts.
• Walk through your 3D interior designs.
• Hone your design skills with the ready-made house and interior design samples (e.g., kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, etc).
• Add and move furniture and other objects (5,000+ items), and apply physically based materials (3,000+ supplied materials). Thousands of free models can be imported from the Trimble 3D Warehouse and Sketchfab.
• Import 3D models from other applications in all of the most popular formats. 
• Project your 3D home into real-world surroundings, and even walk around or inside the house using View in the AR option.
• Scan your room or house using the Room Scanner feature based on LiDAR technology to recreate its digital copy in the app (only for devices with LiDAR sensors built-in).
• Achieve natural lighting by setting up true geolocation, time of day and cloudiness.
• Adjust light fixtures throughout the house to achieve a realistic lighting scene.
• Set multiple cameras to create flyover videos and 3D renderings of your projects from different angles.
• Work with the fully customizable roof; create corner windows and complex openings.
• Easily share your projects among iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, macOS or Windows devices.
Share your projects with friends, contractors or on social media.
• Export 2D floor plans as PDF and 3D views of your projects as high-resolution images.
• Get highly realistic views of your designs with the Cycles rendering engine (unlimited number of renders). Your project will be rendered right on your device.
• Export fast and high quality AI renders of your designs: choose from a multitude of presets and adjust simple settings.
• Render realistic home interior and outdoor walkthrough videos.
• Create Stereo 3D Video, 360° Video, Stereo 3D 360° Video and 360° Panorama JPEG images.
Note: All exports have watermarks in the Free version of the app. Only one project at a time can be used in the Free version.
The Standard Features In-App purchase removes the watermarks, save limitations and the 2-floor limit of the Free version. 
The Pro Features In-App purchase additionally unlocks the advanced features listed below:
• Export quality extended to Ultra HD for movies and 360° Panoramas, and to Hi-res (16,000 x 16,000) for still shots.

bluejetty:00124211:ios.description:

Command your battleship as a third person shooter and plan your battlefield war strategy.
Take command of a variety of ships from the World War 1 and World War 2 era including Patrol Boats, Destroyers, Cruisers, Battleships, Dreadnoughts, Submarines and Aircraft Carriers.

Run escort for your allies cargo or passenger missions and be rewarded should they deem you worthy!
Sneak up on your opponents in one of 3 submarine types before unloading your torpedo's!
Lay a minefield with the mine laying cruiser!
Use depth charges or hedgehogs on enemy subs!
Strategically get in position and fire deadly broadside attacks!
Lead enemies into the firepower of your allied forces!
You can even fly the pirate flag to put the fear of the seas into your opponents!
Train up on the low tier training server before taking on massive action in the main battle server.
Good Luck Captain!

Select from our list of countries and choose the type of virtual number you need.

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00014138:ios.description:

bluejetty:00043227:ios.description:
Ya no tendrás que ingresar contraseña bancaria, tarjeta de coordenadas, clave dinámica u otros, porque Onepay es la billetera digital con la que puedes pagar en Webpay y ahora también en locales habilitados para pago con código QR, a través de Cobro QR de Transbank.
Onepay es tan fácil de usar, que estarás pagando con tu celular en cualquier lugar, con estos simples pasos:
● Instala la app y crea tu cuenta Onepay
● Crea tu PIN de 5 dígitos. Solo lo usarás cuando pagues con Onepay.
● Agrega cualquier tarjeta de crédito, débito o prepago. Solo por esta vez usarás tu contraseña bancaria, tarjeta de coordenadas o clave dinámica.
¡Listo! Ahora al comprar en código QR recuerda preguntar si el local está adherido a Cobro QR de Transbank, escaneas el código QR o ingresas el código de compra que te indicará el vendedor, autorizas el pago con tu PIN de 5 dígitos, así de simple. En Webpay solo seleccionas Onepay y sigues los mismos pasos anteriores.
¿Te quedan más dudas? Revisa las preguntas más comunes que recibimos sobre Onepay, así tú también te convences de usar la billetera digital para todos.

Usa Onepay para pagar en los comercios que cuenten con Cobro QR de Transbank, junto a todos los ecommerce y sitios web que cuentan con Webpay. bluejetty:00133224:ios.description:
Pricefinder is the home of quality property insights.
At your fingertips access the property insights you need to be a leading agent in your local area. Pricefinder provides you with quality data, from over 13 million properties across Australia.
Discover local insights into key suburbs through utilising over 30 years of sales history and real-time auction results to build confidence with your vendors as the agent with the insights.
Join thousands of agents with access to price estimates for over 90% of the residential properties within Australia, powered by Domain Insight. Pricefinder unlocks the performance you need with trusted property estimates used by financial institutions across Australia.
What features can you access on the Pricefinder app?
- The Quick Search makes it easier to search for properties, streets or suburbs
- Easily view the entire sales history on a property
- Download property reports instantly onto your phone
- Download a suburb flyover to get key suburb insights
- Favourite Searches to save your common searches and keep track of your local market
- View nearby development applications that may affect your vendors and link to the council website
- Confirm the school catchment every property belongs within
- Plus many more features!
As always, you must have an active Pricefinder subscription and a data or Wi-Fi connection in order to use this app. Data download and internet usage charges may apply. 
Pricefinder, quality insights at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00185487:ios.summary: The FUJIFILM Camera Remote is an application provided by FUJIFILM that can operate wireless-equipped digital cameras by remote control to shoot images and to view images and movies in the camera and to transfer them to smartphones or tablet
bluejetty:00185487:ios.description:
The FUJIFILM Camera Remote is an application provided by FUJIFILM that can operate wireless-equipped digital cameras by remote control to shoot images and to view images and movies in the camera and to transfer them to smartphones or tablets. And it also supports the cameras that offers Bluetooth® capability. Pair it with your smartphones or tablet devices, it synchronizes "date and time" and/or "location information" of your smartphone or tablet devices with the cameras that offers Bluetooth® capability. In advanced of shooting, to easily transfer pictures you have taken to the smartphones or tablet device via this application. Bluetooth wireless remote shutter release can be used for cameras that offers Bluetooth® capability. In addition, firmware update is now supported from your smartphone or tablet devices via Bluetooth without the need of a SD memory card.
[Features]
-This application provides the following functions:
1. Transferring images and movies to a Smartphone
2. Browsing the Camera from a Smartphone 
3. Downloading Location Data from a Smartphone
4. Shooting Images by Remote Control(*)
5. Easily transfer pictures from the cameras that offers Bluetooth capability.
6. Synchronizing "date and time" and/or "location information" with the cameras that offers Bluetooth capability
7. Firmware update via a Smartphone to the cameras that offers Bluetooth capability.
8. Bluetooth wireless remote control camera shutter release is now supported for cameras that offers Bluetooth capability.
*How to change the setting depends on your camera.
[Supported cameras]
FUJIFILM GFX100 II, GFX100, GFX100SII, GFX100S, GFX50S II, GFX 50R, GFX 50S, X-H2S, X-H2, X-H1, X-Pro3, X-Pro2, X-T5, X-T4, X-T3, X-T2, X-T1※, X-T50, X-T30 II, X-T30, X-T20, X-T10(*), X-T200, X-T100, X-S10, X-E4, X-E3, X-E2S(*), X-E2(*), X-M5, X-M1(*), X-A7, X-A5, X-A3, X-A2(*), X-A1(*), X-A20, X-A10, X100VI, X100V, X100F, X100T(*), XF10, X70(*), X30(*), XQ2(*), XQ1(*)
FinePix XP140, XP130, XP120, XP90, XP80, S9950W, S9900W
(*) Some functions are not available on some smartphones. Please refer to the URL below.
https://fujifilm-x.com/global/news/countermeasure-for-fujifilm-camera-remote-connection-failure/
[Smartphone System Requirements]
iPhone/iPad/iPod touch: iOS 11.0 - 17.1
*iPad WiFi, iPod touch can not use the Geotagging.
*This application software doesn't guarantee the functions for all the iPhone, iPad and iPodtouch.
*iOS10:Ignore the message of "Security Recommendation" during Wi-Fi setting.
Please use your camera with the latest firmware when using the FUJIFILM Camera Remote App.
Please visit the FUJIFILM website for instructions and to download the latest firmware.
http://www.fujifilm.com/support/digital_cameras/software/
Please Visit FUJIFILM Web pages for more details and usage.
http://app.fujifilm-dsc.com/en/camera_remote/index.html

bluejetty:00131851:ios.description:
Live traffic reports and cameras for Oregon including Portland. Save your favorite cameras for quick access. One time purchase, no subscription required. The app was updated during December 2025.
KEY FEATURES:
Live data from the Oregon Department of Transportation (ODOT):
- 750+ Traffic cameras covering Oregon State.
- Today screen widget to show at a glance the nearest current traffic incidents
- Dark Mode throughout the app (iOS13+).
- Optimised for all iPhone and iPad models.
MAP VIEW
- Shows current incidents and traffic cams.
- Each incident is color coded as well as being represented by an icon showing the incident type.
- Clicking on an incident displays more detail right there on the map.
- The map view can also show live traffic camera images.
LIST VIEW
- Shows current incidents in order of distance from your current location (closest incidents are shown first). 
- Each incident is color-coded to indicate the severity of the delay.
- You can quickly see the distance the incident is from you, the road name and the type of incident.
- The detail view shows the description together with a map showing the location.
TRAFFIC CAM FAVORITES
- Save your favorite cameras for quick access to see how clear/congested your usual routes are.
TODAY WIDGET
- Shows at a glance the nearest current traffic incidents without launching the app.
PERSONALISE
- Toggle traffic information on the map.
- Toggle auto refresh of camera images (will refresh every 10 seconds).
- Toggle always show map on app launch.
- Toggle winter road conditions.
- You can configure which incidents are displayed according to the severity of the delay caused.
- Miles or Kilometres setting.
CONTACT
- Email me for feature requests/bug reports etc. I would love to hear from you!
Data courtesy of Oregon Department of Transportation (ODOT)

bluejetty:00140582:ios.description:
► RACE FOR SURVIVAL
Control a man made out of pixel blocks as he races through challenging obstacle courses in this fun and fast-paced running game. Watch out: as Pixel Boy bumps into obstacles, he’ll lose pixels! Run and jump over the hurdles to ensure his survival, and reach the finish line in one piece to score a PERFECT RUN! 
Collect pixels and stars as you maneuver past all sorts of barriers to restore Pixel Boy’s lost body parts and level up. But be careful! If you knock into too many barriers, you’ll lose all your pixels and have to start again! 
► PERSONALIZE YOUR PIXELS 
Keep Pixel Boy running in style with plenty of customization options! Unlock new character figures that you can accessorize with a wide variety of clothing and other great items. In this 3D runner, your look is up to you! 
If you think fast while you run, you’ll even have the chance to grab new items on the obstacle course. Look out, though: an obstacle might just knock your socks—or any other item you’re wearing—right off! 
►GAME FEATURES:
• Easy controls but challenging and dynamic gameplay. Just tap and slide left or right as you dash down the track! Practice makes for a PERFECT RUN!
• Leap off launchpads to soar over barriers on the obstacle course. Beware of the hurdles, sharp spikes, swinging knives and axes, spinning platforms, and other stumbling blocks that could smash your pixels to smithereens! Will Pixel Boy survive as you steer him through increasingly difficult levels?
• Collect keys to obtain new skins so you can play as a tree, chicken, and more wacky characters! 
• Unlock hundreds of items in the Shop! Earn stars to unlock unique new accessories for personalizing your character, including a top hat, crown, gloves, wand, boots, and a whole bunch of other options. Arrr, matey, wouldn’t you like to see Pixel Boy dressed up like a pirate? 
• The better your skills, the quicker you’ll save up enough pixels to unlock Mystery Boxes with special prizes. This running game takes time and concentration to master, but it pays off with big rewards!
• Plenty of opportunities to nab extra stars. Run and jump your way through bonus levels with star multipliers. Get lucky in the Chest Game, and you just might hit the jackpot!
• This 3D runner will keep you hooked with its awesome graphics and fun sound effects and music. 
• The optional vibration setting lets you FEEL the FUN!
Don’t be a blockhead! Download the Pixel Rush running game now and race through an obstacle course on a quest for survival!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00014337:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for New York JFK Airport (JFK). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at New York JFK Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every JFK flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by New York JFK Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.

bluejetty:00070155:ios.description:
Make your own Minecraft addons — no code, no launcher, no computer.
AddOns Maker for Minecraft PE (MAM) turns an idea into a working add-on in minutes: design a mob, paint its texture, give it behaviours, then export straight into Minecraft Bedrock. 12,000 ratings since 2017. Ready for Bedrock 26.44.
NEW IN VERSION 4.0
• A completely rebuilt interface — every tool is closer, clearer and faster to reach
• Custom dimensions — build your own world and the portal that leads to it
• Cloud sync — your profile and projects follow you to every device you sign in on
• A faster editor, with autosave in the texture tool
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a base — mob, block, weapon, furniture, biome or dimension
2. Customise it — 3D model, texture, sounds, behaviours
3. Export — MAM packs the .mcaddon and imports it into the game for you
Key Features of MAM AddOns Maker for Minecraft PE:
* Custom dimensions — build a whole new world and the portal that takes you there: terrain, biomes, sky and fog, and the mobs that live in it
* Animals/mobs — skins, 3D models, animations, skills and behaviours (NPC, bat, blaze, zombie, skeleton…)
* Custom textures — blocks, environment, items, UI/GUI, colormap, misc
* Blocks, slabs and stairs — new skins, animated, translucent
* Guns, weapons and armour — your own skin and your own behaviour
* Furniture and decoration — tables, chairs, TVs, laptops and more
* Custom sounds — replace any sound in Minecraft with your own
* Custom environment — trees, water fog, fog, flowers and food
* New biomes and new crafting recipes
* Auto-pack — MAM packs everything into an MCPE add-on and imports it into your Minecraft Bedrock Edition game
* No launcher needed to play
NAME, LENGTH AND PRICES OF OUR PUBLICATIONS/SERVICES:
- MAM Premium — first 3 days free, then $3.99/month.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Startup brasileira, líder no mercado de car sharing corporativo no Brasil, cuja missão é tornar o carro corporativo uma ferramenta de mobilidade mais econômica e sustentável. 
A tecnologia Joycar é uma plataforma completa e inovadora, que t
bluejetty:00154792:ios.description:
Startup brasileira, líder no mercado de car sharing corporativo no Brasil, cuja missão é tornar o carro corporativo uma ferramenta de mobilidade mais econômica e sustentável. 
A tecnologia Joycar é uma plataforma completa e inovadora, que transforma frotas organizacionais convencionais em uma operação compartilhada (car sharing corporativo). 
Para isso, o software para compartilhamento de carros é instalado nos veículos da frota organizacional, seja própria ou alugada, possibilitando controle de toda operação em tempo real. 
As vantagens da operação compartilhada e 100% digital são muitas. Para começar, colabora para reduzir custos, em função do redimensionamento da frota e evitando gastos com veículos inativos, combustível, documentação, etc. 
Também otimiza o tempo do gestor de frotas, eliminando controles manuais e tornando o processo eficiente e ágil. 
Para o usuário, a experiência é totalmente digital: o colaborador reserva qualquer veículo, de qualquer lugar, quando precisar. Além da facilidade de abrir o carro com o crachá ou celular. 
Tudo muito rápido, descomplicado e com total eficiência! 
Solicite demonstração da nossa tecnologia através do nosso site: www.joycar.com.br

bluejetty:00180901:ios.summary: Smart Kidz Club Math App is designed for young children to practice and master the required math skills in each grade starting from Pre K to Grade 5. This app follows the Common Core State Standards, and each grade level consists of all the
bluejetty:00180901:ios.description:
Smart Kidz Club Math App is designed for young children to practice and master the required math skills in each grade starting from Pre K to Grade 5. This app follows the Common Core State Standards, and each grade level consists of all the comprehensive math skills essential for elementary school students. All resources are categorized by age, grade, and type and consist of both activity books and flash cards.
Math Flash Cards cover all the fact families —addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. The Flash Cards are highly interactive and have a sequential mode useful for learning and memorization and a random/shuffled mode for practice and memory recall. 
Math Activities consist of 2 modes and come with a choice of the number of questions/problems that the child wishes to solve—
Practice Mode: The Practice Mode allows the child to solve each problem before advancing to the next problem while prompting them to try again if they choose the wrong answer. This mode is not scored.At the end of the practice mode the child has the option to try again with a new set of problems.
Test Mode. The Test Mode is scored and does not prompt the child during their attempt to solve the problem. At the end of the Test Mode the child has the option to try again with a set of new problems or review their answers with detailed feedback and explanation. 
Each Math Activity that requires complex solving, consists of a scratch pad option where the child can freely write on the screen (overlay) to solve the problems in writing if they so desire.
Terms of Use: https://smartkidzclub.com/content/termofuse
Privacy Policy: https://smartkidzclub.com/content/privacypolicy

Our loyalty program is all about sharing Big Fun with you for enjoying the sandwiches, tenders, and shakes you love. You’ll earn Bok Bucks for every purchase made and get rewarded with free chicken, swag, and experiences.

From crispy chicken sandwiches and tenders to Cheez-It® crusted mac n’ cheese and hand-crafted ice cream shakes, each menu item tells a story all while offering guests an inside look into the life and personality of Shaquille O’Neal.

bluejetty:00119299:ios.description:
Identity theft is when criminals use your personal information, such as your Social Security number, email address, passwords, or financial account details, to open accounts, access your money, or commit fraud in your name. A breached login, exposed email address, or stolen account detail can give criminals the information they need to commit identity theft and disrupt your whole life. 
LifeLock protects your identity by monitoring your personal information and sending you alerts to potential identity threats. And if you become a victim, live, U.S.-based Restoration Specialists will do whatever it takes to fix your identity theft. 
Recognized as the #1 identity theft protection provider by Security.org, SafeHome, Tom’s Guide and TechRadar, LifeLock provides: 
Identity restoration, guaranteed. If your identity is stolen, we fix it—guaranteed. 
U.S.-based Restoration Specialists. A dedicated expert handles the calls, the paperwork, and steps needed to resolve your identity theft case, so you don’t have to. 
Up to $3 million in identity theft coverage. Get coverage for stolen funds, personal expenses, and legal and expert costs, subject to plan limits and policy terms.¹ 
Personal information monitoring and alerts. Know if personal information like your Social Security number, email, address, and phone number are being used.
Financial monitoring and alerts. Get alerted to unusual payments, unfamiliar merchants, or spending that doesn’t fit your patterns across your connected financial accounts.† 
Automatic data broker removal. We scan top data broker sites for your personal information and continuously work to remove it, helping reduce your exposure. 
Scam support when you need it. Get 24/7 support from our Virtual Advisor to help protect against scams, plus up to $10k scam reimbursement. ³ 
We do not monitor all transactions at all businesses. 
Credit features require setup, identity verification and sufficient credit history and may take several days to activate after enrollment. 
* Restrictions apply. Automatically renewing subscription required. If you're a victim of identity theft and not satisfied with our resolution, you may receive a refund for the current term of your subscription. See lifelock.norton.com/guarantee for complete details.

*Linear Compass
*Weather Condition display
*Road name Display
*Maximum, Average speed
*Odometer
*Altitude meter
*HUD (Head-up Display) mode
*Landscape portrait mode
* Full screen display mode
*Measurement Unit selection to mph, kmh,knot
*Apple Watch Support
*Today Widget Support

• Optimize your Speed

bluejetty:00086598:ios.description:
Karaca: Evin İçin Tek Uygulama! 
Evini güzelleştirmek, mutfağını yenilemek ve günlük yaşamını daha konforlu hale getirmek için ihtiyacın olan her şey Karaca Uygulaması’nda. Airfryer, kahve makinesi, çeyiz seti, yemek takımları, süpürge, mutfak gereçleri, ev tekstili ve dekorasyon ürünleri gibi yüzlerce seçenek tek bir uygulamada seni bekliyor. 
Üstelik “Oyna Kazan” ile sürpriz kuponlar kazanabilir, AR teknolojisiyle ürünleri evinde nasıl duracağını önceden görüntüleyerek alışverişine yeni bir boyut katabilirsin. 
Karaca Uygulaması ile Alışveriş Daha Kolay! 
- Geniş Ürün Yelpazesi: Mutfaktan oturma odasına, küçük ev aletlerinden dekorasyona kadar binlerce ürün. 
- Özel Kampanyalar ve Kuponlar: “Oyna Kazan” ile anında indirim kuponları kazan, alışverişinde avantaj sağla. 
- Artırılmış Gerçeklik (AR) Teknolojisi: Ürünleri satın almadan önce evinde nasıl duracağını gör. 
- Hızlı ve Güvenli Alışveriş: Siparişini oluştur, kolay ödeme yöntemleriyle anında tamamla ve hızlı teslimat avantajından faydalan. 
- Favori Ürünlerini Takip Et: Beğendiğin ürünleri favorilere ekle, fiyat düştüğünde anında haberdar ol. 
- Sezonluk ve Özel Gün Fırsatları: Black Friday, Anneler Günü, yılbaşı kampanyaları gibi dönemsel indirimlerden ilk sen haberdar ol. 
Mutfağında Şıklık ve Fonksiyonellik 
Mutfakta daha pratik ve keyifli bir deneyim için Karaca’nın yenilikçi ürünleriyle tanış. 
- Kahve Keyfi: Türk kahvesi makineleri, filtre kahve makineleri ve çaycılarla her an lezzetli içecekler hazır. 
- Hızlı ve Sağlıklı Yemekler: Airfryer, tost makineleri, blender setleri ve mutfak robotlarıyla yemek yapmayı daha kolay hale getir. 
- Profesyonel Pişirme Deneyimi: Tencere ve tava setleriyle mutfağında şıklığı ve kaliteyi bir arada yaşa. 
Dekorasyon ve Ev Tekstili 
Karaca, evini sıcak, şık ve konforlu bir hale getirmen için geniş bir dekorasyon ve tekstil koleksiyonu sunuyor. 
- Nevresim takımları, yatak örtüleri ve yastıklarla yatak odana zarafet kat. 
- Sofra takımları ve sunum aksesuarlarıyla yemek masanı tamamla. 
- Mevsime özel ev dekorasyon ürünleriyle her sezon yeni bir atmosfer yarat. 
Ayrıca, AR teknolojisi ile ürünleri satın almadan önce evinde nasıl duracağını görebilir, en doğru seçimi yapabilirsin. 
Çeyiz Setleri ile Yeni Başlangıçlar 
Evlilik hazırlığında mısın? Karaca’nın eksiksiz çeyiz setleriyle hayalindeki mutfağı ve evi oluştur. 
- Tam kapsamlı çeyiz setleri: Yemek takımlarından çatal-bıçak setlerine, tencerelerden kahve makinelerine kadar her şey tek pakette. 
- Evlilik hediyesi arayanlar için özel koleksiyonlar. 
- Zarif ve şık tasarımlar, uzun ömürlü kullanım garantisiyle. 
- Kararsız mısın? Karaca Uygulaması üzerinden mağazadan çeyiz randevusu alabilir, uzman danışmanlardan destek alarak en doğru seçimi yapabilirsin. 
Hemen Karaca Uygulaması’nı İndir! 
- Oyna Kazan ile sürpriz kuponlar kazan, özel indirimlerden faydalan. 
- AR teknolojisiyle alışveriş deneyimini bir üst seviyeye taşı. 
- Güvenli ve hızlı teslimat avantajlarından yararlan. 
- Çeyiz alışverişini mağazada deneyimlemek için uygulama üzerinden randevu oluştur. 
Şimdi Karaca Uygulaması’nı indir, fırsatları kaçırma.

Find your next commercial property on Commercial Real Estate
Search commercial properties for sale or lease
Get a bird’s eye view of commercial properties and real estate that fit your needs. Narrow your search with our innovative map features. Then tap on the orange pins on properties you like and we’ll show you important details such as address, land size and commercial property type.
Have a specific area in mind? No problem! Trace it with your finger on the map and we’ll pull up the available commercial properties in that area. 
It's commercial real estate made easier
Once you’ve found an industrial or commercial property you like, add it to your shortlist and we’ll keep track of it for you. Our property pages are mobile-friendly, so you can call or email the commercial real estate agent when you need to. We’ve also made it easy to send links to your contacts so they can see the industrial or commercial property for themselves before you take things to the next step.
Who are we?
Commercial Real Estate is part of Domain Group, and we’re here to help connect Australians with the right commercial property for sale or lease. Whether you’re looking for a high yielding investment, need office/retail premises to lease, or after an industrial or commercial real estate opportunity, we leverage our expertise in the commercial property sector to bring you the information you need to get right down to business.
Download the app to see for yourself why Commercial Real Estate is where Australia does business. 
Have feedback or suggestions? Let us know at feedback@commercialrealestate.com.au.

Spin The Wheel - Random Picker is an ultimate decision making fortune wheel app where you can create countless custom wheels of fortune, add as many customized la
bluejetty:00017193:ios.description:
Having a hard time deciding something? Let us help you decide in a fun way! 
Spin The Wheel - Random Picker is an ultimate decision making fortune wheel app where you can create countless custom wheels of fortune, add as many customized labels as you want and spin away! 
Put anything you want on the wheel and make unique raffle pickers, random name pickers to draw names of prize winners, create your own spinner games which are much more fun than just flipping a coin or make unlimited lucky wheels to help you answer such questions as What should I do? Where should I eat? Where should I go? Make your decisions in a fun way!
Some of the many great features you get for free:
> Chatrooms: Chat with other people who are currently spinning the same wheel of fortune as you and see their spin results.
> Ready-Made Templates: Premade presets to easily create beautiful spinner wheels
> Wheel Library: Discover and use hundreds of community-created wheels
> No Limits: Create unlimited wheels with unlimited slices
> Full Customization: Personalize text and background of each slice, choosing from dozens of colors
> Adjustable Odds: Tune slice probability with custom weights from 1/50x to 50x
> Sound Effects: Choose the perfect sound effects for your wheel spins and wins
> Slice Notes: Add additional text which is only displayed when the wheel lands on the slice
> Easy Sharing: Share your wheels and spin results with friends instantly
> Toggle Slices: Hide or show specific slices easily
> 100% Fair Spins: Unbiased, random results every time
If you want to have fun doing your raffle, giveaway or picking random name for a game then this app is exactly what you want to have!
In the Spin The Wheel - Random Picker the result is mathematically calculated and chosen randomly every time you spin the wheel, no matter how hard or easy the wheel was spun.

bluejetty:00157926:ios.description:
Shohay Pregnancy is the ultimate app for expecting mothers and fathers. Our evidence-based content, written and reviewed by doctors, provides week-by-week guidance on pregnancy and fetal development. Our app features a variety of tools to help you track your progress, manage symptoms, and stay healthy throughout your pregnancy. We also provide advice for dads on how they can support their partners during pregnancy.
KEY FEATURES:
Comprehensive pregnancy tracker: Monitor your progress with our unique weight tracker and stay informed with the week-by-week guides and articles authored by doctors.
Essential tools: Stay on top of your appointments with our reminder system, calculate your baby's due date, and manage your pregnancy symptoms week by week effectively.
Healthy lifestyle guidance: Leverage our diet charts, nutritional information, and prenatal exercise routines for a fit and healthy pregnancy.
Advice for dads: Learn how to provide effective support to your partner during pregnancy.
Evidence-based content: Make informed decisions about your pregnancy using our content.
PREMIUM FEATURES:
Exclusive video guides: Get access to weekly video guides hosted by renowned Dr. Tasnim Jara. These videos cover wide-ranging topics including nutrition for a healthy pregnancy, what tests to take, how to manage pregnancy symptoms, how to prepare for delivery and breastfeeding, and skincare for pregnant women.
Medical Record: Store your medical records in one place so that you can access them in times of need.
With Shohay Pregnancy, you'll have everything you need to ensure a healthy and happy pregnancy. Download now and start your journey today!

bluejetty:00177556:ios.description:
Collect Em All! – The Ultimate Color Match Puzzle Adventure
Get ready for the most satisfying and addictive puzzle experience! In Collect Em All, your mission is simple: connect balls of the same color, crush through challenging puzzles, and climb your way to the top of the global leaderboard.
Connect. Crush. Conquer.
Swipe to link colorful balls and create explosive chains! The longer your chain, the bigger the blast—and the better your score. Clear the board, beat the level goals, and unlock powerful boosters to help you on your journey.
Easy to Play, Hard to Master!
◉ Tap and drag to connect adjacent balls of the same color
◉ Complete each level’s objectives before running out of moves
◉ Use strategy to create super long chains and trigger combos
◉ Blast your way through thousands of handcrafted levels!
Power-Ups & Boosters:
◉ Rocket: Clears a full row or column
◉ Bomb: Blasts a big area in one tap
◉ Shuffle: Rearranges the board for fresh opportunities
Unlock new boosters as you progress!
Game Features:
◉ Satisfying color match gameplay that’s perfect for quick sessions
◉ Thousands of fun and challenging levels with increasing difficulty
◉ Exciting daily rewards, missions, and special timed events
◉ Play anytime, anywhere – no Wi-Fi required
◉ Compete with friends and players worldwide on global leaderboards
◉ Beautiful, bright visuals and smooth animations
◉ Regular updates with new levels, challenges & surprises!
Whether you’re looking to relax or seeking a brain-teasing challenge, Collect Em All delivers a colorful and dynamic puzzle experience that never gets boring.
Perfect For Fans Of:
◉ Match 3 and blast games
◉ Color linking puzzles
◉ Strategy and logic-based mobile games
◉ Addictive games with progression and reward loops
Download Collect Em All now and start your ball-connecting adventure. The puzzle world is waiting—can you collect them all?

bluejetty:00015734:ios.description:
When you're learning English, you can find a lot of phrases that seem to mean the same thing, but are a little bit different. 
It can be really hard to know which phrase you should use. There are so many different ways; which one should you use?
Let’s learn how to use some ways simple formal and informal English phrases, as well as fun slang expressions that people around the world use.
We can also use such English phrases and English idioms to sound more natural, and also to express yourself more clearly and precisely.
Idioms and phrasal verbs play important role in daily English conversation, English writing and speaking. For many people, learning idioms and phrases is a big problem.
This app will help you learn Idioms and Phrases in English very easily and effectively. We have more than 1500 commonly used English Idioms and Phrasal Verbs in the app. It's very easy to use.
Speak english is useful to improve your English ability by understanding common English idioms and phrases.

bluejetty:00073244:ios.description:
Robinhood Wallet - Secure, Seamless, and Built for the Future of Crypto!
Take full control of your crypto with Robinhood Wallet, the easy-to-use Crypto wallet designed for seamless digital asset management. Whether you're buying, storing, or swapping crypto, Robinhood Wallet empowers you with complete ownership and self-custody of your digital assets.
Robinhood Wallet offers a non-custodial experience, giving you full control of your private keys while enabling transactions across multiple blockchains.
▶ Why Choose Robinhood Wallet? 
Robinhood Wallet gives you full control over your digital assets while enabling seamless crypto transactions. Enjoy an intuitive experience built for all crypto users.
▶ Swap Your Favorite Crypto
Manage and trade tens of thousands of popular crypto assets like Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), USDG, and more. 
▶ Easily Buy Popular Crypto Assets

▶ Effortless Crypto Transfers
Easily transfer crypto between Robinhood Wallet and Robinhood Crypto. Move assets quickly to external wallets on supported networks with no hidden fees (network fees still apply). 
▶ Complete Asset Control
Send, receive, and store crypto without restrictions. Robinhood Wallet is non-custodial, meaning you have full ownership of your assets.
▶ Complete Control & Security
Your private keys remain yours. Biometric authentication and advanced encryption.
Download Robinhood Wallet today and take full control of your crypto!

bluejetty:00122502:ios.description:
The Bank of Wisconsin Dells FREE Mobile Banking app is a simple and convenient way to check your account balances,
monitor activity, transfer funds, pay bills and locate BWD/CBOP ATMs and branches – from any location, at any time you choose. 
The Bank of Wisconsin Dells Mobile Banking app is available to all Bank of Wisconsin Dells and Community Bank of Portage Online Banking customers. Accessing the app is simple and fast – use the same Access ID and Password you use for your Personal Online Banking login and you’re on your way to a better Mobile Banking experience. 
Features:
• View Account Balances
• Monitor recent account activity
• View check and deposit image
• Pay bills
• Transfer funds between accounts
• Deposit checks (subject to approval – fee may apply)
• Receive account alerts
• Locate Bank of Wisconsin Dells and Community Bank of Portage ATMs and branches
The Bank of Wisconsin Dells Mobile Banking app is available for all compatible iPhones through the Apple App Store.
The Bank of Wisconsin Dells is a full-service, FDIC insured, financial institution with branches in Wisconsin Dells, Lake Delton and Portage, Wisconsin. To learn more about the Bank of Wisconsin Dells and our privacy policy, please visit www.dellsbank.com.

bluejetty:00030947:ios.description:
Experience the timeless game of chess with beautiful design and intelligent gameplay.
Chess Deluxe brings the classic strategy game to life with a modern, elegant interface and responsive AI that adapts to your skill level. Whether you're learning your first moves or honing your tactics, enjoy chess exactly how you want to play it - with no ads, no distractions, just pure chess.
Play Your Way:
- Smart AI opponents with Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties that provide quick, challenging gameplay
- Local multiplayer for face-to-face games on the same device 
- Game Center integration for online matches with friends anywhere
- Flexible move controls with unlimited undo/redo and move highlighting
- Complete game tracking with move history in Standard Algebraic Notation
Beautiful & Intuitive:
- Clean, distraction-free interface designed for pure chess enjoyment
- Smooth animations and satisfying piece movement
- Board rotation for comfortable two-player games
- Captured pieces display and game timer with customisable durations
- Light and dark themes to match your preference
- Crisp sounds that enhance gameplay without interruption
Seamlessly Connected:
- Settings sync across all your devices with iCloud
- Navigate through your game history by selecting any completed move
- No advertisements to interrupt your focus
- Universal purchase includes iOS, iPadOS, and macOS versions
Chess Deluxe is crafted for chess lovers who appreciate thoughtful design and straightforward gameplay. From quick casual games to focused strategy sessions, experience chess the way it should be - simple, beautiful, and always ready when you are.

bluejetty:00146282:ios.description:
Cardz offers you a fast and modern solution for creating and sharing your digital business cards. Now with our latest feature, you can scan traditional paper business cards and extract contact information using advanced AI technology with our card scanner.
◈ Fast QR Code Scan ◈
• Our unique QR code system makes it easy for anyone to scan your business card.
• Your contacts can simply use their smartphone camera to capture the QR code on your business card and instantly access your contact details.
• No more complicated data entry or manual typing – networking has never been easier and more efficient!
◆ Modern Design and Easy Handling ◆
• Create impressive business cards in no time.
• Choose from stylish templates and customize the business card to match your corporate design.
• Make a personal statement by adding a profile picture and company logo on the QR code.
• Include any amount of information on your business card, including name, contact details, website, address, company information, social profiles, and more.
◈ Networking at a New Level ◈
• Ensure that your contacts receive your business card information.
• Make sure your information is transmitted accurately.
◆ Additional Benefits ◆
• Your digital business card does not require an internet connection for scanning.
◈ Privacy and Security ◈
• Your contact information is safe and protected.
• All data is stored locally on your smartphone at all times.
◈ AI-Powered Business Card Scanning ◈
• Seamlessly scan traditional paper business cards using our advanced AI card scanner.
• Our AI card scanner automatically extracts and digitizes all contact information from paper cards directly into the app.
• Easily save the extracted contact details to your phone or use them within the app for quick access.
• The AI card scanner ensures high accuracy and efficiency in transforming your physical cards into digital contacts.
• Transform your networking by merging traditional and digital methods effortlessly with our AI card scanner.
• The AI card scanner is an essential tool for professionals who frequently receive business cards and need an efficient way to digitize and organize them.
• With our AI card scanner, you can quickly and accurately scan and store contact information from paper cards, ensuring you never lose a valuable contact again.
Cardz is the ultimate solution for modern networking needs. Discover the future of business cards with us. Impress your contacts with modern design, create your business cards in record time, and enable instant scanning anytime, anywhere. Download the app today and join the digital revolution!

bluejetty:00095334:ios.name: Vampirio: Defend & Survive
bluejetty:00095334:ios.summary:
Hunt vampires, undead and dragons in a roguelike with a base-defense twist. By day, build and upgrade your fortress. By night, fight off the horde in fast action combat. You pick new skills every night and build your own combo.
BUILD BY DA
bluejetty:00095334:ios.description:
Hunt vampires, undead and dragons in a roguelike with a base-defense twist. By day, build and upgrade your fortress. By night, fight off the horde in fast action combat. You pick new skills every night and build your own combo.
BUILD BY DAY
• Build walls, towers and buildings around the village
• Upgrade your Town Hall and defenses between nights
• Choose the hero and gear for the night ahead
SURVIVE THE NIGHT
• Dodge through the horde while your hero attacks on their own
• Level up mid-fight and pick new skills: Ice Shards, Lightning, Mortar and more
• Stack your picks into a roguelike build that fills the screen
• Beat elite monsters, minibosses and giant bosses, from sandworms to the dragon Dragan
NINE HEROES, NINE WAYS TO PLAY
• Alba's crossbow, Vlad's silver swords and Radu's hammer (unless he turns into Udar)
• Lucian's lightning gloves, Morana's not-so-sweet cats and Kidd's golden revolvers
• Liliana's axe, Mika's spear, and Ixidor, the wizard nobody understands
• Level up heroes, earn stars and upgrade their weapon, armor and relic
A DARK COMEDY STORY
• Follow the Dracul siblings on the road to Hellsing Academy
• Campaign 1: Dracula's Origin: defend nine villages from the undead
• Campaign 2, Dracula's Descent: fight for the Academy on Normal, Hard and Hell
FIVE MODES AFTER THE STORY
• Umbra Halls: endless survival. How deep can you descend?
• Hellsing Trials: a new siege challenge every season
• Boss Dungeon: deal as much damage as you can and climb the ranking
• Missions: 16-night base-defense seasons
• Raid: attack other players' forts and collect stickers that power up your heroes
NO FORCED ADS
• No forced ads: every video is optional and gives you a reward
• Built for landscape play
• Free to play, with optional in-app purchases
Join the Vampirio community on Discord: https://discord.gg/K3WBNQYzjt
Customer support: support@outfit7neo.com

bluejetty:00165654:ios.description:
With a revolutionary workout, legendary instructors, and epic playlists, SoulCycle is the ultimate mind-body-soul experience. 
Get the app & book your ride, on the go: Bikes open at Noon on Monday. Plus, you can check in for class, shop our retail collection, and see your full SoulJourney—all in one place.
PLAN YOUR RIDE
+ Find classes by city, studio, and instructors.
+ Bookmark classes you want to take for the week ahead.
+ Buy classes quickly and easily, from anywhere in the app.
+ Add classes to your calendar—and never miss a ride.
+ Explore instructors, see their schedules, and listen to their music.
CONNECT TO APPLE HEALTH
When you connect your SoulCycle app to Apple Health, the app will automatically sync key workout data from your rides. This includes the total calories you burned, your maximum heart rate, and your average heart rate for each SoulCycle class you take. The data is pulled directly from Apple Health after each ride and displayed in your SoulCycle class summary, giving you a more complete view of your performance and effort based on your personal health metrics.
SHOP THE COLLECTION
+ Browse, search, and filter our retail collection.
+ Shop curated kits, trend edits, and instructor picks.
+ Get alerted when exclusives and collabs drop.
GET THE LATEST
+ Keep up with everything going on at Soul.
+ Turn push notifications on for instant updates.
See you on a bike!

bluejetty:00116992:ios.name: Aurascope: Capture The Moment
bluejetty:00116992:ios.summary:
SCAN YOUR WORLD. TRACK YOUR ENERGY. COMPETE WITH FRIENDS.

bluejetty:00116992:ios.description:
SCAN YOUR WORLD. TRACK YOUR ENERGY. COMPETE WITH FRIENDS.
Aurascope is a camera-first mobile game that turns real life into a vibe check. Every time you snap a photo—of yourself, your best friend, your pet, your room—you’ll get an aura score based on 500+ data points, including lighting, color, posture, context, and emotional tone.
This isn’t just about taking photos. It’s about seeing more in the photos you already take.
Every scan gives you:
– An aura score (1–1000)
– A personalized insight
– A visual aura filter
– A spot in your Orbit, your personal photo collection
WHAT IS AURASCOPE?
Aurascope blends photography, AI, and emotional intelligence into one game-like experience. You can think of it as part vibe tracker, part real-world exploration game. Like if BeReal met Co–Star, with a little Pokémon Go and Lensa AI energy.
Take a quick selfie, snap your coffee, or capture the vibe of your bedroom. Every photo is analyzed across layers of metadata—from lighting and symmetry to subtle emotional signals—and turned into a score. The clearer and more intentional your photo, the deeper the feedback.
You’ll be surprised how fast it becomes second nature. Especially when you scan your friends and they try to game their aura score with a big pose or goofy smile.
PLAY A GAME THAT’S REAL LIFE
Aurascope gamifies the photos you’re already taking. You’re not just capturing moments—you’re learning from them.
– Earn points for the highest scoring photos
– Scan yourself, friends, food, places, pets, and vibes
– Collect all your scans in your personal Orbit
– Compete with friends for daily and lifetime aura rankings
– Get smarter about what uplifts or drains you
You can scan across 4 core categories:
– Souls (people or pets)
– Artifacts (items and objects)
– Spaces (indoor or outdoor environments)
– Elixirs (food and drinks)
It’s not just about documenting your life—it’s about understanding it.
GAMIFY YOUR ENERGY
Your Aura Score updates daily. Take more photos to raise it.
– Souls (people or pets)Earn streaks and badges
– Track your best and worst days
– Explore how your environment affects you
– Challenge friends to beat your score
– See what boosts your vibe over time
SHARE YOUR VIBE
You can keep your Orbit private or share your favorite scans on your feed. Show off your high score. Compare scans with friends. Or just take a photo of your room and finally understand why it feels good—or doesn’t.
MADE FOR TODAY'S WORLD
Most social apps push you to post highlights, act perfect, and perform for others. Aurascope is different. It’s more personal, more playful, and more reflective.
No likes. No filters. No pressure.
Just you, your camera, and a beautifully simple way to learn about yourself and the world around you.
Perfect for anyone who loves:
– Photography
– Self-awareness apps like Lensa, Wysa, I Am, and Finch
– Astrology and mindfulness tools like Co–Star and The Pattern
– Social wellness games like Duolingo or Finch
– Journaling, manifestation, and visual self-reflection
Aurascope helps you build a deeper relationship with the everyday—through photos, feedback, and fun.
It’s not about perfection. It’s about participation.
DOWNLOAD AURASCOPE NOW AND START SCANNING YOUR WORLD.
Because everything gives off energy.
• • •

Help cute Doggy sorting goods in the supermarket. Train Your Brain!!! Find, sort, and clear 3D goods.
How to sort all goods in the store? 
1. Various items: different goods in the store shelfs.

4. Various items: Passing levels can unlock different & various items in the store. 
5. Ues Tools: Magent, Refresh and Freeze tools help sorting goods easily and faster. 
What's the Coins & Stars use for?
1. Coins: Use coins buy Times or Boosters before levels start. 
2. Star Gift: Earn more stars to get rewards! 
Game Features! Be the Sorting Master

2. Keep Streak: keep winning streak to get booster reward every level. 
3. Different Modes: Choose normal, hard or expert levels that are suitable for different levels of challenges. 
4. Firework: Unlock lv12, can help collect 3 items. 
5. Red Clock: Unlock lv12, can add extra 30 seconds. 
Golden Goods & Masked Goods
1. Golden Goods: Collect golden goods to unlock Times or Boosters. 
2. Masked Goods: Guess which is the one you really want? 
Various items and endless levels increase fun & challenges of Goods Sorting: 3D Store Games.
