bluejetty:00014413:ios.description:
Gain a competitive advantage with Marshall Goldsmith Coaching, the #1 app in leadership development and executive coaching featuring personalized tips and reminders delivered by Marshall Goldsmith. Over one million professionals and organizations follow NYTimes best-selling author Marshall Goldsmith on LinkedIn for his best-in-class leadership and executive coaching. Now, Marshall Goldsmith Coaching brings his world-renowned leadership training directly to you in a one-of-a-kind experience that can’t be found anywhere else. Start today!
Access weekly leadership coaching tips and reminders for as long as you wish. Always free. Or, get new tips and reminders EVERY DAY with a paid subscription.
About Marshall Goldsmith 
At the recent Thinkers50 ceremony in London, Dr. Marshall Goldsmith was recognized again as the World’s #1 Leadership Thinker and #1 Executive Coach. One of his most recent books, Triggers, is a #1 New York Times and Wall Street Journal best seller, as well as an Amazon Best Business Book of the Year.  
Goldsmith is the author or editor of 35 books, which have sold over two million copies, been translated into 30 languages and become bestsellers in 12 countries. His two other New York Times Bestsellers are MOJO and What Got You Here Won’t Get You There—the Harold Longman Award winner for Business Book of the Year. In February 2016, Amazon.com recognized the ‘100 Best Leadership & Success Books’ in their To Read in Your Lifetime series. The list included classics and newer books—management and self-help books. Both Triggers and What Got You Here Won’t Get You There were recognized as being in the top 100 books ever written in their field. Marshall is only one of two authors with two books on the list.  
His work has been recognized by almost every professional organization in his field. Dr. Goldsmith’s Ph.D. is from UCLA’s Anderson School of Management where he was the Distinguished Alumnus of the Year. He teaches executive education at Dartmouth’s Tuck School of Business. He is one of a select few executive advisors who has worked with over 150 major CEOs and their management teams. He served on the Board of the Peter Drucker Foundation for ten years. He has been a volunteer teacher for US Army Generals, Navy Admirals, Girl Scout executives, International and American Red Cross leaders—where he was a National Volunteer of the Year.  
Marshall’s other books include: Succession: Are You Ready?—a WSJ bestseller, The Leader of the Future—a BusinessWeek bestseller. Three of his books have been American Library Association—Choice Award winners for best academic business books of the year.

Navigate through the colorful parking lot, solve challenging puzzles, and ensure that every passenger can find a matching car. Only a genius like you can complete this task, are you ready? Challenging Puzzles: Each level presents a new and more challenging puzzle. Carefully plan your actions, think ahead to clear the road, and ensure that every vehicle can reach passengers without getting stuck. The puzzle was initially simple, but soon became more complex, ensuring hours of exciting gameplay.

bluejetty:00149216:ios.description:
Owll Translator: Real-Time Translation in Your Own Voice 
More than just translation — it's your voice, in any language. 
Speak freely. Understand instantly. See clearly. 
Owll Translator makes conversations feel natural, with no buttons or awkward pauses. 
Now with AI Photo Translation: simply capture or upload any image, and get instant text translations along with AI-powered scene explanations. Plus, our Voice Cloning feature lets you speak any language while still sounding like you. Our new Language Learning feature helps you practice speaking daily and improve your fluency with your own cloned voice.
Powerful Features to Help You Communicate
1. True Voice Cloning 
Speak over 100 languages in your own voice — preserve your unique tone, emotion, and identity.
2. AI Photo Translation 
Translate text in images instantly. Just take a picture or upload a photo to get accurate translations and AI-driven scene explanations.
3. 5-Second Conference Interpretation 
Ultra-fast translations that keep up with the pace of real conversations.
4. Smart Multi-Speaker 
Translation Handle group chats easily. Know who said what and catch the main points without getting lost.
5. Smart Minutes 
Turn long meetings (up to 10,000 words) into short summaries in seconds. Automatically extract key tasks and follow-ups.
6. Industry-Specific Accuracy 
Built-in vocabulary for medical, legal, and religious topics. Real-time correction helps make sure nothing gets lost in translation.
7. 100+ Languages and Dialects 
Supports major languages and regional variations like Mexican Spanish and Canadian French.
How to Get Started
1. Choose your field (Medical, Legal, Religious, etc.)
2. Enable real-time translation or voice cloning
3. Get instant translations, AI-powered summaries, and action checklists
Subscription Options 
Annual Plan (Best Value) 
Try all premium features for a year. 
Weekly Plan (Flexible Access) 
Short-term access if you're just getting started. 
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Additional Information 
Payments charged to your App Store account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew within 24 hours before the current period ends unless canceled 24 hours prior. Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal anytime in Account Settings.
Support & Legal 
Feature requests: translator.support@owll.ai 
Privacy Policy: https://translator.owll.ai/user-agreement/us_privacy_notice.html 
Terms of Service: https://translator.owll.ai/user-agreement/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00027486:ios.summary: The KSAT 12 Weather Authority app offers a sleek and fluid map displaying real-time radar, temperature and surface winds. Whether you're planning your week or just stepping out for the day, our app provides detailed 42-hour and 10-day forec
bluejetty:00027486:ios.description:
The KSAT 12 Weather Authority app offers a sleek and fluid map displaying real-time radar, temperature and surface winds. Whether you're planning your week or just stepping out for the day, our app provides detailed 42-hour and 10-day forecasts tailored to your specific location, accessible by city, ZIP code or wherever you are. 
Key features of the KSAT 12 Weather Authority app: 
- Live from the Weather Authority Center: Livestreams with the best meteorologist team for up-to-the-minute coverage of weather impacting your backyard and the region. 
- Interactive Weather Maps: Better, more dynamic weather radar that is more interactive and easier to read. 
- Updates from the Weather Authority Team: Get real-time insight, video forecasts and up-to-date analysis from our dedicated meteorologists. 
- More Detailed Forecasts: Now including windspeed and direction! Get 3- and 10-day forecasts in both quick view and detailed formats, ensuring you're fully prepared no matter the weather. 
- Live Weather Alerts: Experience integrated weather alerts including tornado likelihood rankings from 1 to 10 for upcoming storm cells. 
- Customizable Notifications: Choose from KSAT12 weather alerts and National Weather Service warnings for comprehensive alerting including tornadoes, severe thunderstorms and flash floods, directly on your map. 
- KSAT Connect: Share and view photos and videos from your community and where events are taking place. Nothing is more powerful than the sights and sounds shared by our viewers, far beyond the forecasts and maps. 
- Dark Mode: A new visual option for easier nighttime viewing. Dark mode is enabled based on your device's settings. 
Beyond just forecasts, the KSAT 12 Weather Authority app offers fully automated, specific weather alerts with up to 15 minutes lead time before severe conditions hit. You can set up alerts for up to 16 locations, including your current mobile location, ensuring that you and your loved ones stay safe. 
South Central Texas, don't just watch the weather. Stay a step ahead with the KSAT 12 Weather Authority app. Download or update today, and take control of your weather experience. Your peace of mind is now at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00159571:ios.description:
The Go Mobile PGH app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Pittsburgh. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can use the Go Mobile PGH app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use Go Mobile PGH?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Use the app in over 3000 locations coast-to-coast including venues, airports, and universities
•. Find areas of the city where there is available parking and avoid areas where there’s no parking
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the Go Mobile PGH app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the Go Mobile PGH app
How It Works
On-Street and Off-Street Parking:
• Enter the zone number on the posted signs around the meter
• Select the amount of time you want to park and confirm your information
• Touch the “Start Parking” button to begin your parking session
• Extend time in the app if you are running late
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Multiple payment methods available
• Parking Availability feature shows streets with open parking spots in your area
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Online Help Center: https://support.ParkMobile.io/hc/en-us/requests/new
Video Tutorials: https://ParkMobile.io/tips-demos/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/

bluejetty:00043267:ios.name: Blossom Story: Sorting Match
bluejetty:00043267:ios.summary: Enter the delightful world of Blossom Story: Sorting Match, where vibrant blooms and exciting puzzles come to life! This is where vibrant flowers and fun puzzles combine to give you the ultimate gaming experience. Whether you're in the mood
bluejetty:00043267:ios.description:
Enter the delightful world of Blossom Story: Sorting Match, where vibrant blooms and exciting puzzles come to life! This is where vibrant flowers and fun puzzles combine to give you the ultimate gaming experience. Whether you're in the mood to relax or ready to take on some brain-teasing challenges, this game has something for players.
Dive into hundreds of beautifully designed levels, each bursting with colorful flowers and exciting tasks. The gameplay is super simple: drag, drop, and match flowers to create perfect combinations and clear the board. It’s easy to pick up, but as you progress, the puzzles get trickier, keeping you hooked and engaged. And there’s more—uncover a touching story along the way about family, and the magical gardens that bring them together.
The game features stunning visuals, with every flower looking like a tiny masterpiece, and calming background music that creates the perfect escape from your daily routine. Each level has unique goals and rewards—collect rare flowers, earn coins, and unlock powerful boosters to help you tackle challenges. Create impressive combos to boost your score or plan your moves carefully to overcome challenging obstacles that will test your skills and keep you engaged.
Play solo to unwind and recharge, or turn it into a fun activity with friends or family to see who can master the puzzles. As you advance, you’ll unlock new levels and experience the joy of transforming simple flower matches into stunning, colorful masterpieces!
Begin your journey with Blossom Story: Sorting Match and immerse yourself in hours of vibrant puzzle fun. Sort, match, and create stunning flower arrangements as you explore a world filled with blooming beauty. Looking for a rewarding challenge, this enchanting adventure is ready for you. Let the blossoming begin!

bluejetty:00103031:android.description:
Discover the new version of the Pass Pass Easy Card application!
Practical, the Pass Pass Easy Card application allows you to consult the contents of your Pass Pass card and to recharge it with your Android NFC smartphone in a few moments, wherever you are, and without going to an ilévia branch.
With Pass Pass Easy Card, facilitate your access to the different modes of public transport in the European Metropolis of Lille: bus, metro and tram!
To get the most from your application:
- Check that your NFC smartphone is compatible: https://www.nfcworld.com/nfc-phones-list/
- Check that your Android version is version 5 or newer.
- Check that your Pass Pass card has an NFC logo on the back.
If this is not the case, go to an Ilévia branch to exchange your old card free of charge for a new NFC-compatible Pass Pass card
Simplify your life with the Pass Pass Easy Card application: more convenient, top-up is at your fingertips:
- Take your Pass Pass card and place it on the back of your smartphone for several seconds until the card has been read confirmation
- You can then remove the card, the time to select your titles
- To finalize the top-up, replace your card on the back of your smartphone.
Please note: your 3G / 4G or wifi network connection must be active for the duration of the operation, until the loading is confirmed
- Your purchase or your reloading is carried out: use the public transport network of the European Metropolis of Lille now!
Need assistance?
You can consult the FAQ.
Do not hesitate to contact us :
- By phone: Customer Relations Department on 03 20 40 40 40 (price of a local call)
- By email to contact@ilevia.fr, subject: Pass Pass Easy Card
We are at your disposal to answer all your questions!

bluejetty:00070653:ios.name: Decibel Meter - Sound Meter
bluejetty:00070653:ios.summary: Turn your smartphone into a sound measuring device. Our app uses a built-in microphone to display current decibels level with a corresponding, easily readable text description, and you can start/stop a measurement to get an average as well
bluejetty:00070653:ios.description:
Turn your smartphone into a sound measuring device. Our app uses a built-in microphone to display current decibels level with a corresponding, easily readable text description, and you can start/stop a measurement to get an average as well as min and max values from a specific period of time. 
- Precision Sound Measurement: Turn your smartphone into a high-accuracy sound meter! Displays real-time decibel levels with clear text descriptions.
- Comprehensive Data Analysis: Capture minimum, average, and maximum sound levels. Perfect for analyzing specific time periods and sound environments.
- Seamless Watch Integration (Apple Watch): Effortlessly control measurements from your wrist with our Apple Watch app. Hands-free and interference-free!
- Customizable Calibration: Manually or automatically adjust decibel input values to fit your needs. Perfect for personalized sound measurement.
- Easy Data Sharing: Share sound level readings instantly. Export as CSV or share engaging screenshots with friends or colleagues.
- Historical Data Tracking: Revisit your sound measurements with our intuitive history screen. Displays all your past data with detailed statistics.
- Cloud Data Security: Keep your data safe and accessible anywhere with our cloud services. Log in with social media or email on any device.
- Adaptive Display Settings: Customize your display for short or long-term monitoring. Keep your screen on to always have an eye on your recordings.
- Features Exclusive to Apple Watch
- Remote Measurement Control: Manage your phone's sound measurements directly from your Apple watch. Simplify your experience!
- Real-Time Monitoring on Your Wrist: Monitor current sound levels conveniently on your Apple Watch device. Stay informed effortlessly!
Using the calibration option, you can adjust the input decibels values according to your needs. You can also screenshot the whole view and share it with friends.
The history screen allows you to see your saved data with the date, time, avg, and max values along with the CSV file from the whole span of measurement, which you can also share as you please.
Keep your data safe with our cloud services, which allows you to create accounts and store your data.. Log in using your social media accounts or email to a different device to see and share your data. 
In settings, you can set up chart length according to your needs, whether you want to see a short period of time or a longer time span. Also, you can change the settings to keep your screen on in order to keep an eye on your recordings at all times.
Our app comes with a brand new application for Apple Watch devices. You can easily control your measurements with your watch without having to touch your phone. Controlling the measurements with the watch avoids interference!
Privacy policy: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/privacy/decibelmeter
Terms and conditions: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/terms/decibelmeter

Manage your health care from anywhere with the Blue Shield of California app. View your ID card,
search for doctors, track your claim information, understand your benefits and more. The Blue Shield of
California app provides BSC and BSC Promise members enhanced 24/7 service and ease-of-access to the information
that matters most.
As a member of Blue Shield of California or Blue Shield Promise, with our app you can:
• View your personalized dashboard
• Search for doctors and facilities, by doctor specialty, by location, and/or by name
• Display and share your Blue Shield of California ID card
• Track the current status of your plan usage, including deductibles and copayments
• Review your claims, and track the progress of new claims from outset to finalization
• Submit out-of-network claims
• Pay your monthly premiums
• Review your health care team, including your doctors’ credentials, locations and contact information
• See your health insurance plan information, including important documents like your plan summary and Evidence of Coverage (EOC)
• Review family members on your plan and see their personal information
• View your benefits, including information on custom benefits, general exclusions and benefit maximums
• Learn about our benefit discount programs, like dental, vision and pharmacy
• Find urgent care
• Quickly access your member information without having to type in your username password. Touch ID is now available for members using compatible devices.
This app is intended for use by Blue Shield of California and Blue Shield Promise Health Plan members who are residents of California.

bluejetty:00024939:ios.name: Drawing for kids 3+ Tiny Art
bluejetty:00024939:ios.summary: Tiny Art is the perfect kids drawing app for children who want to learn to draw, color, and express their creativity in a fun, safe environment. Designed especially for baby, toddler, and preschool learners, Tiny Art helps children develop
bluejetty:00024939:ios.description:
Tiny Art is the perfect kids drawing app for children who want to learn to draw, color, and express their creativity in a fun, safe environment. Designed especially for baby, toddler, and preschool learners, Tiny Art helps children develop artistic skills through a simple and engaging learning process.
Whether your child wants to paint a dinosaur or a favorite animal, our app transforms your device into a creative tracing pad and digital drawing book that parents can trust.
Step-by-Step Learning: Drawing Made Easy
With Tiny Art, every drawing lesson is designed to be easy and stress-free. Children follow simple templates in cartoon and kawaii styles, helping them build fine motor skills from an early age.
- Animal and dinosaur templates: A wide variety of themes to keep kids engaged.
- Interactive tracing: The app acts as a digital worksheet where kids trace outlines and basic shapes to create complete pictures.
Paint and Color: Your Creative Coloring Page
Children can choose their favorite colors to bring every coloring page to life. With an intuitive paint palette and kid-friendly tools, even a young baby can explore colors without the mess. This digital drawing book allows for endless exploration, making it the perfect tool for early learning.
DOODLE Effect: Creative Dark Mode
Switch to our exclusive DOODLE mode to invert colors and create glowing art on a dark background. This unique feature stimulates the imagination and offers a fresh way to doodle, letting kids experiment with high-contrast colors and styles.
Save and Share Your Masterpieces
Every creation is a proud moment. Parents can save their child’s progress directly from the drawing pad and share the artwork with family and friends. It is a wonderful way to keep a record of your child's growth and artistic journey.
New Models Every Month
To keep the inspiration flowing, we add new content every month. From seasonal themes to new animal friends and superheroes, there is always a new lesson to discover. Tiny Art is a dynamic learning tool that grows with your child.
Safe, Ad-Free and Offline
Tiny Art is a premium kids app focused on a distraction-free experience:
- 100% ad-free with no external links.
- Works offline: Perfect for travel, airplane rides, or quiet time at home.
- Download for free: Start your child’s creative journey today with our free-to-try models.
Why Choose Tiny Art?
Tiny Art is more than a simple game; it is an educational tracing app that develops hand-eye coordination, focus, and patience. By combining guided lessons with free-form painting, kids learn that creativity is about exploration and having fun.
-------------------------------------------------- --
